tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

We need to implement the CPU core in cpu.py with the complete 8051 instruction set, setting up SFR definitions for all special function registers, building lookup tables for instruction cycles and lengths, and implementing the main step loop with a detailed opcode dispatch organized by functional groups, starting with NOP at 0x00 through the arithmetic and logic operations.Continuing the opcode table with bit manipulation, conditional jumps, and remaining instructions through 0xFF. Now I'm laying out the cycle counts for each instruction class and working through how SFRs behave when read and written—particularly the quasi-bidirectional port behavior where reading returns the pin state but writing affects the latch. I'll implement this by keeping latch arrays and letting the bus provide pin data, so a read becomes a bitwise AND of the latch and external input, while writes update the latch and notify the bus of any changes.

Interrupt handling uses standard priority polling—checking IE flags against pending requests, then servicing the highest priority enabled interrupt by pushing the PC and jumping to the vector.

For timers, I need to implement T0 and T1 with their various modes (13-bit, 16-bit, 8-bit auto-reload) and handle external counter inputs via T0/T1 pins. The tricky part is timing: timers increment every machine cycle, so I'll accumulate cycles in the main loop and increment each active timer's counter by that amount, checking for overflow after each batch.

For the serial port, I'm implementing SBUF reads/writes with TI/RI flag management and basic 8-bit UART mode support—the firmware will poll these flags after transmitting or receiving. I can skip the transmit rate logic and just make TX instant.

For the watchdog, it's a safety feature; if the firmware times out without resetting, it won't crash the emulator.

On the SFR side, I'm setting up a bytearray for the 256 SFR addresses and making sure direct access to 0x80-0xFF routes to SFR space, not RAM. The accumulator at 0xE0 is the CPU's main storage, and operations like MOVX with DPTR or indirect addressing work through the external bus. Now I'm writing the actual implementation—keeping performance in mind with local variables for the hot loop.

For flags, I'll inline the parity calculation rather than calling a function in every branch, using a lookup table for speed. I also need to handle AT89C55VD specifics: the extra timer T2 with T2CON, RCAP2L/H, TH2/TL2 registers, and the PCA with CMOD, CCAPM0-4, CCAP0-4H/L, plus the 256-byte RAM space. I'll implement T2 in plain 16-bit baud-rate generator mode with RCAP2 reload and TF2/EXF2 flags, and cover the PCA timer with CMOD/CON and CCP compare/capture modes with CCF0-CCF4 flags injected into CCON.

Actually, I'm going to keep PCA and T2 minimal but functional so the firmware doesn't hang waiting for them, and mark them as TODO for later updates. The priority is getting the main code paths working first, then I can refine the peripherals if the firmware depends on them.

{"content": """"Intel MCS-51 (8051) / Atmel AT89C55 processor core.

Design notes
------------
* 12 clocks per machine cycle is assumed (``XTAL / 12``), so every T-state in
  this file is one machine cycle and the natural clock is 1 MHz for a 12 MHz
  crystal.
* Code space is an external :class:`~m8051.rom.ROM`; there is no distinction
  between internal and external fetch, which matches the 8051's unified
  Harvard code space and lets 64 KiB images (27C512) run unmodified.
* Direct addressing above 0x7F hits the SFR space, indirect addressing always
  hits the 256-byte internal RAM - exactly as on real silicon.
* Port latches are kept here, pin levels come from the :class:`HardwareBus`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List, Optional

from .bus import HardwareBus, IRQ_INT0, IRQ_INT1, IRQ_RX, IRQ_T0, IRQ_T1, IRQ_TX, NullBus
from .rom import ROM

__all__ = ["CPU8051"]

# --------------------------------------------------------------------- SFR map
SFR_P0, SFR_SP, SFR_DPL, SFR_DPH, SFR_PCON = 0x80, 0x81, 0x82, 0x83, 0x87
SFR_TCON, SFR_TMOD, SFR_TL0, SFR_TL1, SFR_TH0, SFR_TH1 = 0x88, 0x89, 0x8A, 0x8B, 0x8C, 0x8D
SFR_P1 = 0x90
SFR_SCON, SFR_SBUF = 0x98, 0x99
SFR_P2 = 0xA0
SFR_IE = 0xA8
SFR_P3 = 0xB0
SFR_IP = 0xB8
SFR_PSW = 0xD0
SFR_ACC = 0xE0
SFR_B = 0xF0
# AT89C55 / AT89C55VD extras
SFR_T2CON, SFR_RCAP2L, SFR_RCAP2H = 0xC8, 0xCA, 0xCB
SFR_TL2, SFR_TH2 = 0xCC, 0xCD
SFR_CCON, SFR_CMOD, SFR_CCAPM0, SFR_CCAPM1 = 0xD8, 0xD9, 0xDA, 0xDB
SFR_CCAPM2, SFR_CCAPM3, SFR_CCAPM4 = 0xDC, 0xDD, 0xDE
SFR_CL, SFR_CH = 0xE9, 0xF9
SFR_CCAP0L, SFR_CCAP0H = 0xEA, 0xFA
SFR_CCAP1L, SFR_CCAP1H = 0xEB, 0xFB
SFR_CCAP2L, SFR_CCAP2H = 0xEC, 0xFC
SFR_CCAP3L, SFR_CCAP3H = 0xED, 0xFD
SFR_CCAP4L, SFR_CCAP4H = 0xEE, 0xFE
SFR_WDTRST = 0xA6
SFR_WDTPRG = 0xA7

# Port bit masks
_PORT_MASKS = (-1, -1, -1, -1)

# TCON bits
TCON_IT0, TCON_IE0, TCON_IT1, TCON_IE1 = 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08
TCON_TR0, TCON_TF0, TCON_TR1, TCON_TF1 = 0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80
# SCON bits
SCON_RI, SCON_TI, SCON_REN = 0x01, 0x02, 0x10

_PARITY = bytes(bin(i).count("1") & 1 for i in range(256))

_TABLES_READY = False
_OP_LEN = bytearray(256)
_OP_CYC = bytearray(256)
_VEC = (0x03, 0x0B, 0x13, 0x1B, 0x23, 0x2B, 0x33, 0x3B, 0x43, 0x4B, 0x53, 0x5B, 0x63, 0x6B, 0x73, 0x7B, 0x83)
_VEC_IRQ = (IRQ_INT0, IRQ_T0, IRQ_INT1, IRQ_T1, IRQ_RX, IRQ_TX)


def _init_tables() -> None:
    global _TABLES_READY
    if _TABLES_READY:
        return
    ln = _OP_LEN
    cy = _OP_CYC
    for i in range(256):
        ln[i] = 1
        cy[i] = 1
    # 2-byte immediates
    for op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x14, 0x15, 0x24, 0x25, 0x34, 0x35, 0x44, 0x45,
               0x54, 0x55, 0x64, 0x65, 0x74, 0x75, 0x90, 0xA3, 0xB4, 0xB5,
               0xD5, 0xE4, 0xE5, 0xF4, 0xF5):
        ln[op] = 2
    # 3-byte immediates (MOV direct,#imm)
    ln[0x75] = 3
    for op in (0x01, 0x21, 0x41, 0x61, 0x81, 0xA1, 0xC1, 0xE1):  # AJMP
        ln[op] = 2
    for op in (0x02, 0x12, 0x22, 0x32, 0x42, 0x52, 0x62, 0x72,
               0x82, 0x92, 0xA2, 0xB2, 0xC2, 0xD2, 0xE2, 0xF2):  # LJMP/LCALL
        ln[op] = 3
    for op in (0x03, 0x13, 0x23, 0x33, 0x43, 0x53, 0x63, 0x73,
               0x83, 0x93, 0xA3, 0xB3, 0xC3, 0xD3, 0xE3, 0xF3):  # RR/RL a, imm
        ln[op] = 1
    for op in (0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40, 0x50, 0x60, 0x70,
               0x80, 0x90, 0xA0, 0xB0, 0xC0, 0xD0, 0xE0, 0xF0):  # bit + rel
        ln[op] = 3
    ln[0x30] = 3
    for op in (0xB6, 0xB7, 0xBE, 0xBF, 0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7,
               0xDE, 0xDF, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xEE, 0xEF, 0xF6, 0xF7,
               0xFE, 0xFF, 0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27,
               0x36, 0x37, 0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67,
               0x76, 0x77):
        ln[op] = 1
    for op in (0x86, 0x87, 0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7,
               0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7,
               0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27, 0x36, 0x37,
               0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67, 0x76, 0x77):
        ln[op] = 1
    for op in (0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7, 0xC6, 0xC7,
               0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7):  # MOV @Ri,direct
        ln[op] = 2
    for op in (0xA6, 0xA7):  # MOV direct,@Ri
        ln[op] = 2
    for op in (0x85,):  # MOV direct,direct
        ln[op] = 3
    # DJNZ direct,rel
    ln[0xD5] = 3
    ln[0xB5] = 3
    ln[0xB4] = 3
    # cycle counts
    for op in (0x00,):
        cy[op] = 1
    for op in (0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x13, 0x14, 0x15, 0x23, 0x24, 0x25,
               0x33, 0x34, 0x35, 0x43, 0x44, 0x45, 0x53, 0x54, 0x55,
               0x63, 0x64, 0x65, 0x73, 0x74, 0x75, 0x83, 0x84, 0x85,
               0x93, 0x94, 0x95, 0xA3, 0xA4, 0xA5, 0xB3, 0xB4, 0xB5,
               0xC3, 0xC4, 0xC5, 0xD3, 0xD4, 0xD5, 0xE3, 0xE4, 0xE5,
               0xF3, 0xF4, 0xF5):
        cy[op] = 2
    for op in (0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27, 0x36, 0x37,
               0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67, 0x76, 0x77):
        cy[op] = 1
    for op in (0x86, 0x87, 0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7,
               0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7):
        cy[op] = 2
    for op in (0x02, 0x12, 0x22, 0x32, 0x42, 0x52, 0x62, 0x72,
               0x82, 0x92, 0xA2, 0xB2, 0xC2, 0xD2, 0xE2, 0xF2):
        cy[op] = 3 if op in (0x02, 0x12) else 2
    for op in (0x01, 0x21, 0x41, 0x61, 0x81, 0xA1, 0xC1, 0xE1,
               0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40, 0x50, 0x60, 0x70, 0x80,
               0x90, 0xA0, 0xB0, 0xC0, 0xD0, 0xE0, 0xF0):
        cy[op] = 2
    for op in (0x30, 0x10, 0x20, 0xB4, 0xB5, 0xB6, 0xB7, 0xBE, 0xBF,
               0xC0, 0xD0, 0xD5, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xDE, 0xDF,
               0xE0, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xEE, 0xEF, 0xF0, 0xF6, 0xF7, 0xFE, 0xFF):
        cy[op] = 2
    cy[0x10] = cy[0x20] = cy[0x30] = 2
    cy[0x40] = cy[0x50] = cy[0x60] = cy[0x70] = cy[0x80] = 2
    cy[0x90] = cy[0xA0] = cy[0xB0] = 2
    cy[0xC0] = cy[0xD0] = cy[0xE0] = cy[0xF0] = 2
    cy[0xB6] = cy[0xB7] = cy[0xBE] = cy[0xBF] = 2
    cy[0x00] = 1
    cy[0xA3] = cy[0x85] = cy[0x75] = 2
    cy[0x90] = 2
    cy[0x02] = cy[0x12] = 2
    cy[0xA4] = 4  # MUL AB
    cy[0x84] = 4  # DIV AB
    cy[0xC5] = 1  # XCH A,direct? no: 0xC5 is XCH A,direct (2 cyc)
    cy[0xC5] = 2
    cy[0xD5] = 2
    cy[0xE0] = 2
    cy[0xA5] = 1  # reserved
    _TABLES_READY = True


_init_tables()


class CPU8051:
    """A 12-clocks-per-machine-cycle MCS-51 core."""

    __slots__ = (
        "rom", "bus", "ram", "sfr", "pc", "cycles", "halted", "error",
        "in_isr", "irq_level", "last_op", "trace", "trace_limit",
        "watchdog", "wd_enabled", "pll_locked", "op_count", "idle",
        "serial_in", "t2_running", "pca_running",
    )

    def __init__(self, rom: ROM, bus: Optional[HardwareBus] = None) -> None:
        self.rom = rom
        self.bus: HardwareBus = bus if bus is not None else NullBus()
        self.ram = bytearray(256)          # internal RAM, banked + upper 128
        self.sfr = bytearray(256)          # SFR space (direct 0x80..0xFF)
        self.pc = 0
        self.cycles = 0                    # machine cycles since reset
        self.op_count = 0
        self.halted = False
        self.error: Optional[str] = None
        self.in_isr = 0
        self.irq_level = 0
        self.last_op = -1
        self.trace: Optional[List] = None
        self.trace_limit = 200_000
        self.watchdog = 0
        self.wd_enabled = False
        self.idle = False
        self.t2_running = False
        self.pca_running = False
        self._port_latch = bytearray(4)
        self.reset()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
    def reset(self) -> None:
        self.ram[:] = b"\x00" * 256
        self.sfr[:] = b"\x00" * 256
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = 0x07
        self.sfr[SFR_P0] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P1] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P2] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P3] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_PCON] = 0x00
        self._port_latch[:] = b"\xff\xff\xff\xff"
        self.pc = 0
        self.cycles = 0
        self.op_count = 0
        self.halted = False
        self.error = None
        self.in_isr = 0
        self.irq_level = 0
        self.idle = False
        self.watchdog = 0
        self.wd_enabled = False

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    @property
    def acc(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_ACC]

    @acc.setter
    def acc(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value & 0xFF

    @property
    def psw(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_PSW]

    @psw.setter
    def psw(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = value & 0xFF

    def set_p(self) -> None:
        p = _PARITY[self.sfr[SFR_ACC]]
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE) | p

    @property
    def sp(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_SP]

    @sp.setter
    def sp(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = value & 0xFF

    @property
    def dptr(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_DPH] << 8 | self.sfr[SFR_DPL]

    @dptr.setter
    def dptr(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = value & 0xFF

    # register bank helpers (indirect through PSW.RS0/RS1)
    def _r(self, n: int) -> int:
        return self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n]

    def _set_r(self, n: int, v: int) -> None:
        self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n] = v & 0xFF

    def _ri(self, n: int) -> int:
        """Address held in R0/R1 of the active bank."""
        return self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- stack
    def push(self, value: int) -> None:
        sp = (self.sfr[SFR_SP] + 1) & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = sp
        self.ram[sp] = value & 0xFF
        if sp <= 7:
            self.error = f"stack overflow (SP wrapped to 0x{sp:02X}) at PC=0x{self.pc:04X}"

    def pop(self) -> int:
        sp = self.sfr[SFR_SP]
        value = self.ram[sp]
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = (sp - 1) & 0xFF
        return value

    def push_pc(self) -> None:
        pc = self.pc
        self.push(pc >> 8)
        self.push(pc & 0xFF)
        if self.in_isr < 8:
            self.in_isr += 1

    def pop_pc(self) -> None:
        high = self.pop()
        low = self.pop()
        self.pc = (high << 8) | low
        if self.in_isr:
            self.in_isr -= 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- direct/bit
    def _dir_read(self, addr: int) -> int:
        if addr < 0x80:
            return self.ram[addr]
        return self.sfr[addr]

    def _dir_write(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        value &= 0xFF
        if addr < 0x80:
            self.ram[addr] = value
            return
        if addr == SFR_ACC:
            self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
            self.set_p()
            return
        if addr == SFR_PSW:
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = value
            return
        if SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
            # ports need pin/latch interaction
            port = (addr - SFR_P0) >> 4
            self._port_latch[port] = value
            self.sfr[addr] = value
            self.bus.port_write(port, value)
            return
        self.sfr[addr] = value
        if addr == SFR_SBUF:
            self.bus.serial_write(value)
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_TI
        self._sfr_side_effect(addr, value)

    def _port_read(self, port: int) -> int:
        """Read a port: latch AND external pin levels (quasi-bidirectional)."""
        return self._port_latch[port] & self.bus.port_read(port)

    def _sfr_side_effect(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        if addr == SFR_WDTRST:
            self.watchdog = 0
        elif addr == SFR_WDTPRG:
            self.wd_enabled = True

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------- time
    def _advance(self, cycles: int) -> None:
        """Run timers/serial/peripherals for ``cycles`` machine cycles."""
        self.cycles += cycles
        self.op_count += 1
        tick = self.bus.tick
        tick(cycles)
        sfr = self.sfr
        tmod = sfr[SFR_TMOD]
        tcon = sfr[SFR_TCON]
        ri_hit = False
        if tcon & TCON_TR0:
            m = tmod & 0x03
            if m == 0:
                value = ((sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value & 0x1FFF >= 0x2000 or value > 0x1FFF:
                    value &= 0x1FFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            elif m == 1:
                value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value &= 0xFFFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            else:
                value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | (value & 0xFF)
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            sfr[SFR_TH0] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
            sfr[SFR_TL0] = value & 0xFF
        if tcon & TCON_TR1:
            m = (tmod >> 4) & 0x03
            value = (sfr[SFR_TH1] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL1]) + cycles
            if m == 1:
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value &= 0xFFFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF1
            elif m == 2:
                if value > 0xFF:
                    value = sfr[SFR_TH1]
                    tcon |= TCON_TF1
            else:
                value &= 0xFFFF  # mode 0: 13 bit, mode 3: stop
            sfr[SFR_TH1] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
            sfr[SFR_TL1] = value & 0xFF
        sfr[SFR_TCON] = tcon
        # serial receive
        if sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_REN:
            chunk = self.bus.serial_read()
            if chunk is not None:
                sfr[SFR_SBUF] = chunk & 0xFF
                sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_RI
                ri_hit = True
        # watchdog: 8051 WDT overflows ~ 2**17 machine cycles on AT89C55
        if self.wd_enabled:
            self.watchdog += cycles
            if self.watchdog > 0x20000:
                self.watchdog = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ interrupts
    def _poll_interrupts(self) -> None:
        ie = self.sfr[SFR_IE]
        if not (ie & 0x80):            # EA
            return
        pending = 0
        tcon = self.sfr[SFR_TCON]
        if tcon & TCON_IE0:
            pending |= IRQ_INT0
        if tcon & TCON_TF0:
            pending |= IRQ_T0
        if tcon & TCON_IE1:
            pending |= IRQ_INT1
        if tcon & TCON_TF1:
            pending |= IRQ_T1
        if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_RI:
            pending |= IRQ_RX
        if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_TI:
            pending |= IRQ_TX
        pending |= self.bus.irq_requested()
        pending &= 0xFF
        if not pending:
            return
        ip = self.sfr[SFR_IP]
        chosen = -1
        chosen_pri = -1
        for bit, irq in zip(range(6), _VEC_IRQ):
            if not (pending & irq):
                continue
            if not (ie & irq):
                continue
            if (ip & irq) and self.irq_level and irq != self.irq_level:
                continue
            pri = 1 if (ip & irq) else 0
            if pri > chosen_pri:
                chosen_pri = pri
                chosen = bit
        if chosen < 0:
            return
        irq = _VEC_IRQ[chosen]
        if irq == IRQ_T0:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF0 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_T1:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF1 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_INT0:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE0 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_INT1:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE1 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_RX:
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_RI & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_TX:
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_TI & 0xFF
        self.irq_level = irq if (ip & irq) else 0
        self._advance(2)
        self.push_pc()
        self.pc = _VEC[chosen]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- step
    def step(self) -> int:
        """Execute one instruction.  Returns the machine cycles consumed."""
        if self.halted:
            return 1
        if self.idle:
            self._advance(1)
            return 1
        self._poll_interrupts()
        cycles = self._execute()
        self._advance(cycles)
        return cycles

    def run(self, cycles: int) -> int:
        """Run for at most ``cycles`` machine cycles (or forever if <= 0)."""
        executed = 0
        target = self.cycles + cycles if cycles > 0 else -1
        execute = self._execute
        advance = self._advance
        while True:
            if self.halted:
                break
            if self.idle:
                advance(1)
            else:
                self._poll_interrupts()
                advance(execute())
            executed += 1
            if target >= 0 and self.cycles >= target:
                break
            if executed >= 400_000_000:
                break
        return executed

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- execution
    def _execute(self) -> int:
        rom = self.rom
        pc = self.pc
        self.last_op = rom.byte(pc)
        trace = self.trace
        if trace is not None:
            if len(trace) < self.trace_limit:
                trace.append((pc, self.last_op, self.acc, self.psw,
                              self.sfr[SFR_SP], self.cycles))
            else:
                self.trace = None
        p = pc + 1
        op = self.last_op
        romb = rom.byte
        sfr = self.sfr
        ram = self.ram
        bus = self.bus
        # ---- decode/execute -------------------------------------------------
        if op == 0x00:                                              # NOP
            self.pc = p
            return 1
        # ================================ MOV A, #imm / direct / @Ri / Rn / R
        if op == 0x74:                                              # MOV A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0xE5:                                              # MOV A,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            if addr == SFR_ACC:
                pass
            elif addr < 0x80:
                self.acc = ram[addr]
            elif SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
                self.acc = self._port_read((addr - SFR_P0) >> 4)
            elif addr == SFR_SBUF:
                self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
            else:
                self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if op == 0xF5:                                              # MOV direct,A
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 1
        if op == 0xE4:                                              # CLR A
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = 0
            return 1
        if op == 0xF4:                                              # CPL A
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ 0xFF
            return 1
        if op in (0xE6, 0xE7):                                      # MOV A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if op in (0xF6, 0xF7):                                      # MOV @Ri,A
            self.pc = p
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            return 1
        if op in (0x76, 0x77):                                      # MOV @Ri,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = romb(p)
            return 1
        if 0xE8 <= op <= 0xEF:                                      # MOV A,Rn
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self._r(op & 7)
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if 0xF8 <= op <= 0xFF:                                      # MOV Rn,A
            self.pc = p
            self._set_r(op & 7, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 1
        if 0x78 <= op <= 0x7F:                                      # MOV Rn,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._set_r(op & 7, romb(p))
            return 1
        if 0xA8 <= op <= 0xAF:                                      # MOV Rn,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._set_r(op & 7, self._dir_read(romb(p)))
            return 1
        if 0x88 <= op <= 0x8F:                                      # MOV direct,Rn
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), self._r(op & 7))
            return 1
        if op == 0x85:                                             # MOV direct,direct
            self.pc = p + 2
            src = romb(p)
            dst = romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(dst, self._dir_read(src))
            return 2
        if op == 0x75:                                             # MOV direct,#imm
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._dir_write(romb(p), romb(p + 1))
            return 2
        if op in (0x86, 0x87):                                     # MOV direct,@Ri
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), ram[self._ri(op & 1)])
            return 2
        if op in (0xA6, 0xA7):                                     # MOV @Ri,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 2
        if op == 0x90:                                             # MOV DPTR,#imm16
            self.pc = p + 2
            self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = romb(p)
            self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = romb(p + 1)
            return 2
        # ============================== MOVC / MOVX
        if op == 0x93:                                             # MOVC A,@A+DPTR
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + self.dptr) & 0xFFFF)
            return 2
        if op == 0x83:                                             # MOVC A,@A+PC
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + p) & 0xFFFF)
            return 2
        if op in (0xE2, 0xE3):                                     # MOVX A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            addr = self._ri(op & 1)
            if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
                addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
            self.acc = bus.ext_read(addr) & 0xFF
            self.set_p()
            return 2
        if op in (0xF2, 0xF3):                                     # MOVX @Ri,A
            self.pc = p
            addr = self._ri(op & 1)
            self._ext_write_banked(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 2
        if op == 0xE0:                                             # MOVX A,@DPTR
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = bus.ext_read(self.dptr) & 0xFF
            self.set_p()
            return 2
        if op == 0xF0:                                             # MOVX @DPTR,A
            self.pc = p
            bus.ext_write(self.dptr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 2
        if op == 0xA3:                                             # INC DPTR
            self.pc = p
            self.dptr = (self.dptr + 1) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        # =============================================================== ADD
        if op == 0x24:                                             # ADD A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._add(romb(p), 0)
            return 1
        if op == 0x25:                                             # ADD A,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), 0)
            return 1
        if op in (0x26, 0x27):                                     # ADD A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], 0)
            return 1
        if 0x28 <= op <= 0x2F:                                     # ADD A,Rn
            self.pc = p
            self._add(self._r(op & 7), 0)
            return 1
        if op == 0x34:                                             # ADDC A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._add(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if op == 0x35:                                             # ADDC A,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if op in (0x36, 0x37):
            self.pc = p
            self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if 0x38 <= op <= 0x3F:
            self.pc = p
            self._add(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        # =============================================================== SUBB
        if op == 0x94:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._sub(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if op == 0x95:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._sub(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if op in (0x96, 0x97):
            self.pc = p
            self._sub(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if 0x98 <= op <= 0x9F:
            self.pc = p
            self._sub(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        # ================================================================ INC
        if op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):
            return self._inc_family(op, p, romb)
        if 0x08 <= op <= 0x0F:                                     # INC Rn
            self.pc = p
            n = op & 7
            self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) + 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        if op == 0x14:                                             # DEC A
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] - 1) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op in (0x15, 0x16, 0x17):
            return self._dec_family(op, p, romb)
        if 0x18 <= op <= 0x1F:                                     # DEC Rn
            self.pc = p
            n = op & 7
            self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        # ================================================================ MUL/DIV
        if op == 0xA4:                                             # MUL AB
            self.pc = p
            result = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] * self.sfr[SFR_B]
            self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = result & 0xFF
            self.sfr[SFR_B] = (result >> 8) & 0xFF
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
            if result > 0xFF:
                psw |= 0x04
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
            self.set_p()
            return 4
        if op == 0x84:                                             # DIV AB
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            b = self.sfr[SFR_B]
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
            if b == 0:
                psw |= 0x04
            else:
                self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a // b
                self.sfr[SFR_B] = a % b
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
            self.set_p()
            return 4
        # ========================================================== logical ops
        if op == 0x54:                                             # ANL A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0x55:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 1
        if op in (0x56, 0x57):
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            return 1
        if 0x58 <= op <= 0x5F:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._r(op & 7)
            return 1
        if op == 0x44:                                             # ORL A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0x45:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 1
        if op in (0x46, 0x47):
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            return 1
        if 0x48 <= op <= 0x4F:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._r(op & 7)
            return 1
        if op == 0x64:                                             # XRL A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0x65:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 1
        if op in (0x66, 0x67):
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            return 1
        if 0x68 <= op <= 0x6F:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._r(op & 7)
            return 1
        # ANL/ORL/XRL direct,A and direct,#imm
        if op in (0x52, 0x53):
            self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x52 else 2)
            addr = romb(p)
            operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x52 else romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) & operand)
            return 1 if op == 0x52 else 2
        if op in (0x42, 0x43):
            self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x42 else 2)
            addr = romb(p)
            operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x42 else romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) | operand)
            return 1 if op == 0x42 else 2
        if op in (0x62, 0x63):
            self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x62 else 2)
            addr = romb(p)
            operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x62 else romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) ^ operand)
            return 1 if op == 0x62 else 2
        # =========================================================== rotates
        if op == 0x03:                                             # RR A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            self.acc = (a >> 1) | ((a & 1) << 7)
            return 1
        if op == 0x13:                                             # RRC A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            carry = 0x80 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
            if a & 1:
                psw |= 0x80
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
            self.acc = (a >> 1) | carry
            return 1
        if op == 0x23:                                             # RL A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            self.acc = ((a << 1) | (a >> 7)) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op == 0x33:                                             # RLC A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            carry_in = 1 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
            result = (a << 1) | carry_in
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
            if result > 0xFF:
                psw |= 0x80
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
            self.acc = result & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op == 0xC4:                                             # SWAP A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            self.acc = ((a << 4) | (a >> 4)) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op in (0xD4,):                                          # DA A
            self.pc = p
            return self._da(1)
        # ========================================================= XCH / XCHD
        if op == 0xC5:
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            tmp = self._dir_read(addr)
            self._dir_write(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            self.acc = tmp
            return 1
        if op in (0xC6, 0xC7):
            self.pc = p
            ri = self._ri(op & 1)
            tmp = ram[ri]
            ram[ri] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            self.acc = tmp
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if 0xC8 <= op <= 0xCF:
            self.pc = p
            n = op & 7
            tmp = self._r(n)
            self._set_r(n, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            self.acc = tmp
            return 1
        if op in (0xD6, 0xD7):                                     # XCHD A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            ri = self._ri(op & 1)
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            ram[ri] = (ram[ri] & 0xF0) | (a & 0x0F)
            self.acc = (a & 0xF0) | (ram[ri] & 0x0F)
            return 1
        # ================================================================ PUSH/POP
        if op == 0xC0:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.push(self._dir_read(romb(p)))
            return 2
        if op == 0xD0:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), self.pop())
            return 2
        # ============================================================== branches
        if op == 0x02:                                             # LJMP
            self.pc = romb(p) << 8 | romb(p + 1)
            return 2
        if op == 0x12:                                             # LCALL
            target = romb(p) << 8 | romb(p + 1)
            self.pc = p + 2
            self.push_pc()
            self.pc = target
            return 2
        if op == 0x22:                                             # RET
            self.pop_pc()
            return 2
        if op == 0x32:                                             # RETI
            self.pop_pc()
            self.irq_level = 0
            return 2
        if op in (0x01, 0x21, 0x41, 0x61, 0x81, 0xA1, 0xC1, 0xE1):  # AJMP
            page = (p & 0xF800)
            target = page | ((op >> 5) << 8) | romb(p)
            self.pc = target
            return 2
        if op == 0x80:                                             # SJMP
            self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0x40:                                             # JC
            self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if (sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else p + 1
            return 2
        if op == 0x50:                                             # JNC
            self.pc = p + 1 if (sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0x60:                                             # JZ
            self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if self.sfr[SFR_ACC] == 0 else p + 1
            return 2
        if op == 0x70:                                             # JNZ
            self.pc = p + 1 if self.sfr[SFR_ACC] == 0 else (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0xB4:                                             # CJNE A,#imm,rel
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], romb(p))
            if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0xB5:                                             # CJNE A,direct,rel
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], self._dir_read(romb(p)))
            if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op in (0xB6, 0xB7):                                     # CJNE @Ri,#imm,rel
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._cjne(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], romb(p))
            if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if 0xB8 <= op <= 0xBF:                                     # CJNE Rn,#imm,rel
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._cjne(self._r(op & 7), romb(p))
            if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0xD5:                                             # DJNZ direct,rel
            addr = romb(p)
            value = (self._dir_read(addr) - 1) & 0xFF
            self._dir_write(addr, value)
            self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF if value else p + 2
            return 2
        if 0xD8 <= op <= 0xDF:                                     # DJNZ Rn,rel
            n = op & 7
            value = (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF
            self._set_r(n, value)
            self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if value else p + 1
            return 2
        if op == 0x20:                                             # JB bit,rel
            bit = self._bit(romb(p))
            self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF if bit else p + 2
            return 2
        if op == 0x30:                                             # JNB bit,rel
            bit = self._bit(romb(p))
            self.pc = p + 2 if bit else (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0x10:                                             # JBC bit,rel
            addr = romb(p)
            bit = self._bit(addr)
            if bit:
                self._bit_write(addr, 0)
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            else:
                self.pc = p + 2
            return 2
        # ============================================================ bit ops
        if op in (0xC2, 0xC3, 0xD2, 0xD3, 0xB2, 0xB3):
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            if op == 0xC2:
                self._bit_write(addr, 0)
            elif op == 0xD2:
                self._bit_write(addr, 1)
            elif op == 0xB2:
                self._bit_write(addr, 0 if self._bit(addr) else 1)
            elif op == 0xC3:                                       # CLR C
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
            elif op == 0xD3:                                       # SETB C
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
            elif op == 0xB3:                                       # CPL C
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] ^= 0x80
            return 1 if op in (0xC3, 0xD3, 0xB3) else 2
        if op == 0x72:                                             # ORL C,bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            if self._bit(romb(p)):
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
            return 2
        if op == 0xA2:                                             # MOV C,bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | (0x80 if self._bit(romb(p)) else 0)
            return 1
        if op == 0x92:                                             # MOV bit,C
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._bit_write(romb(p), 1 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0)
            return 2
        if op == 0xA0:                                             # ORL C,/bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            if not self._bit(romb(p)):
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
            return 2
        if op == 0x82:                                             # ANL C,bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            if not self._bit(romb(p)):
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
            return 2
        if op == 0xB0:                                             # ANL C,/bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            if self._bit(romb(p)):
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
            return 2
        # ================================================================= misc
        if op == 0xA5:                                             # reserved
            self.pc = p
            self.error = f"reserved opcode 0xA5 at 0x{pc:04X}"
            return 1
        if op == 0xC0:  # (already handled)
            pass
        # ------------------------------------------------------------- unknown
        self.pc = p
        self.error = f"unimplemented opcode 0x{op:02X} at 0x{pc:04X}"
        return 1

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- helper ops
    def _ext_write_banked(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
            addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
        self.bus.ext_write(addr, value)

    def _add(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        result = a + operand + (1 if carry_in else 0)
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0
        if ((a & 0x0F) + (operand & 0x0F) + (1 if carry_in else 0)) > 0x0F:
            psw |= 0x40
        if result > 0xFF:
            psw |= 0x80
        value = result & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
        if (a ^ value) & (operand ^ value) & 0x80:
            psw |= 0x04
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]

    def _sub(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        borrow_in = 1 if carry_in else 0
        result = a - operand - borrow_in
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0
        if ((a & 0x0F) - (operand & 0x0F) - borrow_in) < 0:
            psw |= 0x40
        if result < 0:
            psw |= 0x80
        value = result & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
        if (a ^ operand) & (a ^ value) & 0x80:
            psw |= 0x04
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]

    def _cjne(self, left: int, right: int) -> None:
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
        if left != right:
            psw |= 0x80
        if left < right:
            psw |= 0x80
        else:
            psw &= 0x7F
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw

    def _inc_family(self, op: int, p: int, romb) -> int:
        if op == 0x04:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + 1) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op == 0x05:
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            self._dir_write(addr, (self._dir_read(addr) + 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        self.pc = p
        ri = self._ri(op & 1)
        self.ram[ri] = (self.ram[ri] + 1) & 0xFF
        return 1

    def _dec_family(self, op: int, p: int, romb) -> int:
        if op == 0x15:
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            self._dir_write(addr, (self._dir_read(addr) - 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        self.pc = p
        ri = self._ri(op & 1)
        self.ram[ri] = (self.ram[ri] - 1) & 0xFF
        return 1

    def _da(self, cycles: int) -> int:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW]
        carry = psw & 0x80
        if (a & 0x0F) > 9 or (psw & 0x40):
            a += 6
        if ((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] >> 4) > 9) or carry or (a > 0xFF):
            a += 0x60
            carry = 0x80
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = (psw & 0x7F) | carry
        self.set_p()
        return cycles

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------- bits
    def _bit_addr(self, bit: int):
        if bit < 0x80:
            byte = (bit >> 3) + 0x20
            mask = 1 << (bit & 7)
            return byte, mask, False
        byte = bit & 0xF8
        mask = 1 << (bit & 7)
        if byte == SFR_P0 or byte == SFR_P1 or byte == SFR_P2 or byte == SFR_P3:
            return byte, mask, True
        return byte, mask, False

    def _bit(self, bit: int) -> int:
        byte, mask, is_port = self._bit_addr(bit)
        if is_port:
            return 1 if (self._port_read((byte - SFR_P0) >> 4) & mask) else 0
        if byte < 0x80:
            return 1 if (self.ram[byte] & mask) else 0
        return 1 if (self.sfr[byte] & mask) else 0

    def _bit_write(self, bit: int, value: int) -> None:
        byte, mask, is_port = self._bit_addr(bit)
        if is_port:
            port = (byte - SFR_P0) >> 4
            latch = self._port_latch[port]
            latch = (latch | mask) if value else (latch & ~mask & 0xFF)
            self._port_latch[port] = latch
            self.sfr[byte] = latch
            self.bus.port_write(port, latch)
            return
        if byte < 0x80:
            if value:
                self.ram[byte] |= mask
            else:
                self.ram[byte] &= ~mask & 0xFF
            return
        if value:
            self.sfr[byte] |= mask
        else:
            self.sfr[byte] &= ~mask & 0xFF
        if byte == SFR_SBUF:
            self.bus.serial_write(self.sfr[byte])
        if byte == SFR_P0 or byte == SFR_P1 or byte == SFR_P2 or byte == SFR_P3:
            pass

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ diagnostics
    def state(self) -> dict:
        s = self.sfr
        return {
            "pc": self.pc,
            "op": self.last_op,
            "acc": s[SFR_ACC],
            "b": s[SFR_B],
            "psw": s[SFR_PSW],
            "sp": s[SFR_SP],
            "dptr": self.dptr,
            "p0": self._port_latch[0],
            "p1": self._port_latch[1],
            "p2": self._port_latch[2],
            "p3": self._port_latch[3],
            "cycles": self.cycles,
            "ops": self.op_count,
            "in_isr": self.in_isr,
            "error": self.error,
        }


def _signed(byte: int) -> int:
    return byte - 256 if byte > 127 else byte

block.text:
We need to implement the CPU core in cpu.py with the complete 8051 instruction set, setting up SFR definitions for all special function registers, building lookup tables for instruction cycles and lengths, and implementing the main step loop with a detailed opcode dispatch organized by functional groups, starting with NOP at 0x00 through the arithmetic and logic operations.Continuing the opcode table with bit manipulation, conditional jumps, and remaining instructions through 0xFF. Now I'm laying out the cycle counts for each instruction class and working through how SFRs behave when read and written—particularly the quasi-bidirectional port behavior where reading returns the pin state but writing affects the latch. I'll implement this by keeping latch arrays and letting the bus provide pin data, so a read becomes a bitwise AND of the latch and external input, while writes update the latch and notify the bus of any changes.

Interrupt handling uses standard priority polling—checking IE flags against pending requests, then servicing the highest priority enabled interrupt by pushing the PC and jumping to the vector.

For timers, I need to implement T0 and T1 with their various modes (13-bit, 16-bit, 8-bit auto-reload) and handle external counter inputs via T0/T1 pins. The tricky part is timing: timers increment every machine cycle, so I'll accumulate cycles in the main loop and increment each active timer's counter by that amount, checking for overflow after each batch.

For the serial port, I'm implementing SBUF reads/writes with TI/RI flag management and basic 8-bit UART mode support—the firmware will poll these flags after transmitting or receiving. I can skip the transmit rate logic and just make TX instant.

For the watchdog, it's a safety feature; if the firmware times out without resetting, it won't crash the emulator.

On the SFR side, I'm setting up a bytearray for the 256 SFR addresses and making sure direct access to 0x80-0xFF routes to SFR space, not RAM. The accumulator at 0xE0 is the CPU's main storage, and operations like MOVX with DPTR or indirect addressing work through the external bus. Now I'm writing the actual implementation—keeping performance in mind with local variables for the hot loop.

For flags, I'll inline the parity calculation rather than calling a function in every branch, using a lookup table for speed. I also need to handle AT89C55VD specifics: the extra timer T2 with T2CON, RCAP2L/H, TH2/TL2 registers, and the PCA with CMOD, CCAPM0-4, CCAP0-4H/L, plus the 256-byte RAM space. I'll implement T2 in plain 16-bit baud-rate generator mode with RCAP2 reload and TF2/EXF2 flags, and cover the PCA timer with CMOD/CON and CCP compare/capture modes with CCF0-CCF4 flags injected into CCON.

Actually, I'm going to keep PCA and T2 minimal but functional so the firmware doesn't hang waiting for them, and mark them as TODO for later updates. The priority is getting the main code paths working first, then I can refine the peripherals if the firmware depends on them.

Writing cpu.py now...

{"content": """"Intel MCS-51 (8051) / Atmel AT89C55 processor core.

Design notes
------------
* 12 clocks per machine cycle is assumed (``XTAL / 12``), so every T-state in
  this file is one machine cycle and the natural clock is 1 MHz for a 12 MHz
  crystal.
* Code space is an external :class:`~m8051.rom.ROM`; there is no distinction
  between internal and external fetch, which matches the 8051's unified
  Harvard code space and lets 64 KiB images (27C512) run unmodified.
* Direct addressing above 0x7F hits the SFR space, indirect addressing always
  hits the 256-byte internal RAM - exactly as on real silicon.
* Port latches are kept here, pin levels come from the :class:`HardwareBus`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List, Optional

from .bus import HardwareBus, IRQ_INT0, IRQ_INT1, IRQ_RX, IRQ_T0, IRQ_T1, IRQ_TX, NullBus
from .rom import ROM

__all__ = ["CPU8051"]

# --------------------------------------------------------------------- SFR map
SFR_P0, SFR_SP, SFR_DPL, SFR_DPH, SFR_PCON = 0x80, 0x81, 0x82, 0x83, 0x87
SFR_TCON, SFR_TMOD, SFR_TL0, SFR_TL1, SFR_TH0, SFR_TH1 = 0x88, 0x89, 0x8A, 0x8B, 0x8C, 0x8D
SFR_P1 = 0x90
SFR_SCON, SFR_SBUF = 0x98, 0x99
SFR_P2 = 0xA0
SFR_IE = 0xA8
SFR_P3 = 0xB0
SFR_IP = 0xB8
SFR_PSW = 0xD0
SFR_ACC = 0xE0
SFR_B = 0xF0
# AT89C55 / AT89C55VD extras
SFR_T2CON, SFR_RCAP2L, SFR_RCAP2H = 0xC8, 0xCA, 0xCB
SFR_TL2, SFR_TH2 = 0xCC, 0xCD
SFR_CCON, SFR_CMOD, SFR_CCAPM0, SFR_CCAPM1 = 0xD8, 0xD9, 0xDA, 0xDB
SFR_CCAPM2, SFR_CCAPM3, SFR_CCAPM4 = 0xDC, 0xDD, 0xDE
SFR_CL, SFR_CH = 0xE9, 0xF9
SFR_CCAP0L, SFR_CCAP0H = 0xEA, 0xFA
SFR_CCAP1L, SFR_CCAP1H = 0xEB, 0xFB
SFR_CCAP2L, SFR_CCAP2H = 0xEC, 0xFC
SFR_CCAP3L, SFR_CCAP3H = 0xED, 0xFD
SFR_CCAP4L, SFR_CCAP4H = 0xEE, 0xFE
SFR_WDTRST = 0xA6
SFR_WDTPRG = 0xA7

# Port bit masks
_PORT_MASKS = (-1, -1, -1, -1)

# TCON bits
TCON_IT0, TCON_IE0, TCON_IT1, TCON_IE1 = 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08
TCON_TR0, TCON_TF0, TCON_TR1, TCON_TF1 = 0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80
# SCON bits
SCON_RI, SCON_TI, SCON_REN = 0x01, 0x02, 0x10

_PARITY = bytes(bin(i).count("1") & 1 for i in range(256))

_TABLES_READY = False
_OP_LEN = bytearray(256)
_OP_CYC = bytearray(256)
_VEC = (0x03, 0x0B, 0x13, 0x1B, 0x23, 0x2B, 0x33, 0x3B, 0x43, 0x4B, 0x53, 0x5B, 0x63, 0x6B, 0x73, 0x7B, 0x83)
_VEC_IRQ = (IRQ_INT0, IRQ_T0, IRQ_INT1, IRQ_T1, IRQ_RX, IRQ_TX)


def _init_tables() -> None:
    global _TABLES_READY
    if _TABLES_READY:
        return
    ln = _OP_LEN
    cy = _OP_CYC
    for i in range(256):
        ln[i] = 1
        cy[i] = 1
    # 2-byte immediates
    for op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x14, 0x15, 0x24, 0x25, 0x34, 0x35, 0x44, 0x45,
