class CPU8051:
    """A 12-clocks-per-machine-cycle MCS-51 core."""

    __slots__ = (
        "rom", "bus", "ram", "sfr", "pc", "cycles", "halted", "error",
        "in_isr", "irq_level", "last_op", "trace", "trace_limit",
        "watchdog", "wd_enabled", "pll_locked", "op_count", "idle",
        "serial_in", "t2_running", "pca_running",
    )

    def __init__(self, rom: ROM, bus: Optional[HardwareBus] = None) -> None:
        self.rom = rom
        self.bus: HardwareBus = bus if bus is not None else NullBus()
        self.ram = bytearray(256)          # internal RAM, banked + upper 128
        self.sfr = bytearray(256)          # SFR space (direct 0x80..0xFF)
        self.pc = 0
        self.cycles = 0                    # machine cycles since reset
        self.op_count = 0
        self.halted = False
        self.error: Optional[str] = None
        self.in_isr = 0
        self.irq_level = 0
        self.last_op = -1
        self.trace: Optional[List] = None
        self.trace_limit = 200_000
        self.watchdog = 0
        self.wd_enabled = False
        self.idle = False
        self.t2_running = False
        self.pca_running = False
        self._port_latch = bytearray(4)
        self.reset()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
    def reset(self) -> None:
        self.ram[:] = b"\x00" * 256
        self.sfr[:] = b"\x00" * 256
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = 0x07
        self.sfr[SFR_P0] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P1] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P2] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P3] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_PCON] = 0x00
        self._port_latch[:] = b"\xff\xff\xff\xff"
        self.pc = 0
        self.cycles = 0
        self.op_count = 0
        self.halted = False
        self.error = None
        self.in_isr = 0
        self.irq_level = 0
        self.idle = False
        self.watchdog = 0
        self.wd_enabled = False

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    @property
    def acc(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_ACC]

    @acc.setter
    def acc(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value & 0xFF

    @property
    def psw(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_PSW]

    @psw.setter
    def psw(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = value & 0xFF

    def set_p(self) -> None:
        p = _PARITY[self.sfr[SFR_ACC]]
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE) | p

    @property
    def sp(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_SP]

    @sp.setter
    def sp(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = value & 0xFF

    @property
    def dptr(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_DPH] << 8 | self.sfr[SFR_DPL]

    @dptr.setter
    def dptr(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = value & 0xFF

    # register bank helpers (indirect through PSW.RS0/RS1)
    def _r(self, n: int) -> int:
        return self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n]

    def _set_r(self, n: int, v: int) -> None:
        self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n] = v & 0xFF

    def _ri(self, n: int) -> int:
        """Address held in R0/R1 of the active bank."""
        return self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- stack
    def push(self, value: int) -> None:
        sp = (self.sfr[SFR_SP] + 1) & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = sp
        self.ram[sp] = value & 0xFF
        if sp <= 7:
            self.error = f"stack overflow (SP wrapped to 0x{sp:02X}) at PC=0x{self.pc:04X}"

    def pop(self) -> int:
        sp = self.sfr[SFR_SP]
        value = self.ram[sp]
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = (sp - 1) & 0xFF
        return value

    def push_pc(self) -> None:
        pc = self.pc
        self.push(pc >> 8)
        self.push(pc & 0xFF)
        if self.in_isr < 8:
            self.in_isr += 1

    def pop_pc(self) -> None:
        high = self.pop()
        low = self.pop()
        self.pc = (high << 8) | low
        if self.in_isr:
            self.in_isr -= 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- direct/bit
    def _dir_read(self, addr: int) -> int:
        if addr < 0x80:
            return self.ram[addr]
        return self.sfr[addr]

    def _dir_write(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        value &= 0xFF
        if addr < 0x80:
            self.ram[addr] = value
            return
        if addr == SFR_ACC:
            self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
            self.set_p()
            return
        if addr == SFR_PSW:
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = value
            return
        if SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
            # ports need pin/latch interaction
            port = (addr - SFR_P0) >> 4
            self._port_latch[port] = value
            self.sfr[addr] = value
            self.bus.port_write(port, value)
            return
        self.sfr[addr] = value
        if addr == SFR_SBUF:
            self.bus.serial_write(value)
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_TI
        self._sfr_side_effect(addr, value)

    def _port_read(self, port: int) -> int:
        """Read a port: latch AND external pin levels (quasi-bidirectional)."""
        return self._port_latch[port] & self.bus.port_read(port)

    def _sfr_side_effect(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        if addr == SFR_WDTRST:
            self.watchdog = 0
        elif addr == SFR_WDTPRG:
            self.wd_enabled = True

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------- time
    def _advance(self, cycles: int) -> None:
        """Run timers/serial/peripherals for ``cycles`` machine cycles."""
        self.cycles += cycles
        self.op_count += 1
        tick = self.bus.tick
        tick(cycles)
        sfr = self.sfr
        tmod = sfr[SFR_TMOD]
        tcon = sfr[SFR_TCON]
        ri_hit = False
        if tcon & TCON_TR0:
            m = tmod & 0x03
            if m == 0:
                value = ((sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value & 0x1FFF >= 0x2000 or value > 0x1FFF:
                    value &= 0x1FFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            elif m == 1:
                value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value &= 0xFFFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            else:
                value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | (value & 0xFF)
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            sfr[SFR_TH0] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
            sfr[SFR_TL0] = value & 0xFF
        if tcon & TCON_TR1:
            m = (tmod >> 4) & 0x03
            value = (sfr[SFR_TH1] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL1]) + cycles
            if m == 1:
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value &= 0xFFFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF1
            elif m == 2:
                if value > 0xFF:
                    value = sfr[SFR_TH1]
                    tcon |= TCON_TF1
            else:
                value &= 0xFFFF  # mode 0: 13 bit, mode 3: stop
            sfr[SFR_TH1] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
            sfr[SFR_TL1] = value & 0xFF
        sfr[SFR_TCON] = tcon
        # serial receive
        if sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_REN:
            chunk = self.bus.serial_read()
            if chunk is not None:
                sfr[SFR_SBUF] = chunk & 0xFF
                sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_RI
                ri_hit = True
        # watchdog: 8051 WDT overflows ~ 2**17 machine cycles on AT89C55
        if self.wd_enabled:
            self.watchdog += cycles
            if self.watchdog > 0x20000:
                self.watchdog = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ interrupts
    def _poll_interrupts(self) -> None:
        ie = self.sfr[SFR_IE]
        if not (ie & 0x80):            # EA
            return
        pending = 0
        tcon = self.sfr[SFR_TCON]
        if tcon & TCON_IE0:
            pending |= IRQ_INT0
        if tcon & TCON_TF0:
            pending |= IRQ_T0
        if tcon & TCON_IE1:
            pending |= IRQ_INT1
        if tcon & TCON_TF1:
            pending |= IRQ_T1
        if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_RI:
            pending |= IRQ_RX
        if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_TI:
            pending |= IRQ_TX
        pending |= self.bus.irq_requested()
        pending &= 0xFF
        if not pending:
            return
        ip = self.sfr[SFR_IP]
        chosen = -1
        chosen_pri = -1
        for bit, irq in zip(range(6), _VEC_IRQ):
            if not (pending & irq):
                continue
            if not (ie & irq):
                continue
            if (ip & irq) and self.irq_level and irq != self.irq_level:
                continue
            pri = 1 if (ip & irq) else 0
            if pri > chosen_pri:
                chosen_pri = pri
                chosen = bit
        if chosen < 0:
            return
        irq = _VEC_IRQ[chosen]
        if irq == IRQ_T0:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF0 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_T1:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF1 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_INT0:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE0 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_INT1:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE1 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_RX:
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_RI & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_TX:
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_TI & 0xFF
        self.irq_level = irq if (ip & irq) else 0
        self._advance(2)
        self.push_pc()
        self.pc = _VEC[chosen]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- step
    def step(self) -> int:
        """Execute one instruction.  Returns the machine cycles consumed."""
        if self.halted:
            return 1
        if self.idle:
            self._advance(1)
            return 1
        self._poll_interrupts()
        cycles = self._execute()
        self._advance(cycles)
        return cycles

    def run(self, cycles: int) -> int:
        """Run for at most ``cycles`` machine cycles (or forever if <= 0)."""
        executed = 0
        target = self.cycles + cycles if cycles > 0 else -1
        execute = self._execute
        advance = self._advance
        while True:
            if self.halted:
                break
            if self.idle:
                advance(1)
            else:
                self._poll_interrupts()
                advance(execute())
            executed += 1
            if target >= 0 and self.cycles >= target:
                break
            if executed >= 400_000_000:
                break
        return executed

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- execution
    def _execute(self) -> int:
        rom = self.rom
        pc = self.pc
        self.last_op = rom.byte(pc)
        trace = self.trace
        if trace is not None:
            if len(trace) < self.trace_limit:
                trace.append((pc, self.last_op, self.acc, self.psw,
                              self.sfr[SFR_SP], self.cycles))
            else:
                self.trace = None
        p = pc + 1
        op = self.last_op
        romb = rom.byte
        sfr = self.sfr
        ram = self.ram
        bus = self.bus
        # ---- decode/execute -------------------------------------------------
        if op == 0x00:                                              # NOP
            self.pc = p
            return 1
        # ================================ MOV A, #imm / direct / @Ri / Rn / R
        if op == 0x74:                                              # MOV A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0xE5:                                              # MOV A,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            if addr == SFR_ACC:
                pass
            elif addr < 0x80:
                self.acc = ram[addr]
            elif SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
                self.acc = self._port_read((addr - SFR_P0) >> 4)
            elif addr == SFR_SBUF:
                self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
            else:
                self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if op == 0xF5:                                              # MOV direct,A
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 1
        if op == 0xE4:                                              # CLR A
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = 0
            return 1
        if op == 0xF4:                                              # CPL A
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ 0xFF
            return 1
        if op in (0xE6, 0xE7):                                      # MOV A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if op in (0xF6, 0xF7):                                      # MOV @Ri,A
            self.pc = p
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            return 1
        if op in (0x76, 0x77):                                      # MOV @Ri,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = romb(p)
            return 1
        if 0xE8 <= op <= 0xEF:                                      # MOV A,Rn
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self._r(op & 7)
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if 0xF8 <= op <= 0xFF:                                      # MOV Rn,A
            self.pc = p
            self._set_r(op & 7, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 1
        if 0x78 <= op <= 0x7F:                                      # MOV Rn,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._set_r(op & 7, romb(p))
            return 1
        if 0xA8 <= op <= 0xAF:                                      # MOV Rn,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._set_r(op & 7, self._dir_read(romb(p)))
            return 1
        if 0x88 <= op <= 0x8F:                                      # MOV direct,Rn
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), self._r(op & 7))
            return 1
        if op == 0x85:                                             # MOV direct,direct
            self.pc = p + 2
            src = romb(p)
            dst = romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(dst, self._dir_read(src))
            return 2
        if op == 0x75:                                             # MOV direct,#imm
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._dir_write(romb(p), romb(p + 1))
            return 2
        if op in (0x86, 0x87):                                     # MOV direct,@Ri
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), ram[self._ri(op & 1)])
            return 2
        if op in (0xA6, 0xA7):                                     # MOV @Ri,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 2
        if op == 0x90:                                             # MOV DPTR,#imm16
            self.pc = p + 2
            self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = romb(p)
            self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = romb(p + 1)
            return 2
        # ============================== MOVC / MOVX
        if op == 0x93:                                             # MOVC A,@A+DPTR
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + self.dptr) & 0xFFFF)
            return 2
        if op == 0x83:                                             # MOVC A,@A+PC
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + p) & 0xFFFF)
            return 2
        if op in (0xE2, 0xE3):                                     # MOVX A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            addr = self._ri(op & 1)
            if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
                addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
            self.acc = bus.ext_read(addr) & 0xFF
            self.set_p()
            return 2
        if op in (0xF2, 0xF3):                                     # MOVX @Ri,A
            self.pc = p
            addr = self._ri(op & 1)
            self._ext_write_banked(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 2
        if op == 0xE0:                                             # MOVX A,@DPTR
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = bus.ext_read(self.dptr) & 0xFF
            self.set_p()
            return 2
        if op == 0xF0:                                             # MOVX @DPTR,A
            self.pc = p
            bus.ext_write(self.dptr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 2
        if op == 0xA3:                                             # INC DPTR
            self.pc = p
            self.dptr = (self.dptr + 1) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        # =============================================================== ADD
        if op == 0x24:                                             # ADD A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._add(romb(p), 0)
            return 1
        if op == 0x25:                                             # ADD A,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), 0)
            return 1
        if op in (0x26, 0x27):                                     # ADD A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], 0)
            return 1
        if 0x28 <= op <= 0x2F:                                     # ADD A,Rn
            self.pc = p
            self._add(self._r(op & 7), 0)
            return 1
        if op == 0x34:                                             # ADDC A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._add(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if op == 0x35:                                             # ADDC A,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if op in (0x36, 0x37):
            self.pc = p
            self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if 0x38 <= op <= 0x3F:
            self.pc = p
            self._add(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        # =============================================================== SUBB
        if op == 0x94:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._sub(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if op == 0x95:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._sub(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if op in (0x96, 0x97):
            self.pc = p
            self._sub(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        if 0x98 <= op <= 0x9F:
            self.pc = p
            self._sub(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
            return 1
        # ================================================================ INC
        if op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):
            return self._inc_family(op, p, romb)
        if 0x08 <= op <= 0x0F:                                     # INC Rn
            self.pc = p
            n = op & 7
            self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) + 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        if op == 0x14:                                             # DEC A
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] - 1) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op in (0x15, 0x16, 0x17):
            return self._dec_family(op, p, romb)
        if 0x18 <= op <= 0x1F:                                     # DEC Rn
            self.pc = p
            n = op & 7
            self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        # ================================================================ MUL/DIV
        if op == 0xA4:                                             # MUL AB
            self.pc = p
            result = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] * self.sfr[SFR_B]
            self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = result & 0xFF
            self.sfr[SFR_B] = (result >> 8) & 0xFF
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
            if result > 0xFF:
                psw |= 0x04
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
            self.set_p()
            return 4
        if op == 0x84:                                             # DIV AB
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            b = self.sfr[SFR_B]
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
            if b == 0:
                psw |= 0x04
            else:
                self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a // b
                self.sfr[SFR_B] = a % b
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
            self.set_p()
            return 4
        # ========================================================== logical ops
        if op == 0x54:                                             # ANL A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0x55:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 1
        if op in (0x56, 0x57):
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            return 1
        if 0x58 <= op <= 0x5F:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._r(op & 7)
            return 1
        if op == 0x44:                                             # ORL A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0x45:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 1
        if op in (0x46, 0x47):
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            return 1
        if 0x48 <= op <= 0x4F:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._r(op & 7)
            return 1
        if op == 0x64:                                             # XRL A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0x65:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 1
        if op in (0x66, 0x67):
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            return 1
        if 0x68 <= op <= 0x6F:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._r(op & 7)
            return 1
        # ANL/ORL/XRL direct,A and direct,#imm
        if op in (0x52, 0x53):
            self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x52 else 2)
            addr = romb(p)
            operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x52 else romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) & operand)
            return 1 if op == 0x52 else 2
        if op in (0x42, 0x43):
            self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x42 else 2)
            addr = romb(p)
            operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x42 else romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) | operand)
            return 1 if op == 0x42 else 2
        if op in (0x62, 0x63):
            self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x62 else 2)
            addr = romb(p)
            operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x62 else romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) ^ operand)
            return 1 if op == 0x62 else 2
        # =========================================================== rotates
        if op == 0x03:                                             # RR A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            self.acc = (a >> 1) | ((a & 1) << 7)
            return 1
        if op == 0x13:                                             # RRC A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            carry = 0x80 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
            if a & 1:
                psw |= 0x80
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
            self.acc = (a >> 1) | carry
            return 1
        if op == 0x23:                                             # RL A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            self.acc = ((a << 1) | (a >> 7)) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op == 0x33:                                             # RLC A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            carry_in = 1 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
            result = (a << 1) | carry_in
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
            if result > 0xFF:
                psw |= 0x80
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
            self.acc = result & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op == 0xC4:                                             # SWAP A
            self.pc = p
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            self.acc = ((a << 4) | (a >> 4)) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op in (0xD4,):                                          # DA A
            self.pc = p
            return self._da(1)
        # ========================================================= XCH / XCHD
        if op == 0xC5:
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            tmp = self._dir_read(addr)
            self._dir_write(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            self.acc = tmp
            return 1
        if op in (0xC6, 0xC7):
            self.pc = p
            ri = self._ri(op & 1)
            tmp = ram[ri]
            ram[ri] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            self.acc = tmp
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if 0xC8 <= op <= 0xCF:
            self.pc = p
            n = op & 7
            tmp = self._r(n)
            self._set_r(n, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            self.acc = tmp
            return 1
        if op in (0xD6, 0xD7):                                     # XCHD A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            ri = self._ri(op & 1)
            a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            ram[ri] = (ram[ri] & 0xF0) | (a & 0x0F)
            self.acc = (a & 0xF0) | (ram[ri] & 0x0F)
            return 1
        # ================================================================ PUSH/POP
        if op == 0xC0:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.push(self._dir_read(romb(p)))
            return 2
        if op == 0xD0:
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), self.pop())
            return 2
        # ============================================================== branches
        if op == 0x02:                                             # LJMP
            self.pc = romb(p) << 8 | romb(p + 1)
            return 2
        if op == 0x12:                                             # LCALL
            target = romb(p) << 8 | romb(p + 1)
            self.pc = p + 2
            self.push_pc()
            self.pc = target
            return 2
        if op == 0x22:                                             # RET
            self.pop_pc()
            return 2
        if op == 0x32:                                             # RETI
            self.pop_pc()
            self.irq_level = 0
            return 2
        if op in (0x01, 0x21, 0x41, 0x61, 0x81, 0xA1, 0xC1, 0xE1):  # AJMP
            page = (p & 0xF800)
            target = page | ((op >> 5) << 8) | romb(p)
            self.pc = target
            return 2
        if op == 0x80:                                             # SJMP
            self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0x40:                                             # JC
            self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if (sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else p + 1
            return 2
        if op == 0x50:                                             # JNC
            self.pc = p + 1 if (sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0x60:                                             # JZ
            self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if self.sfr[SFR_ACC] == 0 else p + 1
            return 2
        if op == 0x70:                                             # JNZ
            self.pc = p + 1 if self.sfr[SFR_ACC] == 0 else (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0xB4:                                             # CJNE A,#imm,rel
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], romb(p))
            if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0xB5:                                             # CJNE A,direct,rel
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], self._dir_read(romb(p)))
            if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op in (0xB6, 0xB7):                                     # CJNE @Ri,#imm,rel
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._cjne(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], romb(p))
            if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if 0xB8 <= op <= 0xBF:                                     # CJNE Rn,#imm,rel
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._cjne(self._r(op & 7), romb(p))
            if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0xD5:                                             # DJNZ direct,rel
            addr = romb(p)
            value = (self._dir_read(addr) - 1) & 0xFF
            self._dir_write(addr, value)
            self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF if value else p + 2
            return 2
        if 0xD8 <= op <= 0xDF:                                     # DJNZ Rn,rel
            n = op & 7
            value = (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF
            self._set_r(n, value)
            self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if value else p + 1
            return 2
        if op == 0x20:                                             # JB bit,rel
            bit = self._bit(romb(p))
            self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF if bit else p + 2
            return 2
        if op == 0x30:                                             # JNB bit,rel
            bit = self._bit(romb(p))
            self.pc = p + 2 if bit else (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            return 2
        if op == 0x10:                                             # JBC bit,rel
            addr = romb(p)
            bit = self._bit(addr)
            if bit:
                self._bit_write(addr, 0)
                self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
            else:
                self.pc = p + 2
            return 2
        # ============================================================ bit ops
        if op in (0xC2, 0xC3, 0xD2, 0xD3, 0xB2, 0xB3):
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            if op == 0xC2:
                self._bit_write(addr, 0)
            elif op == 0xD2:
                self._bit_write(addr, 1)
            elif op == 0xB2:
                self._bit_write(addr, 0 if self._bit(addr) else 1)
            elif op == 0xC3:                                       # CLR C
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
            elif op == 0xD3:                                       # SETB C
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
            elif op == 0xB3:                                       # CPL C
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] ^= 0x80
            return 1 if op in (0xC3, 0xD3, 0xB3) else 2
        if op == 0x72:                                             # ORL C,bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            if self._bit(romb(p)):
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
            return 2
        if op == 0xA2:                                             # MOV C,bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | (0x80 if self._bit(romb(p)) else 0)
            return 1
        if op == 0x92:                                             # MOV bit,C
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._bit_write(romb(p), 1 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0)
            return 2
        if op == 0xA0:                                             # ORL C,/bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            if not self._bit(romb(p)):
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
            return 2
        if op == 0x82:                                             # ANL C,bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            if not self._bit(romb(p)):
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
            return 2
        if op == 0xB0:                                             # ANL C,/bit
            self.pc = p + 1
            if self._bit(romb(p)):
                self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
            return 2
        # ================================================================= misc
        if op == 0xA5:                                             # reserved
            self.pc = p
            self.error = f"reserved opcode 0xA5 at 0x{pc:04X}"
            return 1
        if op == 0xC0:  # (already handled)
            pass
        # ------------------------------------------------------------- unknown
        self.pc = p
        self.error = f"unimplemented opcode 0x{op:02X} at 0x{pc:04X}"
        return 1

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- helper ops
    def _ext_write_banked(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
            addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
        self.bus.ext_write(addr, value)

    def _add(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        result = a + operand + (1 if carry_in else 0)
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0
        if ((a & 0x0F) + (operand & 0x0F) + (1 if carry_in else 0)) > 0x0F:
            psw |= 0x40
        if result > 0xFF:
            psw |= 0x80
        value = result & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
        if (a ^ value) & (operand ^ value) & 0x80:
            psw |= 0x04
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]

    def _sub(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        borrow_in = 1 if carry_in else 0
        result = a - operand - borrow_in
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0
        if ((a & 0x0F) - (operand & 0x0F) - borrow_in) < 0:
            psw |= 0x40
        if result < 0:
            psw |= 0x80
        value = result & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
        if (a ^ operand) & (a ^ value) & 0x80:
            psw |= 0x04
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]

    def _cjne(self, left: int, right: int) -> None:
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
        if left != right:
            psw |= 0x80
        if left < right:
            psw |= 0x80
        else:
            psw &= 0x7F
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw

    def _inc_family(self, op: int, p: int, romb) -> int:
        if op == 0x04:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + 1) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op == 0x05:
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            self._dir_write(addr, (self._dir_read(addr) + 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        self.pc = p
        ri = self._ri(op & 1)
        self.ram[ri] = (self.ram[ri] + 1) & 0xFF
        return 1

    def _dec_family(self, op: int, p: int, romb) -> int:
        if op == 0x15:
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            self._dir_write(addr, (self._dir_read(addr) - 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        self.pc = p
        ri = self._ri(op & 1)
        self.ram[ri] = (self.ram[ri] - 1) & 0xFF
        return 1

    def _da(self, cycles: int) -> int:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW]
        carry = psw & 0x80
        if (a & 0x0F) > 9 or (psw & 0x40):
            a += 6
        if ((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] >> 4) > 9) or carry or (a > 0xFF):
            a += 0x60
            carry = 0x80
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = (psw & 0x7F) | carry
        self.set_p()
        return cycles

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------- bits
    def _bit_addr(self, bit: int):
        if bit < 0x80:
            byte = (bit >> 3) + 0x20
            mask = 1 << (bit & 7)
            return byte, mask, False
        byte = bit & 0xF8
        mask = 1 << (bit & 7)
        if byte == SFR_P0 or byte == SFR_P1 or byte == SFR_P2 or byte == SFR_P3:
            return byte, mask, True
        return byte, mask, False

    def _bit(self, bit: int) -> int:
        byte, mask, is_port = self._bit_addr(bit)
        if is_port:
            return 1 if (self._port_read((byte - SFR_P0) >> 4) & mask) else 0
        if byte < 0x80:
            return 1 if (self.ram[byte] & mask) else 0
        return 1 if (self.sfr[byte] & mask) else 0

    def _bit_write(self, bit: int, value: int) -> None:
        byte, mask, is_port = self._bit_addr(bit)
        if is_port:
            port = (byte - SFR_P0) >> 4
            latch = self._port_latch[port]
            latch = (latch | mask) if value else (latch & ~mask & 0xFF)
            self._port_latch[port] = latch
            self.sfr[byte] = latch
            self.bus.port_write(port, latch)
            return
        if byte < 0x80:
            if value:
                self.ram[byte] |= mask
            else:
                self.ram[byte] &= ~mask & 0xFF
            return
        if value:
            self.sfr[byte] |= mask
        else:
            self.sfr[byte] &= ~mask & 0xFF
        if byte == SFR_SBUF:
            self.bus.serial_write(self.sfr[byte])
        if byte == SFR_P0 or byte == SFR_P1 or byte == SFR_P2 or byte == SFR_P3:
            pass

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ diagnostics
    def state(self) -> dict:
        s = self.sfr
        return {
            "pc": self.pc,
            "op": self.last_op,
            "acc": s[SFR_ACC],
            "b": s[SFR_B],
            "psw": s[SFR_PSW],
            "sp": s[SFR_SP],
            "dptr": self.dptr,
            "p0": self._port_latch[0],
            "p1": self._port_latch[1],
            "p2": self._port_latch[2],
            "p3": self._port_latch[3],
            "cycles": self.cycles,
            "ops": self.op_count,
            "in_isr": self.in_isr,
            "error": self.error,
        }


def _signed(byte: int) -> int:
    return byte - 256 if byte > 127 else byte

{"content": """"Intel MCS-51 (8051) / Atmel AT89C55 processor core.

Design notes
------------
* 12 clocks per machine cycle is assumed (``XTAL / 12``), so every T-state in
  this file is one machine cycle and the natural clock is 1 MHz for a 12 MHz
  crystal.
* Code space is an external :class:`~m8051.rom.ROM`; there is no distinction
  between internal and external fetch, which matches the 8051's unified
  Harvard code space and lets 64 KiB images (27C512) run unmodified.
* Direct addressing above 0x7F hits the SFR space, indirect addressing always
  hits the 256-byte internal RAM - exactly as on real silicon.
* Port latches are kept here, pin levels come from the :class:`HardwareBus`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List, Optional

from .bus import HardwareBus, IRQ_INT0, IRQ_INT1, IRQ_RX, IRQ_T0, IRQ_T1, IRQ_TX, NullBus
from .rom import ROM

__all__ = ["CPU8051"]

# --------------------------------------------------------------------- SFR map
SFR_P0, SFR_SP, SFR_DPL, SFR_DPH, SFR_PCON = 0x80, 0x81, 0x82, 0x83, 0x87
SFR_TCON, SFR_TMOD, SFR_TL0, SFR_TL1, SFR_TH0, SFR_TH1 = 0x88, 0x89, 0x8A, 0x8B, 0x8C, 0x8D
SFR_P1 = 0x90
SFR_SCON, SFR_SBUF = 0x98, 0x99
SFR_P2 = 0xA0
SFR_IE = 0xA8
SFR_P3 = 0xB0
SFR_IP = 0xB8
SFR_PSW = 0xD0
SFR_ACC = 0xE0
SFR_B = 0xF0
# AT89C55 / AT89C55VD extras
SFR_T2CON, SFR_RCAP2L, SFR_RCAP2H = 0xC8, 0xCA, 0xCB
SFR_TL2, SFR_TH2 = 0xCC, 0xCD
SFR_CCON, SFR_CMOD, SFR_CCAPM0, SFR_CCAPM1 = 0xD8, 0xD9, 0xDA, 0xDB
SFR_CCAPM2, SFR_CCAPM3, SFR_CCAPM4 = 0xDC, 0xDD, 0xDE
SFR_CL, SFR_CH = 0xE9, 0xF9
SFR_CCAP0L, SFR_CCAP0H = 0xEA, 0xFA
SFR_CCAP1L, SFR_CCAP1H = 0xEB, 0xFB
SFR_CCAP2L, SFR_CCAP2H = 0xEC, 0xFC
SFR_CCAP3L, SFR_CCAP3H = 0xED, 0xFD
SFR_CCAP4L, SFR_CCAP4H = 0xEE, 0xFE
SFR_WDTRST = 0xA6
SFR_WDTPRG = 0xA7

# Port bit masks
_PORT_MASKS = (-1, -1, -1, -1)

# TCON bits
TCON_IT0, TCON_IE0, TCON_IT1, TCON_IE1 = 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08
TCON_TR0, TCON_TF0, TCON_TR1, TCON_TF1 = 0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80
# SCON bits
SCON_RI, SCON_TI, SCON_REN = 0x01, 0x02, 0x10

_PARITY = bytes(bin(i).count("1") & 1 for i in range(256))

_TABLES_READY = False
_OP_LEN = bytearray(256)
_OP_CYC = bytearray(256)
_VEC = (0x03, 0x0B, 0x13, 0x1B, 0x23, 0x2B, 0x33, 0x3B, 0x43, 0x4B, 0x53, 0x5B, 0x63, 0x6B, 0x73, 0x7B, 0x83)
_VEC_IRQ = (IRQ_INT0, IRQ_T0, IRQ_INT1, IRQ_T1, IRQ_RX, IRQ_TX)


def _init_tables() -> None:
    global _TABLES_READY
    if _TABLES_READY:
        return
    ln = _OP_LEN
    cy = _OP_CYC
    for i in range(256):
        ln[i] = 1
        cy[i] = 1
    # 2-byte immediates
    for op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x14, 0x15, 0x24, 0x25, 0x34, 0x35, 0x44, 0x45,
               0x54, 0x55, 0x64, 0x65, 0x74, 0x75, 0x90, 0xA3, 0xB4, 0xB5,
               0xD5, 0xE4, 0xE5, 0xF4, 0xF5):
        ln[op] = 2
    # 3-byte immediates (MOV direct,#imm)
    ln[0x75] = 3
    for op in (0x01, 0x21, 0x41, 0x61, 0x81, 0xA1, 0xC1, 0xE1):  # AJMP
        ln[op] = 2
    for op in (0x02, 0x12, 0x22, 0x32, 0x42, 0x52, 0x62, 0x72,
               0x82, 0x92, 0xA2, 0xB2, 0xC2, 0xD2, 0xE2, 0xF2):  # LJMP/LCALL
        ln[op] = 3
    for op in (0x03, 0x13, 0x23, 0x33, 0x43, 0x53, 0x63, 0x73,
               0x83, 0x93, 0xA3, 0xB3, 0xC3, 0xD3, 0xE3, 0xF3):  # RR/RL a, imm
        ln[op] = 1
    for op in (0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40, 0x50, 0x60, 0x70,
               0x80, 0x90, 0xA0, 0xB0, 0xC0, 0xD0, 0xE0, 0xF0):  # bit + rel
        ln[op] = 3
    ln[0x30] = 3
    for op in (0xB6, 0xB7, 0xBE, 0xBF, 0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7,
               0xDE, 0xDF, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xEE, 0xEF, 0xF6, 0xF7,
               0xFE, 0xFF, 0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27,
               0x36, 0x37, 0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67,
               0x76, 0x77):
        ln[op] = 1
    for op in (0x86, 0x87, 0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7,
               0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7,
               0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27, 0x36, 0x37,
               0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67, 0x76, 0x77):
        ln[op] = 1
    for op in (0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7, 0xC6, 0xC7,
               0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7):  # MOV @Ri,direct
        ln[op] = 2
    for op in (0xA6, 0xA7):  # MOV direct,@Ri
        ln[op] = 2
    for op in (0x85,):  # MOV direct,direct
        ln[op] = 3
    # DJNZ direct,rel
    ln[0xD5] = 3
    ln[0xB5] = 3
    ln[0xB4] = 3
    # cycle counts
    for op in (0x00,):
        cy[op] = 1
    for op in (0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x13, 0x14, 0x15, 0x23, 0x24, 0x25,
               0x33, 0x34, 0x35, 0x43, 0x44, 0x45, 0x53, 0x54, 0x55,
               0x63, 0x64, 0x65, 0x73, 0x74, 0x75, 0x83, 0x84, 0x85,
               0x93, 0x94, 0x95, 0xA3, 0xA4, 0xA5, 0xB3, 0xB4, 0xB5,
               0xC3, 0xC4, 0xC5, 0xD3, 0xD4, 0xD5, 0xE3, 0xE4, 0xE5,
               0xF3, 0xF4, 0xF5):
        cy[op] = 2
    for op in (0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27, 0x36, 0x37,
               0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67, 0x76, 0x77):
        cy[op] = 1
    for op in (0x86, 0x87, 0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7,
               0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7):
        cy[op] = 2
    for op in (0x02, 0x12, 0x22, 0x32, 0x42, 0x52, 0x62, 0x72,
               0x82, 0x92, 0xA2, 0xB2, 0xC2, 0xD2, 0xE2, 0xF2):
        cy[op] = 3 if op in (0x02, 0x12) else 2
    for op in (0x01, 0x21, 0x41, 0x61, 0x81, 0xA1, 0xC1, 0xE1,
               0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40, 0x50, 0x60, 0x70, 0x80,
               0x90, 0xA0, 0xB0, 0xC0, 0xD0, 0xE0, 0xF0):
        cy[op] = 2
    for op in (0x30, 0x10, 0x20, 0xB4, 0xB5, 0xB6, 0xB7, 0xBE, 0xBF,
               0xC0, 0xD0, 0xD5, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xDE, 0xDF,
               0xE0, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xEE, 0xEF, 0xF0, 0xF6, 0xF7, 0xFE, 0xFF):
        cy[op] = 2
    cy[0x10] = cy[0x20] = cy[0x30] = 2
    cy[0x40] = cy[0x50] = cy[0x60] = cy[0x70] = cy[0x80] = 2
    cy[0x90] = cy[0xA0] = cy[0xB0] = 2
    cy[0xC0] = cy[0xD0] = cy[0xE0] = cy[0xF0] = 2
    cy[0xB6] = cy[0xB7] = cy[0xBE] = cy[0xBF] = 2
    cy[0x00] = 1
    cy[0xA3] = cy[0x85] = cy[0x75] = 2
    cy[0x90] = 2
    cy[0x02] = cy[0x12] = 2
    cy[0xA4] = 4  # MUL AB
    cy[0x84] = 4  # DIV AB
    cy[0xC5] = 1  # XCH A,direct? no: 0xC5 is XCH A,direct (2 cyc)
    cy[0xC5] = 2
    cy[0xD5] = 2
    cy[0xE0] = 2
    cy[0xA5] = 1  # reserved
    _TABLES_READY = True


_init_tables()


class CPU8051:
    """A 12-clocks-per-machine-cycle MCS-51 core."""

    __slots__ = (
        "rom", "bus", "ram", "sfr", "pc", "cycles", "halted", "error",
        "in_isr", "irq_level", "last_op", "trace", "trace_limit",
        "watchdog", "wd_enabled", "pll_locked", "op_count", "idle",
        "serial_in", "t2_running", "pca_running",
    )

    def __init__(self, rom: ROM, bus: Optional[HardwareBus] = None) -> None:
        self.rom = rom
        self.bus: HardwareBus = bus if bus is not None else NullBus()
        self.ram = bytearray(256)          # internal RAM, banked + upper 128
        self.sfr = bytearray(256)          # SFR space (direct 0x80..0xFF)
        self.pc = 0
        self.cycles = 0                    # machine cycles since reset
        self.op_count = 0
        self.halted = False
        self.error: Optional[str] = None
        self.in_isr = 0
        self.irq_level = 0
        self.last_op = -1
        self.trace: Optional[List] = None
        self.trace_limit = 200_000
        self.watchdog = 0
        self.wd_enabled = False
        self.idle = False
        self.t2_running = False
        self.pca_running = False
        self._port_latch = bytearray(4)
        self.reset()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
    def reset(self) -> None:
        self.ram[:] = b"\x00" * 256
        self.sfr[:] = b"\x00" * 256
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = 0x07
        self.sfr[SFR_P0] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P1] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P2] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_P3] = 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_PCON] = 0x00
        self._port_latch[:] = b"\xff\xff\xff\xff"
        self.pc = 0
        self.cycles = 0
        self.op_count = 0
        self.halted = False
        self.error = None
        self.in_isr = 0
        self.irq_level = 0
        self.idle = False
        self.watchdog = 0
        self.wd_enabled = False

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    @property
    def acc(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_ACC]

    @acc.setter
    def acc(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value & 0xFF

    @property
    def psw(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_PSW]

    @psw.setter
    def psw(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = value & 0xFF

    def set_p(self) -> None:
        p = _PARITY[self.sfr[SFR_ACC]]
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE) | p

    @property
    def sp(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_SP]

    @sp.setter
    def sp(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = value & 0xFF

    @property
    def dptr(self) -> int:
        return self.sfr[SFR_DPH] << 8 | self.sfr[SFR_DPL]

    @dptr.setter
    def dptr(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = value & 0xFF

    # register bank helpers (indirect through PSW.RS0/RS1)
    def _r(self, n: int) -> int:
        return self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n]

    def _set_r(self, n: int, v: int) -> None:
        self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n] = v & 0xFF

    def _ri(self, n: int) -> int:
        """Address held in R0/R1 of the active bank."""
        return self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- stack
    def push(self, value: int) -> None:
        sp = (self.sfr[SFR_SP] + 1) & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = sp
        self.ram[sp] = value & 0xFF
        if sp <= 7:
            self.error = f"stack overflow (SP wrapped to 0x{sp:02X}) at PC=0x{self.pc:04X}"

    def pop(self) -> int:
        sp = self.sfr[SFR_SP]
        value = self.ram[sp]
        self.sfr[SFR_SP] = (sp - 1) & 0xFF
        return value

    def push_pc(self) -> None:
        pc = self.pc
        self.push(pc >> 8)
        self.push(pc & 0xFF)
        if self.in_isr < 8:
            self.in_isr += 1

    def pop_pc(self) -> None:
        high = self.pop()
        low = self.pop()
        self.pc = (high << 8) | low
        if self.in_isr:
            self.in_isr -= 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- direct/bit
    def _dir_read(self, addr: int) -> int:
        if addr < 0x80:
            return self.ram[addr]
        return self.sfr[addr]

    def _dir_write(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        value &= 0xFF
        if addr < 0x80:
            self.ram[addr] = value
            return
        if addr == SFR_ACC:
            self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
            self.set_p()
            return
        if addr == SFR_PSW:
            self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = value
            return
        if SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
            # ports need pin/latch interaction
            port = (addr - SFR_P0) >> 4
            self._port_latch[port] = value
            self.sfr[addr] = value
            self.bus.port_write(port, value)
            return
        self.sfr[addr] = value
        if addr == SFR_SBUF:
            self.bus.serial_write(value)
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_TI
        self._sfr_side_effect(addr, value)

    def _port_read(self, port: int) -> int:
        """Read a port: latch AND external pin levels (quasi-bidirectional)."""
        return self._port_latch[port] & self.bus.port_read(port)

    def _sfr_side_effect(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        if addr == SFR_WDTRST:
            self.watchdog = 0
        elif addr == SFR_WDTPRG:
            self.wd_enabled = True

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------- time
    def _advance(self, cycles: int) -> None:
        """Run timers/serial/peripherals for ``cycles`` machine cycles."""
        self.cycles += cycles
        self.op_count += 1
        tick = self.bus.tick
        tick(cycles)
        sfr = self.sfr
        tmod = sfr[SFR_TMOD]
        tcon = sfr[SFR_TCON]
        ri_hit = False
        if tcon & TCON_TR0:
            m = tmod & 0x03
            if m == 0:
                value = ((sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value & 0x1FFF >= 0x2000 or value > 0x1FFF:
                    value &= 0x1FFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            elif m == 1:
                value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value &= 0xFFFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            else:
                value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | (value & 0xFF)
                    tcon |= TCON_TF0
            sfr[SFR_TH0] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
            sfr[SFR_TL0] = value & 0xFF
        if tcon & TCON_TR1:
            m = (tmod >> 4) & 0x03
            value = (sfr[SFR_TH1] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL1]) + cycles
            if m == 1:
                if value > 0xFFFF:
                    value &= 0xFFFF
                    tcon |= TCON_TF1
            elif m == 2:
                if value > 0xFF:
                    value = sfr[SFR_TH1]
                    tcon |= TCON_TF1
            else:
                value &= 0xFFFF  # mode 0: 13 bit, mode 3: stop
            sfr[SFR_TH1] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
            sfr[SFR_TL1] = value & 0xFF
        sfr[SFR_TCON] = tcon
        # serial receive
        if sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_REN:
            chunk = self.bus.serial_read()
            if chunk is not None:
                sfr[SFR_SBUF] = chunk & 0xFF
                sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_RI
                ri_hit = True
        # watchdog: 8051 WDT overflows ~ 2**17 machine cycles on AT89C55
        if self.wd_enabled:
            self.watchdog += cycles
            if self.watchdog > 0x20000:
                self.watchdog = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ interrupts
    def _poll_interrupts(self) -> None:
        ie = self.sfr[SFR_IE]
        if not (ie & 0x80):            # EA
            return
        pending = 0
        tcon = self.sfr[SFR_TCON]
        if tcon & TCON_IE0:
            pending |= IRQ_INT0
        if tcon & TCON_TF0:
            pending |= IRQ_T0
        if tcon & TCON_IE1:
            pending |= IRQ_INT1
        if tcon & TCON_TF1:
            pending |= IRQ_T1
        if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_RI:
            pending |= IRQ_RX
        if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_TI:
            pending |= IRQ_TX
        pending |= self.bus.irq_requested()
        pending &= 0xFF
        if not pending:
            return
        ip = self.sfr[SFR_IP]
        chosen = -1
        chosen_pri = -1
        for bit, irq in zip(range(6), _VEC_IRQ):
            if not (pending & irq):
                continue
            if not (ie & irq):
                continue
            if (ip & irq) and self.irq_level and irq != self.irq_level:
                continue
            pri = 1 if (ip & irq) else 0
            if pri > chosen_pri:
                chosen_pri = pri
                chosen = bit
        if chosen < 0:
            return
        irq = _VEC_IRQ[chosen]
        if irq == IRQ_T0:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF0 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_T1:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF1 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_INT0:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE0 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_INT1:
            self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE1 & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_RX:
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_RI & 0xFF
        elif irq == IRQ_TX:
            self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_TI & 0xFF
        self.irq_level = irq if (ip & irq) else 0
        self._advance(2)
        self.push_pc()
        self.pc = _VEC[chosen]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- step
    def step(self) -> int:
        """Execute one instruction.  Returns the machine cycles consumed."""
        if self.halted:
            return 1
        if self.idle:
            self._advance(1)
            return 1
        self._poll_interrupts()
        cycles = self._execute()
        self._advance(cycles)
        return cycles

    def run(self, cycles: int) -> int:
        """Run for at most ``cycles`` machine cycles (or forever if <= 0)."""
        executed = 0
        target = self.cycles + cycles if cycles > 0 else -1
        execute = self._execute
        advance = self._advance
        while True:
            if self.halted:
                break
            if self.idle:
                advance(1)
            else:
                self._poll_interrupts()
                advance(execute())
            executed += 1
            if target >= 0 and self.cycles >= target:
                break
            if executed >= 400_000_000:
                break
        return executed

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- execution
    def _execute(self) -> int:
        rom = self.rom
        pc = self.pc
        self.last_op = rom.byte(pc)
        trace = self.trace
        if trace is not None:
            if len(trace) < self.trace_limit:
                trace.append((pc, self.last_op, self.acc, self.psw,
                              self.sfr[SFR_SP], self.cycles))
            else:
                self.trace = None
        p = pc + 1
        op = self.last_op
        romb = rom.byte
        sfr = self.sfr
        ram = self.ram
        bus = self.bus
        # ---- decode/execute -------------------------------------------------
        if op == 0x00:                                              # NOP
            self.pc = p
            return 1
        # ================================ MOV A, #imm / direct / @Ri / Rn / R
        if op == 0x74:                                              # MOV A,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self.acc = romb(p)
            return 1
        if op == 0xE5:                                              # MOV A,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            if addr == SFR_ACC:
                pass
            elif addr < 0x80:
                self.acc = ram[addr]
            elif SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
                self.acc = self._port_read((addr - SFR_P0) >> 4)
            elif addr == SFR_SBUF:
                self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
            else:
                self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if op == 0xF5:                                              # MOV direct,A
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 1
        if op == 0xE4:                                              # CLR A
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = 0
            return 1
        if op == 0xF4:                                              # CPL A
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ 0xFF
            return 1
        if op in (0xE6, 0xE7):                                      # MOV A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if op in (0xF6, 0xF7):                                      # MOV @Ri,A
            self.pc = p
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
            return 1
        if op in (0x76, 0x77):                                      # MOV @Ri,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = romb(p)
            return 1
        if 0xE8 <= op <= 0xEF:                                      # MOV A,Rn
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = self._r(op & 7)
            self.set_p()
            return 1
        if 0xF8 <= op <= 0xFF:                                      # MOV Rn,A
            self.pc = p
            self._set_r(op & 7, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 1
        if 0x78 <= op <= 0x7F:                                      # MOV Rn,#imm
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._set_r(op & 7, romb(p))
            return 1
        if 0xA8 <= op <= 0xAF:                                      # MOV Rn,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._set_r(op & 7, self._dir_read(romb(p)))
            return 1
        if 0x88 <= op <= 0x8F:                                      # MOV direct,Rn
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), self._r(op & 7))
            return 1
        if op == 0x85:                                             # MOV direct,direct
            self.pc = p + 2
            src = romb(p)
            dst = romb(p + 1)
            self._dir_write(dst, self._dir_read(src))
            return 2
        if op == 0x75:                                             # MOV direct,#imm
            self.pc = p + 2
            self._dir_write(romb(p), romb(p + 1))
            return 2
        if op in (0x86, 0x87):                                     # MOV direct,@Ri
            self.pc = p + 1
            self._dir_write(romb(p), ram[self._ri(op & 1)])
            return 2
        if op in (0xA6, 0xA7):                                     # MOV @Ri,direct
            self.pc = p + 1
            ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self._dir_read(romb(p))
            return 2
        if op == 0x90:                                             # MOV DPTR,#imm16
            self.pc = p + 2
            self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = romb(p)
            self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = romb(p + 1)
            return 2
        # ============================== MOVC / MOVX
        if op == 0x93:                                             # MOVC A,@A+DPTR
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + self.dptr) & 0xFFFF)
            return 2
        if op == 0x83:                                             # MOVC A,@A+PC
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + p) & 0xFFFF)
            return 2
        if op in (0xE2, 0xE3):                                     # MOVX A,@Ri
            self.pc = p
            addr = self._ri(op & 1)
            if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
                addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
            self.acc = bus.ext_read(addr) & 0xFF
            self.set_p()
            return 2
        if op in (0xF2, 0xF3):                                     # MOVX @Ri,A
            self.pc = p
            addr = self._ri(op & 1)
            self._ext_write_banked(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
            return 2
        if op == 0xE0:                                             # MOVX A,@DPTR
            self.pc = p

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- helper ops
    def _ext_write_banked(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
            addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
        self.bus.ext_write(addr, value)

    def _add(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        result = a + operand + (1 if carry_in else 0)
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0
        if ((a & 0x0F) + (operand & 0x0F) + (1 if carry_in else 0)) > 0x0F:
            psw |= 0x40
        if result > 0xFF:
            psw |= 0x80
        value = result & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
        if (a ^ value) & (operand ^ value) & 0x80:
            psw |= 0x04
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]

    def _sub(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        borrow_in = 1 if carry_in else 0
        result = a - operand - borrow_in
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0
        if ((a & 0x0F) - (operand & 0x0F) - borrow_in) < 0:
            psw |= 0x40
        if result < 0:
            psw |= 0x80
        value = result & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
        if (a ^ operand) & (a ^ value) & 0x80:
            psw |= 0x04
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]

    def _cjne(self, left: int, right: int) -> None:
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
        if left != right:
            psw |= 0x80
        if left < right:
            psw |= 0x80
        else:
            psw &= 0x7F
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw

    def _inc_family(self, op: int, p: int, romb) -> int:
        if op == 0x04:
            self.pc = p
            self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + 1) & 0xFF
            return 1
        if op == 0x05:
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            self._dir_write(addr, (self._dir_read(addr) + 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        self.pc = p
        ri = self._ri(op & 1)
        self.ram[ri] = (self.ram[ri] + 1) & 0xFF
        return 1

    def _dec_family(self, op: int, p: int, romb) -> int:
        if op == 0x15:
            self.pc = p + 1
            addr = romb(p)
            self._dir_write(addr, (self._dir_read(addr) - 1) & 0xFF)
            return 1
        self.pc = p
        ri = self._ri(op & 1)
        self.ram[ri] = (self.ram[ri] - 1) & 0xFF
        return 1

    def _da(self, cycles: int) -> int:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW]
        carry = psw & 0x80
        if (a & 0x0F) > 9 or (psw & 0x40):
            a += 6
        if ((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] >> 4) > 9) or carry or (a > 0xFF):
            a += 0x60
            carry = 0x80
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a & 0xFF
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = (psw & 0x7F) | carry
        self.set_p()
        return cycles

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------- bits
    def _bit_addr(self, bit: int):
        if bit < 0x80:
            byte = (bit >> 3) + 0x20
            mask = 1 << (bit & 7)
            return byte, mask, False
        byte = bit & 0xF8
        mask = 1 << (bit & 7)
        if byte == SFR_P0 or byte == SFR_P1 or byte == SFR_P2 or byte == SFR_P3:
            return byte, mask, True
        return byte, mask, False

    def _bit(self, bit: int) -> int:
        byte, mask, is_port = self._bit_addr(bit)
        if is_port:
            return 1 if (self._port_read((byte - SFR_P0) >> 4) & mask) else 0
        if byte < 0x80:
            return 1 if (self.ram[byte] & mask) else 0
        return 1 if (self.sfr[byte] & mask) else 0

    def _bit_write(self, bit: int, value: int) -> None:
        byte, mask, is_port = self._bit_addr(bit)
        if is_port:
            port = (byte - SFR_P0) >> 4
            latch = self._port_latch[port]
            latch = (latch | mask) if value else (latch & ~mask & 0xFF)
            self._port_latch[port] = latch
            self.sfr[byte] = latch
            self.bus.port_write(port, latch)
            return
        if byte < 0x80:
            if value:
                self.ram[byte] |= mask
            else:
                self.ram[byte] &= ~mask & 0xFF
            return
        if value:
            self.sfr[byte] |= mask
        else:
            self.sfr[byte] &= ~mask & 0xFF
        if byte == SFR_SBUF:
            self.bus.serial_write(self.sfr[byte])
        if byte == SFR_P0 or byte == SFR_P1 or byte == SFR_P2 or byte == SFR_P3:
            pass

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ diagnostics
    def state(self) -> dict:
        s = self.sfr
        return {
            "pc": self.pc,
            "op": self.last_op,
            "acc": s[SFR_ACC],
            "b": s[SFR_B],
            "psw": s[SFR_PSW],
            "sp": s[SFR_SP],
            "dptr": self.dptr,
            "p0": self._port_latch[0],
            "p1": self._port_latch[1],
            "p2": self._port_latch[2],
            "p3": self._port_latch[3],
            "cycles": self.cycles,
            "ops": self.op_count,
            "in_isr": self.in_isr,
            "error": self.error,
        }


def _signed(byte: int) -> int:
    return byte - 256 if byte > 127 else byte

content.arguments:
{"content": """"Run the cash-register firmware and report what it does.

Examples
--------
    python tools/inspect_rom.py trace --cycles 3000000
    python tools/inspect_rom.py trace --cycles 500000 --watch 0x0000-0x000F
    python tools/inspect_rom.py disasm 0x8000 60
    python tools/inspect_rom.py vectors
    python tools/inspect_rom.py histogram --cycles 5000000
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import collections
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from m8051 import CPU8051, ROM  # noqa: E402
from m8051.bus import HardwareBus  # noqa: E402
from tools.disasm import disassemble_one  # noqa: E402

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
DEFAULT_ROM = os.path.join(HERE, "firmware", "nm27c512n.hex")


class TraceBus(HardwareBus):
    """Records every access and reactivates peripherals from the firmware."""

    def __init__(self, watch=()) -> None:
        self.port_writes = collections.Counter()
        self.port_edges = collections.Counter()
        self.ext_writes = collections.Counter()
        self.ext_reads = collections.Counter()
        self.serial = []
        self.events = []
        self.watch = set(watch)
        self._port_state = [0xFF] * 4
        self.tick_cycles = 0
        # a 8255 PPI: control word at ext address 3, ports 0..2
        self.ppi_control = 0
        self.ppi_ports = [0, 0, 0]

    def tick(self, cycles: int) -> None:
        self.tick_cycles += cycles

    def ext_read(self, addr: int, code: bool = False) -> int:
        self.ext_reads[addr] += 1
        if addr < 4:
            if addr == 3:
                return self.ppi_control
            return self.ppi_ports[addr]
        return 0xFF

    def ext_write(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
        self.ext_writes[addr] += 1
        if addr < 4:
            if addr == 3:
                self.ppi_control = value
            else:
                self.ppi_ports[addr] = value
            self.events.append((self.tick_cycles, "ppi", addr, value))
        elif addr in self.watch:
            self.events.append((self.tick_cycles, "ext", addr, value))

    def ext_probe(self, addr: int) -> bool:
        return addr < 4

    def port_read(self, port: int) -> int:
        return 0xFF

    def port_write(self, port: int, value: int) -> None:
        self.port_writes[port] += 1
        old = self._port_state[port]
        if old != value:
            self.port_edges[port] += 1
            self.events.append((self.tick_cycles, f"P{port}", old, value))
        self._port_state[port] = value

    def serial_write(self, byte: int) -> None:
        self.serial.append(byte)


def build_rom(path: str) -> ROM:
    rom = ROM(os.path.basename(path)).load_file(path)
    return rom


def cmd_vectors(rom: ROM) -> None:
    print(f"ROM {rom.name}: {len(rom)} bytes, coverage {rom.coverage()}")
    names = ["EXT0", "T0", "EXT1", "T1", "SERIAL", "T2", "PCA", "LVD", "SPI", "UART1"]
    for i, vec in enumerate((0x03, 0x0B, 0x13, 0x1B, 0x23, 0x2B, 0x33, 0x3B, 0x43, 0x4B)):
        target = rom.word(vec - 3) if False else rom.word(vec)
        src = vec - 3
        text, _ = disassemble_one(rom, src)
        print(f"  {src:04X}: {text:<24} -> handler {target:04X}h   {names[i] if i < len(names) else ''}")


def cmd_disasm(rom: ROM, args) -> None:
    from tools.disasm import walk

    start = int(args.start, 0)
    count = args.count
    for i, (pc, text, length) in enumerate(walk(rom, start, start + 0x10000, count)):
        raw = rom.get_slice(pc, length).hex().upper()
        print(f"{pc:04X}  {raw:<9} {text}")


def cmd_trace(rom: ROM, args) -> None:
    bus = TraceBus()
    cpu = CPU8051(rom, bus)
    cpu.run(args.cycles)
    print(f"executed {cpu.op_count} instructions, {cpu.cycles} machine cycles "
          f"({cpu.cycles / 1e6:.3f} s @12MHz), error={cpu.error}")
    print(f"PC={cpu.pc:04X} A={cpu.acc:02X} PSW={cpu.psw:02X} SP={cpu.sp:02X} DPTR={cpu.dptr:04X}")
    print(f"P0={bus._port_state[0]:02X} P1={bus._port_state[1]:02X} "
          f"P2={bus._port_state[2]:02X} P3={bus._port_state[3]:02X}")
    print("--- port writes ---")
    total = 0
    for port in range(4):
        if bus.port_writes[port]:
            total += bus.port_writes[port]
            print(f"  P{port}: {bus.port_writes[port]} writes, {bus.port_edges[port]} edges")
    print(f"  total {total}")
    print("--- external writes (top 25) ---")
    for addr, count in bus.ext_writes.most_common(25):
        print(f"  {addr:04X}h: {count}")
    print("--- external reads (top 25) ---")
    for addr, count in bus.ext_reads.most_common(25):
        print(f"  {addr:04X}h: {count}")
    if bus.serial:
        text = "".join(chr(b) if 32 <= b < 127 else f"\\x{b:02x}" for b in bus.serial[:400])
        print(f"--- serial out ({len(bus.serial)} bytes) ---\n  {text}")
    if args.events:
        print("--- last 60 events ---")
        for ev in bus.events[-60:]:
            print("  ", ev)


def cmd_histogram(rom: ROM, args) -> None:
    bus = TraceBus()
    cpu = CPU8051(rom, bus)
    counts = collections.Counter()
    block = 0x100
    steps = 0
    while cpu.cycles < args.cycles and cpu.error is None:
        counts[cpu.pc & ~(block - 1)] += 1
        cpu.step()
        steps += 1
    print(f"{steps} instructions, {cpu.cycles} cycles, error={cpu.error}")
    for base, count in counts.most_common(30):
        print(f"  {base:04X}-{base + block - 1:04X}: {count}")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--rom", default=DEFAULT_ROM)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    sub.add_parser("vectors")
    p = sub.add_parser("disasm")
    p.add_argument("start", nargs="?", default="0x8000")
    p.add_argument("count", nargs="?", type=int, default=60)
    p = sub.add_parser("trace")
    p.add_argument("--cycles", type=int, default=2_000_000)
    p.add_argument("--events", action="store_true")
    p = sub.add_parser("histogram")
    p.add_argument("--cycles", type=int, default=2_000_000)

    args = ap.parse_args()
    rom = build_rom(args.rom)
    if args.cmd == "vectors":
        cmd_vectors(rom)
    elif args.cmd == "disasm":
        cmd_disasm(rom, args)
    elif args.cmd == "trace":
        cmd_trace(rom, args)
    elif args.cmd == "histogram":
        cmd_histogram(rom, args)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

content.text:
Need to check if the two firmware images overlap by comparing their byte patterns, noting that the first image starts with `02 0A 06` while the second begins with `02 DD 67`, and investigate the shifted text in the second image around 0x106B showing "Copyright(C)Versia".I'm going to spawn two teammates in parallel: one to reverse-engineer the I/O hardware from the decompiled C and trace ROM accesses to produce a documentation file plus the hardware abstraction layer, and another to build a Tkinter GUI with a classic 3D button aesthetic on a dark background that hooks into a display/keyboard/printer contract. I'll keep the core board implementation, tools, and final assembly to myself since the HAL has a clean interface boundary. The main risk is that their reverse-engineering output might not be accurate, but I can validate their findings myself once they deliver.

For the bus API, I'm defining a HardwareBus class with methods for maintaining port latch state, simulating external memory reads/writes, managing display buffers and keyboard matrix state, and exposing callbacks for test harnesses to inject key events and query screen content.

The board module will house both the PPI chip and virtual peripheral devices (display, keyboard, printer), keeping hardware modeling separate from the UI layer. The GUI will operate on generic interfaces rather than concrete implementations, with the board pushing screen updates and key events to the UI through a host application that manages the threading and binds the keyboard controls.

Defining the interface contract... I need to clarify the scope: the display models handle the rendering logic and return pixel data to the GUI, while the printer model provides the printed receipt through a simple interface. I'm deciding how to split the models between the board teammate and the GUI teammate — the models should live in board/, but that creates a boundary issue if I'm assigning board/ to one person and ui/ to another.

Looking at the actual dependencies, teammate B needs to start with its own interfaces and can use a stub implementation for testing while waiting for A's HAL findings, then wire everything together once A delivers.

I'll spawn both teammates with clear instructions: A focuses on reverse-engineering the port mapping and building the virtual hardware models in isolation (testable without the GUI), documenting everything in a shared interface spec. B builds the Tkinter UI with a receiver protocol so it can develop against my mock display while waiting for A's actual board implementation. I'll handle the wiring and integration.

But the CPU is the critical path—if it has bugs, everything fails. I need a comprehensive test suite that validates against real firmware traces; if the emulator executes the ROM and displays the expected output, that's strong evidence the CPU implementation is correct. I'll write those tests and spawn the teammates now.

For performance, I'm making the `advance()` method in the CPU smarter about when to call the bus tick function. Instead of firing every instruction, I'll accumulate cycles and only call tick when either the timer is running or a peripheral actually needs it. The challenge is knowing when peripherals require ticks—I'll add a flag the bus can set to indicate whether it needs cycle-by-cycle notification, so we skip the overhead when it's not necessary.

I'll also add a `batch_tick` method to the bus so peripherals can be notified less frequently of the total accumulated cycles. But first, let me benchmark the current implementation to see if optimization is even necessary.
Let me benchmark the core before optimizing, then brief the team.

"", "description": "Benchmark emulator speed"}

instr 1999934 cycles 2000000 wall 7.94s instr/s 0.25M cycles/s 0.25M
pc 0x1988 err None

We need to address the performance issue at 0.25M cycles/s, which is 4x slower than needed for a 12MHz processor requiring 1M cycles/s; investigate the jump to unmapped memory at 0x1988 (all 0xFF), causing an infinite loop; and focus optimization efforts on the SFR side-effects and peripheral handling.The `_advance` method calls `self.bus.tick(cycles)` on every instruction, and for NullBus that's just a Python function call overhead (~0.1µs), but with 2M instructions that's still significant. More critically, the timer logic runs every single instruction even when timers are inactive, and the serial receive check attempts to call `serial_read()` constantly. I should conditionally skip all this work when timers and serial aren't active. I can also cache commonly used attributes like `psw` and `acc` as direct integer slots instead of SFR array lookups, which should cut a lot of overhead. Implementing optimization C first for the biggest win—only triggering `_advance` when peripherals actually need it—then tackling B for the common case, and finally A if there's time. I'll start with a quick patch to the hot path, then benchmark whether threading makes per-frame rendering viable, since Python's global interpreter lock means the emulator step loop will block the UI thread for 100-200ms per frame. With tkinter's 60fps frame rate and 1M cycles per second, that's roughly 20k cycles per frame—manageable but still noticeable.

The real solution is running the emulator in a separate process and using a queue to exchange framebuffer snapshots and key events, letting multiprocessing parallelize across cores and keep the UI responsive. A pure Python implementation can't realistically hit the performance targets without significant optimization, so I'll focus on the most impactful architectural changes: caching SFR values in attributes and skipping peripheral work when those features are disabled. Then I'll measure the actual speed and either accept the result or escalate to generated code if needed.
