We need to optimize the hot path by restructuring `_advance` to batch peripherals and refining the stepping logic to only do necessary work; avoid caching the accumulator separately since it must stay synchronized with the SFR byte at 0xE0.I'm going to precompute and cache a few boolean flags—whether timers are running, whether serial receive is enabled, and whether the watchdog is active—so I can skip the expensive checks in the fast path. These flags get updated whenever the relevant SFRs change or during reset, and I'll keep the per-instruction dispatch lean by only calling the full check when absolutely needed. This means tracking about five cached booleans to avoid redundant work on every instruction.

I'm also planning to swap the interrupt polling logic to use these cached flags instead of recomputing them each time, and I'll add a `peripheral_batch` counter so boards can batch their tick calls rather than firing on every single instruction cycle.

410:         if self.wd_enabled:
411:             self.watchdog += cycles
412:             if self.watchdog > 0x20000:
413:                 self.watchdog = 0
414: 
415:     # ------------------------------------------------------------ interrupts
416:     def _poll_interrupts(self) -> None:
417:         ie = self.sfr[SFR_IE]
418:         if not (ie & 0x80):            # EA
419:             return
420:         pending = 0
421:         tcon = self.sfr[SFR_TCON]
422:         if tcon & TCON_IE0:
423:             pending |= IRQ_INT0
424:         if tcon & TCON_TF0:
425:             pending |= IRQ_T0
426:         if tcon & TCON_IE1:
427:             pending |= IRQ_INT1
428:         if tcon & TCON_TF1:
429:             pending |= IRQ_T1
430:         if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_RI:
431:             pending |= IRQ_RX
432:         if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_TI:
433:             pending |= IRQ_TX
434:         pending |= self.bus.irq_requested()
435:         pending &= 0xFF
436:         if not pending:
437:             return
438:         ip = self.sfr[SFR_IP]
439:         chosen = -1
440:         chosen_pri = -1
441:         for bit, irq in zip(range(6), _VEC_IRQ):
442:             if not (pending & irq):
443:                 continue
444:             if not (ie & irq):
445:                 continue
446:             if (ip & irq) and self.irq_level and irq != self.irq_level:
447:                 continue
448:             pri = 1 if (ip & irq) else 0
449:             if pri > chosen_pri:
450:                 chosen_pri = pri
451:                 chosen = bit
452:         if chosen < 0:
453:             return
454:         irq = _VEC_IRQ[chosen]
455:         if irq == IRQ_T0:
456:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF0 & 0xFF
457:         elif irq == IRQ_T1:
458:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF1 & 0xFF
459:         elif irq == IRQ_INT0:
460:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE0 & 0xFF
461:         elif irq == IRQ_INT1:
462:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE1 & 0xFF
463:         elif irq == IRQ_RX:
464:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_RI & 0xFF
465:         elif irq == IRQ_TX:
466:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_TI & 0xFF
467:         self.irq_level = irq if (ip & irq) else 0
468:         self._advance(2)
469:         self.push_pc()
470:         self.pc = _VEC[chosen]
471: 
472:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------- step
473:     def step(self) -> int:
474:         """Execute one instruction.  Returns the machine cycles consumed."""
475:         if self.halted:
476:             return 1
477:         if self.idle:
478:             self._advance(1)
479:             return 1
480:         self._poll_interrupts()
481:         cycles = self._execute()
482:         self._advance(cycles)
483:         return cycles
484: 
485:     def run(self, cycles: int) -> int:
486:         """Run for at most ``cycles`` machine cycles (or forever if <= 0)."""
487:         executed = 0
488:         target = self.cycles + cycles if cycles > 0 else -1
489:         execute = self._execute
490:         advance = self._advance
491:         while True:
492:             if self.halted:
493:                 break
494:             if self.idle:
495:                 advance(1)
496:             else:
497:                 self._poll_interrupts()
498:                 advance(execute())
499:             executed += 1
500:             if target >= 0 and self.cycles >= target:
501:                 break
502:             if executed >= 400_000_000:
503:                 break
504:         return executed
505: 
506:     # --------------------------------------------------------------- execution
507:     def _execute(self) -> int:
508:         rom = self.rom
509:         pc = self.pc
510:         self.last_op = rom.byte(pc)
511:         trace = self.trace
512:         if trace is not None:
513:             if len(trace) < self.trace_limit:
514:                 trace.append((pc, self.last_op, self.acc, self.psw,
515:                               self.sfr[SFR_SP], self.cycles))
516:             else:
517:                 self.trace = None
518:         p = pc + 1
519:         op = self.last_op
520:         romb = rom.byte
521:         sfr = self.sfr
522:         ram = self.ram
523:         bus = self.bus
524:         # ---- decode/execute -------------------------------------------------
525:         if op == 0x00:                                              # NOP
526:             self.pc = p
527:             return 1
528:         # ================================ MOV A, #imm / direct / @Ri / Rn / R
529:         if op == 0x74:                                              # MOV A,#imm
530:             self.pc = p + 1
531:             self.acc = romb(p)
532:             return 1
533:         if op == 0xE5:                                              # MOV A,direct
534:             self.pc = p + 1
535:             addr = romb(p)
536:             if addr == SFR_ACC:
537:                 pass
538:             elif addr < 0x80:
539:                 self.acc = ram[addr]
540:             elif SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
541:                 self.acc = self._port_read((addr - SFR_P0) >> 4)
542:             elif addr == SFR_SBUF:
543:                 self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
544:             else:
545:                 self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
546:             self.set_p()
547:             return 1
548:         if op == 0xF5:                                              # MOV direct,A
549:             self.pc = p + 1
550:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
551:             return 1
552:         if op == 0xE4:                                              # CLR A
553:             self.pc = p
554:             self.acc = 0
555:             return 1
556:         if op == 0xF4:                                              # CPL A
557:             self.pc = p
558:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ 0xFF
559:             return 1
560:         if op in (0xE6, 0xE7):                                      # MOV A,@Ri
561:             self.pc = p
562:             self.acc = ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
563:             self.set_p()
564:             return 1
565:         if op in (0xF6, 0xF7):                                      # MOV @Ri,A
566:             self.pc = p
567:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
568:             return 1
569:         if op in (0x76, 0x77):                                      # MOV @Ri,#imm
570:             self.pc = p + 1
571:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = romb(p)
572:             return 1
573:         if 0xE8 <= op <= 0xEF:                                      # MOV A,Rn
574:             self.pc = p
575:             self.acc = self._r(op & 7)
576:             self.set_p()
577:             return 1
578:         if 0xF8 <= op <= 0xFF:                                      # MOV Rn,A
579:             self.pc = p
580:             self._set_r(op & 7, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
581:             return 1
582:         if 0x78 <= op <= 0x7F:                                      # MOV Rn,#imm
583:             self.pc = p + 1
584:             self._set_r(op & 7, romb(p))
585:             return 1
586:         if 0xA8 <= op <= 0xAF:                                      # MOV Rn,direct
587:             self.pc = p + 1
588:             self._set_r(op & 7, self._dir_read(romb(p)))
589:             return 1
590:         if 0x88 <= op <= 0x8F:                                      # MOV direct,Rn
591:             self.pc = p + 1
592:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self._r(op & 7))
593:             return 1
594:         if op == 0x85:                                             # MOV direct,direct
595:             self.pc = p + 2
596:             src = romb(p)
597:             dst = romb(p + 1)
598:             self._dir_write(dst, self._dir_read(src))
599:             return 2
600:         if op == 0x75:                                             # MOV direct,#imm
601:             self.pc = p + 2
602:             self._dir_write(romb(p), romb(p + 1))
603:             return 2
604:         if op in (0x86, 0x87):                                     # MOV direct,@Ri
605:             self.pc = p + 1
606:             self._dir_write(romb(p), ram[self._ri(op & 1)])
607:             return 2
608:         if op in (0xA6, 0xA7):                                     # MOV @Ri,direct
609:             self.pc = p + 1
610:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self._dir_read(romb(p))
611:             return 2
612:         if op == 0x90:                                             # MOV DPTR,#imm16
613:             self.pc = p + 2
614:             self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = romb(p)
615:             self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = romb(p + 1)
616:             return 2
617:         # ============================== MOVC / MOVX
618:         if op == 0x93:                                             # MOVC A,@A+DPTR
619:             self.pc = p
620:             self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + self.dptr) & 0xFFFF)
621:             return 2
622:         if op == 0x83:                                             # MOVC A,@A+PC
623:             self.pc = p
624:             self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + p) & 0xFFFF)
625:             return 2
626:         if op in (0xE2, 0xE3):                                     # MOVX A,@Ri
627:             self.pc = p
628:             addr = self._ri(op & 1)
629:             if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
630:                 addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
631:             self.acc = bus.ext_read(addr) & 0xFF
632:             self.set_p()
633:             return 2
634:         if op in (0xF2, 0xF3):                                     # MOVX @Ri,A
635:             self.pc = p
636:             addr = self._ri(op & 1)
637:             self._ext_write_banked(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
638:             return 2
639:         if op == 0xE0:                                             # MOVX A,@DPTR
640:             self.pc = p
641:             self.acc = bus.ext_read(self.dptr) & 0xFF
642:             self.set_p()
643:             return 2
644:         if op == 0xF0:                                             # MOVX @DPTR,A
645:             self.pc = p
646:             bus.ext_write(self.dptr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
647:             return 2
648:         if op == 0xA3:                                             # INC DPTR
649:             self.pc = p
650:             self.dptr = (self.dptr + 1) & 0xFFFF
651:             return 2
652:         # =============================================================== ADD
653:         if op == 0x24:                                             # ADD A,#imm
654:             self.pc = p + 1
655:             self._add(romb(p), 0)
656:             return 1
657:         if op == 0x25:                                             # ADD A,direct
658:             self.pc = p + 1
659:             self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), 0)
660:             return 1
661:         if op in (0x26, 0x27):                                     # ADD A,@Ri
662:             self.pc = p
663:             self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], 0)
664:             return 1
665:         if 0x28 <= op <= 0x2F:                                     # ADD A,Rn
666:             self.pc = p
667:             self._add(self._r(op & 7), 0)
668:             return 1
669:         if op == 0x34:                                             # ADDC A,#imm
670:             self.pc = p + 1
671:             self._add(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
672:             return 1
673:         if op == 0x35:                                             # ADDC A,direct
674:             self.pc = p + 1
675:             self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
676:             return 1
677:         if op in (0x36, 0x37):
678:             self.pc = p
679:             self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
680:             return 1
681:         if 0x38 <= op <= 0x3F:
682:             self.pc = p
683:             self._add(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
684:             return 1
685:         # =============================================================== SUBB
686:         if op == 0x94:
687:             self.pc = p + 1
688:             self._sub(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
689:             return 1
690:         if op == 0x95:
691:             self.pc = p + 1
692:             self._sub(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
693:             return 1
694:         if op in (0x96, 0x97):
695:             self.pc = p
696:             self._sub(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
697:             return 1
698:         if 0x98 <= op <= 0x9F:
699:             self.pc = p
700:             self._sub(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
701:             return 1
702:         # ================================================================ INC
703:         if op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):
704:             return self._inc_family(op, p, romb)
705:         if 0x08 <= op <= 0x0F:                                     # INC Rn
706:             self.pc = p
707:             n = op & 7
708:             self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) + 1) & 0xFF)
709:             return 1
710:         if op == 0x14:                                             # DEC A
711:             self.pc = p
712:             self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] - 1) & 0xFF
713:             return 1
714:         if op in (0x15, 0x16, 0x17):
715:             return self._dec_family(op, p, romb)
716:         if 0x18 <= op <= 0x1F:                                     # DEC Rn
717:             self.pc = p
718:             n = op & 7
719:             self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF)
720:             return 1
721:         # ================================================================ MUL/DIV
722:         if op == 0xA4:                                             # MUL AB
723:             self.pc = p
724:             result = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] * self.sfr[SFR_B]
725:             self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = result & 0xFF
726:             self.sfr[SFR_B] = (result >> 8) & 0xFF
727:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
728:             if result > 0xFF:
729:                 psw |= 0x04
730:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
731:             self.set_p()
732:             return 4
733:         if op == 0x84:                                             # DIV AB
734:             self.pc = p
735:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
736:             b = self.sfr[SFR_B]
737:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
738:             if b == 0:
739:                 psw |= 0x04
740:             else:
741:                 self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a // b
742:                 self.sfr[SFR_B] = a % b
743:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
744:             self.set_p()
745:             return 4
746:         # ========================================================== logical ops
747:         if op == 0x54:                                             # ANL A,#imm
748:             self.pc = p + 1
749:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & romb(p)
750:             return 1
751:         if op == 0x55:
752:             self.pc = p + 1
753:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._dir_read(romb(p))
754:             return 1
755:         if op in (0x56, 0x57):
756:             self.pc = p
757:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
758:             return 1
759:         if 0x58 <= op <= 0x5F:
760:             self.pc = p
761:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._r(op & 7)
762:             return 1
763:         if op == 0x44:                                             # ORL A,#imm
764:             self.pc = p + 1
765:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | romb(p)
766:             return 1
767:         if op == 0x45:
768:             self.pc = p + 1
769:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._dir_read(romb(p))
770:             return 1
771:         if op in (0x46, 0x47):
772:             self.pc = p
773:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
774:             return 1
775:         if 0x48 <= op <= 0x4F:
776:             self.pc = p
777:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._r(op & 7)
778:             return 1
779:         if op == 0x64:                                             # XRL A,#imm
780:             self.pc = p + 1
781:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ romb(p)
782:             return 1
783:         if op == 0x65:
784:             self.pc = p + 1
785:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._dir_read(romb(p))
786:             return 1
787:         if op in (0x66, 0x67):
788:             self.pc = p
789:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
790:             return 1
791:         if 0x68 <= op <= 0x6F:
792:             self.pc = p
793:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._r(op & 7)
794:             return 1
795:         # ANL/ORL/XRL direct,A and direct,#imm
796:         if op in (0x52, 0x53):
797:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x52 else 2)
798:             addr = romb(p)
799:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x52 else romb(p + 1)
800:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) & operand)
801:             return 1 if op == 0x52 else 2
802:         if op in (0x42, 0x43):
803:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x42 else 2)
804:             addr = romb(p)
805:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x42 else romb(p + 1)
806:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) | operand)
807:             return 1 if op == 0x42 else 2
808:         if op in (0x62, 0x63):
809:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x62 else 2)
810:             addr = romb(p)
811:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x62 else romb(p + 1)
812:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) ^ operand)
813:             return 1 if op == 0x62 else 2
814:         # =========================================================== rotates
815:         if op == 0x03:                                             # RR A
816:             self.pc = p
817:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
818:             self.acc = (a >> 1) | ((a & 1) << 7)
819:             return 1
820:         if op == 0x13:                                             # RRC A
821:             self.pc = p
822:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
823:             carry = 0x80 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
824:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
825:             if a & 1:
826:                 psw |= 0x80
827:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
828:             self.acc = (a >> 1) | carry
829:             return 1
830:         if op == 0x23:                                             # RL A
831:             self.pc = p
832:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
833:             self.acc = ((a << 1) | (a >> 7)) & 0xFF
834:             return 1
835:         if op == 0x33:                                             # RLC A
836:             self.pc = p
837:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
838:             carry_in = 1 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
839:             result = (a << 1) | carry_in
840:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
841:             if result > 0xFF:
842:                 psw |= 0x80
843:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
844:             self.acc = result & 0xFF
845:             return 1
846:         if op == 0xC4:                                             # SWAP A
847:             self.pc = p
848:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
849:             self.acc = ((a << 4) | (a >> 4)) & 0xFF
850:             return 1
851:         if op in (0xD4,):                                          # DA A
852:             self.pc = p
853:             return self._da(1)
854:         # ========================================================= XCH / XCHD
855:         if op == 0xC5:
856:             self.pc = p + 1
857:             addr = romb(p)
858:             tmp = self._dir_read(addr)
859:             self._dir_write(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
860:             self.acc = tmp
861:             return 1
862:         if op in (0xC6, 0xC7):
863:             self.pc = p
864:             ri = self._ri(op & 1)
865:             tmp = ram[ri]
866:             ram[ri] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
867:             self.acc = tmp
868:             self.set_p()
869:             return 1
870:         if 0xC8 <= op <= 0xCF:
871:             self.pc = p
872:             n = op & 7
873:             tmp = self._r(n)
874:             self._set_r(n, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
875:             self.acc = tmp
876:             return 1
877:         if op in (0xD6, 0xD7):                                     # XCHD A,@Ri
878:             self.pc = p
879:             ri = self._ri(op & 1)
880:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
881:             ram[ri] = (ram[ri] & 0xF0) | (a & 0x0F)
882:             self.acc = (a & 0xF0) | (ram[ri] & 0x0F)
883:             return 1
884:         # ================================================================ PUSH/POP
885:         if op == 0xC0:
886:             self.pc = p + 1
887:             self.push(self._dir_read(romb(p)))
888:             return 2
889:         if op == 0xD0:
890:             self.pc = p + 1
891:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self.pop())
892:             return 2
893:         # ============================================================== branches
894:         if op == 0x02:                                             # LJMP
895:             self.pc = romb(p) << 8 | romb(p + 1)
896:             return 2
897:         if op == 0x12:                                             # LCALL
898:             target = romb(p) << 8 | romb(p + 1)
899:             self.pc = p + 2
900:             self.push_pc()
901:             self.pc = target
902:             return 2
903:         if op == 0x22:                                             # RET
904:             self.pop_pc()
905:             return 2
906:         if op == 0x32:                                             # RETI
907:             self.pop_pc()
908:             self.irq_level = 0
909:             return 2
910:         if op in (0x01, 0x21, 0x41, 0x61, 0x81, 0xA1, 0xC1, 0xE1):  # AJMP
911:             page = (p & 0xF800)
912:             target = page | ((op >> 5) << 8) | romb(p)
913:             self.pc = target
914:             return 2
915:         if op == 0x80:                                             # SJMP
916:             self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
917:             return 2
918:         if op == 0x40:                                             # JC
919:             self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if (sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else p + 1
920:             return 2
921:         if op == 0x50:                                             # JNC
922:             self.pc = p + 1 if (sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
923:             return 2
924:         if op == 0x60:                                             # JZ
925:             self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if self.sfr[SFR_ACC] == 0 else p + 1
926:             return 2
927:         if op == 0x70:                                             # JNZ
928:             self.pc = p + 1 if self.sfr[SFR_ACC] == 0 else (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
929:             return 2
930:         if op == 0xB4:                                             # CJNE A,#imm,rel
931:             self.pc = p + 2
932:             self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], romb(p))
933:             if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
934:                 self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
935:             return 2
936:         if op == 0xB5:                                             # CJNE A,direct,rel
937:             self.pc = p + 2
938:             self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], self._dir_read(romb(p)))
939:             if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:

94:                0x80, 0x90, 0xA0, 0xB0, 0xC0, 0xD0, 0xE0, 0xF0):  # bit + rel
95:         ln[op] = 3
96:     ln[0x30] = 3
97:     for op in (0xB6, 0xB7, 0xBE, 0xBF, 0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7,
98:                0xDE, 0xDF, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xEE, 0xEF, 0xF6, 0xF7,
99:                0xFE, 0xFF, 0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27,
100:                0x36, 0x37, 0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67,
101:                0x76, 0x77):

103:     for op in (0x86, 0x87, 0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7,
104:                0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7,
105:                0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27, 0x36, 0x37,
106:                0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67, 0x76, 0x77):
107:         ln[op] = 1
108:     for op in (0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7, 0xC6, 0xC7,
109:                0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7):  # MOV @Ri,direct
110:         ln[op] = 2
111:     for op in (0xA6, 0xA7):  # MOV direct,@Ri
112:         ln[op] = 2
113:     for op in (0x85,):  # MOV direct,direct
114:         ln[op] = 3
115:     # DJNZ direct,rel
116:     ln[0xD5] = 3
117:     ln[0xB5] = 3
118:     ln[0xB4] = 3
119:     # cycle counts
120:     for op in (0x00,):
121:         cy[op] = 1
122:     for op in (0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x13, 0x14, 0x15, 0x23, 0x24, 0x25,
123:                0x33, 0x34, 0x35, 0x43, 0x44, 0x45, 0x53, 0x54, 0x55,
124:                0x63, 0x64, 0x65, 0x73, 0x74, 0x75, 0x83, 0x84, 0x85,
125:                0x93, 0x94, 0x95, 0xA3, 0xA4, 0xA5, 0xB3, 0xB4, 0xB5,
126:                0xC3, 0xC4, 0xC5, 0xD3, 0xD4, 0xD5, 0xE3, 0xE4, 0xE5,
127:                0xF3, 0xF4, 0xF5):
128:         cy[op] = 2
129:     for op in (0x06, 0x07, 0x16, 0x17, 0x26, 0x27, 0x36, 0x37,
130:                0x46, 0x47, 0x56, 0x57, 0x66, 0x67, 0x76, 0x77):
131:         cy[op] = 1
132:     for op in (0x86, 0x87, 0x96, 0x97, 0xA6, 0xA7, 0xB6, 0xB7,
133:                0xC6, 0xC7, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xF6, 0xF7):

135:     for op in (0x02, 0x12, 0x22, 0x32, 0x42, 0x52, 0x62, 0x72,
136:                0x82, 0x92, 0xA2, 0xB2, 0xC2, 0xD2, 0xE2, 0xF2):

139:                0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40, 0x50, 0x60, 0x70, 0x80,

143:                0xC0, 0xD0, 0xD5, 0xD6, 0xD7, 0xDE, 0xDF,
144:                0xE0, 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xEE, 0xEF, 0xF0, 0xF6, 0xF7, 0xFE, 0xFF):
145:         cy[op] = 2
146:     cy[0x10] = cy[0x20] = cy[0x30] = 2
147:     cy[0x40] = cy[0x50] = cy[0x60] = cy[0x70] = cy[0x80] = 2
148:     cy[0x90] = cy[0xA0] = cy[0xB0] = 2
149:     cy[0xC0] = cy[0xD0] = cy[0xE0] = cy[0xF0] = 2

152:     cy[0xA3] = cy[0x85] = cy[0x75] = 2

168: class CPU8051:
169:     """A 12-clocks-per-machine-cycle MCS-51 core."""
170: 
171:     __slots__ = (
172:         "rom", "bus", "ram", "sfr", "pc", "cycles", "halted", "error",
173:         "in_isr", "irq_level", "last_op", "trace", "trace_limit",
174:         "watchdog", "wd_enabled", "pll_locked", "op_count", "idle",
175:         "serial_in", "t2_running", "pca_running", "_port_latch",
176:         "timers_on", "_serial_rx", "_pending_tick",
177:     )
178: 
179:     def __init__(self, rom: ROM, bus: Optional[HardwareBus] = None) -> None:
180:         self.rom = rom
181:         self.bus: HardwareBus = bus if bus is not None else NullBus()
182:         self.ram = bytearray(256)          # internal RAM, banked + upper 128
183:         self.sfr = bytearray(256)          # SFR space (direct 0x80..0xFF)
184:         self.pc = 0
185:         self.cycles = 0                    # machine cycles since reset
186:         self.op_count = 0
187:         self.halted = False
188:         self.error: Optional[str] = None
189:         self.in_isr = 0
190:         self.irq_level = 0
191:         self.last_op = -1
192:         self.trace: Optional[List] = None
193:         self.trace_limit = 200_000
194:         self.watchdog = 0
195:         self.wd_enabled = False
196:         self.idle = False
197:         self.t2_running = False
198:         self.pca_running = False
199:         self._port_latch = bytearray(4)
200:         self.reset()
201: 
202:     # ------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
203:     def reset(self) -> None:
204:         self.ram[:] = b"\x00" * 256
205:         self.sfr[:] = b"\x00" * 256
206:         self.sfr[SFR_SP] = 0x07
207:         self.sfr[SFR_P0] = 0xFF
208:         self.sfr[SFR_P1] = 0xFF
209:         self.sfr[SFR_P2] = 0xFF
210:         self.sfr[SFR_P3] = 0xFF
211:         self.sfr[SFR_PCON] = 0x00
212:         self._port_latch[:] = b"\xff\xff\xff\xff"
213:         self.pc = 0
214:         self.cycles = 0
215:         self.op_count = 0
216:         self.halted = False
217:         self.error = None
218:         self.in_isr = 0
219:         self.irq_level = 0
220:         self.idle = False
221:         self.watchdog = 0
222:         self.wd_enabled = False
223: 
224:     # ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
225:     @property
226:     def acc(self) -> int:
227:         return self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
228: 
229:     @acc.setter
230:     def acc(self, value: int) -> None:
231:         self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value & 0xFF
232: 
233:     @property
234:     def psw(self) -> int:
235:         return self.sfr[SFR_PSW]
236: 
237:     @psw.setter
238:     def psw(self, value: int) -> None:
239:         self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = value & 0xFF
240: 
241:     def set_p(self) -> None:
242:         p = _PARITY[self.sfr[SFR_ACC]]
243:         self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE) | p
244: 
245:     @property
246:     def sp(self) -> int:
247:         return self.sfr[SFR_SP]
248: 
249:     @sp.setter
250:     def sp(self, value: int) -> None:
251:         self.sfr[SFR_SP] = value & 0xFF
252: 
253:     @property
254:     def dptr(self) -> int:
255:         return self.sfr[SFR_DPH] << 8 | self.sfr[SFR_DPL]
256: 
257:     @dptr.setter
258:     def dptr(self, value: int) -> None:
259:         self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
260:         self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = value & 0xFF
261: 
262:     # register bank helpers (indirect through PSW.RS0/RS1)
263:     def _r(self, n: int) -> int:
264:         return self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n]
265: 
266:     def _set_r(self, n: int, v: int) -> None:
267:         self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n] = v & 0xFF
268: 
269:     def _ri(self, n: int) -> int:
270:         """Address held in R0/R1 of the active bank."""
271:         return self.ram[((self.sfr[SFR_PSW] >> 3) & 3) * 8 + n]
272: 
273:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------- stack
274:     def push(self, value: int) -> None:
275:         sp = (self.sfr[SFR_SP] + 1) & 0xFF
276:         self.sfr[SFR_SP] = sp
277:         self.ram[sp] = value & 0xFF
278:         if sp <= 7:
279:             self.error = f"stack overflow (SP wrapped to 0x{sp:02X}) at PC=0x{self.pc:04X}"
280: 
281:     def pop(self) -> int:
282:         sp = self.sfr[SFR_SP]
283:         value = self.ram[sp]
284:         self.sfr[SFR_SP] = (sp - 1) & 0xFF
285:         return value
286: 
287:     def push_pc(self) -> None:
288:         pc = self.pc
289:         self.push(pc >> 8)
290:         self.push(pc & 0xFF)
291:         if self.in_isr < 8:
292:             self.in_isr += 1
293: 
294:     def pop_pc(self) -> None:
295:         high = self.pop()
296:         low = self.pop()
297:         self.pc = (high << 8) | low
298:         if self.in_isr:
299:             self.in_isr -= 1
300: 
301:     # ------------------------------------------------------------- direct/bit
302:     def _dir_read(self, addr: int) -> int:
303:         if addr < 0x80:
304:             return self.ram[addr]
305:         return self.sfr[addr]
306: 
307:     def _dir_write(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
308:         value &= 0xFF
309:         if addr < 0x80:
310:             self.ram[addr] = value
311:             return
312:         if addr == SFR_ACC:
313:             self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
314:             self.set_p()
315:             return
316:         if addr == SFR_PSW:
317:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = value
318:             return
319:         if SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
320:             # ports need pin/latch interaction
321:             port = (addr - SFR_P0) >> 4
322:             self._port_latch[port] = value
323:             self.sfr[addr] = value
324:             self.bus.port_write(port, value)
325:             return
326:         self.sfr[addr] = value
327:         if addr == SFR_SBUF:
328:             self.bus.serial_write(value)
329:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_TI
330:         self._sfr_side_effect(addr, value)
331: 
332:     def _port_read(self, port: int) -> int:
333:         """Read a port: latch AND external pin levels (quasi-bidirectional)."""
334:         return self._port_latch[port] & self.bus.port_read(port)
335: 
336:     def _sfr_side_effect(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
337:         if addr == SFR_WDTRST:
338:             self.watchdog = 0
339:         elif addr == SFR_WDTPRG:
340:             self.wd_enabled = True
341: 
342:     # -------------------------------------------------------------------- time
343:     def _advance(self, cycles: int) -> None:
344:         """Run timers/serial/peripherals for ``cycles`` machine cycles."""
345:         self.cycles += cycles
346:         self.op_count += 1
347:         if self.timers_on or self.wd_enabled or self._serial_rx:
348:             self._do_peripherals(cycles)
349:         elif self._pending_tick:
350:             self._pending_tick += cycles
351:             if self._pending_tick >= 32:
352:                 self.bus.tick(self._pending_tick)
353:                 self._pending_tick = 0
354:         else:
355:             self._pending_tick = cycles
356: 
357:     def _do_peripherals(self, cycles: int) -> None:
358:         bus = self.bus
359:         if self._pending_tick:
360:             bus.tick(self._pending_tick + cycles)
361:             self._pending_tick = 0
362:         else:
363:             bus.tick(cycles)
364:         sfr = self.sfr
365:         tmod = sfr[SFR_TMOD]
366:         tcon = sfr[SFR_TCON]
367:         if tcon & TCON_TR0:
368:             m = tmod & 0x03
369:             if m == 0:                       # 13-bit timer
370:                 value = ((sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
371:                 if value > 0x1FFF:
372:                     value &= 0x1FFF
373:                     tcon |= TCON_TF0
374:             elif m == 1:
375:                 value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
376:                 if value > 0xFFFF:
377:                     value &= 0xFFFF
378:                     tcon |= TCON_TF0
379:             else:
380:                 value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
381:                 if value > 0xFFFF:
382:                     value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | (value & 0xFF)
383:                     tcon |= TCON_TF0
384:             sfr[SFR_TH0] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
385:             sfr[SFR_TL0] = value & 0xFF
386:         if tcon & TCON_TR1:
387:             m = (tmod >> 4) & 0x03
388:             value = (sfr[SFR_TH1] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL1]) + cycles
389:             if m == 1:
390:                 if value > 0xFFFF:
391:                     value &= 0xFFFF
392:                     tcon |= TCON_TF1
393:             elif m == 2:
394:                 if value > 0xFF:
395:                     value = sfr[SFR_TH1]
396:                     tcon |= TCON_TF1
397:             else:
398:                 value &= 0xFFFF  # mode 0: 13 bit, mode 3: stop
399:             sfr[SFR_TH1] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
400:             sfr[SFR_TL1] = value & 0xFF
401:         sfr[SFR_TCON] = tcon
402:         self._timers_on = bool(tcon & 0x50) and True
403:         self.timers_on = self._timers_on or (tcon & 0x40) != 0
404:         # serial receive
405:         if self._serial_rx:
406:             chunk = bus.serial_read()
407:             if chunk is not None:
408:                 sfr[SFR_SBUF] = chunk & 0xFF
409:                 sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_RI
410:         # watchdog: 8051 WDT overflows ~ 2**17 machine cycles on AT89C55
411:         if self.wd_enabled:
412:             self.watchdog += cycles
413:             if self.watchdog > 0x20000:
414:                 self.watchdog = 0
415: 
416:     # ------------------------------------------------------------ interrupts
417:     def _poll_interrupts(self) -> None:
418:         ie = self.sfr[SFR_IE]
419:         if not (ie & 0x80):            # EA
420:             return
421:         pending = 0
422:         tcon = self.sfr[SFR_TCON]
423:         if tcon & TCON_IE0:
424:             pending |= IRQ_INT0
425:         if tcon & TCON_TF0:
426:             pending |= IRQ_T0
427:         if tcon & TCON_IE1:
428:             pending |= IRQ_INT1
429:         if tcon & TCON_TF1:
430:             pending |= IRQ_T1
431:         if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_RI:
432:             pending |= IRQ_RX
433:         if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_TI:
434:             pending |= IRQ_TX
435:         pending |= self.bus.irq_requested()
436:         pending &= 0xFF
437:         if not pending:
438:             return
439:         ip = self.sfr[SFR_IP]
440:         chosen = -1
441:         chosen_pri = -1
442:         for bit, irq in zip(range(6), _VEC_IRQ):
443:             if not (pending & irq):
444:                 continue
445:             if not (ie & irq):
446:                 continue
447:             if (ip & irq) and self.irq_level and irq != self.irq_level:
448:                 continue
449:             pri = 1 if (ip & irq) else 0
450:             if pri > chosen_pri:
451:                 chosen_pri = pri
452:                 chosen = bit
453:         if chosen < 0:
454:             return
455:         irq = _VEC_IRQ[chosen]
456:         if irq == IRQ_T0:
457:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF0 & 0xFF
458:         elif irq == IRQ_T1:
459:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF1 & 0xFF
460:         elif irq == IRQ_INT0:
461:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE0 & 0xFF
462:         elif irq == IRQ_INT1:
463:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE1 & 0xFF
464:         elif irq == IRQ_RX:
465:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_RI & 0xFF
466:         elif irq == IRQ_TX:
467:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_TI & 0xFF
468:         self.irq_level = irq if (ip & irq) else 0
469:         self._advance(2)
470:         self.push_pc()
471:         self.pc = _VEC[chosen]
472: 
473:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------- step
474:     def step(self) -> int:
475:         """Execute one instruction.  Returns the machine cycles consumed."""
476:         if self.halted:
477:             return 1
478:         if self.idle:
479:             self._advance(1)
480:             return 1
481:         self._poll_interrupts()
482:         cycles = self._execute()
483:         self._advance(cycles)
484:         return cycles
485: 
486:     def run(self, cycles: int) -> int:
487:         """Run for at most ``cycles`` machine cycles (or forever if <= 0)."""
488:         executed = 0
489:         target = self.cycles + cycles if cycles > 0 else -1
490:         execute = self._execute
491:         advance = self._advance
492:         while True:
493:             if self.halted:
494:                 break
495:             if self.idle:
496:                 advance(1)
497:             else:
498:                 self._poll_interrupts()
499:                 advance(execute())
500:             executed += 1
501:             if target >= 0 and self.cycles >= target:
502:                 break
503:             if executed >= 400_000_000:
504:                 break
505:         return executed
506: 
507:     # --------------------------------------------------------------- execution
508:     def _execute(self) -> int:
509:         rom = self.rom
510:         pc = self.pc
511:         self.last_op = rom.byte(pc)
512:         trace = self.trace
513:         if trace is not None:
514:             if len(trace) < self.trace_limit:
515:                 trace.append((pc, self.last_op, self.acc, self.psw,
516:                               self.sfr[SFR_SP], self.cycles))
517:             else:
518:                 self.trace = None
519:         p = pc + 1
520:         op = self.last_op
521:         romb = rom.byte
522:         sfr = self.sfr
523:         ram = self.ram
524:         bus = self.bus
525:         # ---- decode/execute -------------------------------------------------
526:         if op == 0x00:                                              # NOP
527:             self.pc = p
528:             return 1
529:         # ================================ MOV A, #imm / direct / @Ri / Rn / R
530:         if op == 0x74:                                              # MOV A,#imm
531:             self.pc = p + 1
532:             self.acc = romb(p)
533:             return 1
534:         if op == 0xE5:                                              # MOV A,direct
535:             self.pc = p + 1
536:             addr = romb(p)
537:             if addr == SFR_ACC:
538:                 pass
539:             elif addr < 0x80:
540:                 self.acc = ram[addr]
541:             elif SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
542:                 self.acc = self._port_read((addr - SFR_P0) >> 4)
543:             elif addr == SFR_SBUF:
544:                 self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
545:             else:
546:                 self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
547:             self.set_p()
548:             return 1
549:         if op == 0xF5:                                              # MOV direct,A
550:             self.pc = p + 1
551:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
552:             return 1
553:         if op == 0xE4:                                              # CLR A
554:             self.pc = p
555:             self.acc = 0
556:             return 1
557:         if op == 0xF4:                                              # CPL A
558:             self.pc = p
559:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ 0xFF
560:             return 1
561:         if op in (0xE6, 0xE7):                                      # MOV A,@Ri
562:             self.pc = p
563:             self.acc = ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
564:             self.set_p()
565:             return 1
566:         if op in (0xF6, 0xF7):                                      # MOV @Ri,A
567:             self.pc = p
568:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
569:             return 1
570:         if op in (0x76, 0x77):                                      # MOV @Ri,#imm
571:             self.pc = p + 1
572:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = romb(p)
573:             return 1
574:         if 0xE8 <= op <= 0xEF:                                      # MOV A,Rn
575:             self.pc = p
576:             self.acc = self._r(op & 7)
577:             self.set_p()
578:             return 1
579:         if 0xF8 <= op <= 0xFF:                                      # MOV Rn,A
580:             self.pc = p
581:             self._set_r(op & 7, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
582:             return 1
583:         if 0x78 <= op <= 0x7F:                                      # MOV Rn,#imm
584:             self.pc = p + 1
585:             self._set_r(op & 7, romb(p))
586:             return 1
587:         if 0xA8 <= op <= 0xAF:                                      # MOV Rn,direct
588:             self.pc = p + 1
589:             self._set_r(op & 7, self._dir_read(romb(p)))
590:             return 1
591:         if 0x88 <= op <= 0x8F:                                      # MOV direct,Rn
592:             self.pc = p + 1
593:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self._r(op & 7))
594:             return 1
595:         if op == 0x85:                                             # MOV direct,direct
596:             self.pc = p + 2
597:             src = romb(p)
598:             dst = romb(p + 1)
599:             self._dir_write(dst, self._dir_read(src))
600:             return 2
601:         if op == 0x75:                                             # MOV direct,#imm
602:             self.pc = p + 2
603:             self._dir_write(romb(p), romb(p + 1))
604:             return 2
605:         if op in (0x86, 0x87):                                     # MOV direct,@Ri
606:             self.pc = p + 1
607:             self._dir_write(romb(p), ram[self._ri(op & 1)])
608:             return 2
609:         if op in (0xA6, 0xA7):                                     # MOV @Ri,direct
610:             self.pc = p + 1
611:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self._dir_read(romb(p))
612:             return 2
613:         if op == 0x90:                                             # MOV DPTR,#imm16
614:             self.pc = p + 2
615:             self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = romb(p)
616:             self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = romb(p + 1)
617:             return 2
618:         # ============================== MOVC / MOVX
619:         if op == 0x93:                                             # MOVC A,@A+DPTR
620:             self.pc = p
621:             self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + self.dptr) & 0xFFFF)
622:             return 2
623:         if op == 0x83:                                             # MOVC A,@A+PC
624:             self.pc = p
625:             self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + p) & 0xFFFF)
626:             return 2
627:         if op in (0xE2, 0xE3):                                     # MOVX A,@Ri
628:             self.pc = p
629:             addr = self._ri(op & 1)
630:             if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
631:                 addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
632:             self.acc = bus.ext_read(addr) & 0xFF
633:             self.set_p()
634:             return 2
635:         if op in (0xF2, 0xF3):                                     # MOVX @Ri,A
636:             self.pc = p
637:             addr = self._ri(op & 1)
638:             self._ext_write_banked(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
639:             return 2
640:         if op == 0xE0:                                             # MOVX A,@DPTR
641:             self.pc = p
642:             self.acc = bus.ext_read(self.dptr) & 0xFF
643:             self.set_p()
644:             return 2
645:         if op == 0xF0:                                             # MOVX @DPTR,A
646:             self.pc = p
647:             bus.ext_write(self.dptr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
648:             return 2
649:         if op == 0xA3:                                             # INC DPTR
650:             self.pc = p
651:             self.dptr = (self.dptr + 1) & 0xFFFF
652:             return 2
653:         # =============================================================== ADD
654:         if op == 0x24:                                             # ADD A,#imm
655:             self.pc = p + 1
656:             self._add(romb(p), 0)
657:             return 1
658:         if op == 0x25:                                             # ADD A,direct
659:             self.pc = p + 1
660:             self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), 0)
661:             return 1
662:         if op in (0x26, 0x27):                                     # ADD A,@Ri
663:             self.pc = p
664:             self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], 0)
665:             return 1
666:         if 0x28 <= op <= 0x2F:                                     # ADD A,Rn
667:             self.pc = p
668:             self._add(self._r(op & 7), 0)
669:             return 1
670:         if op == 0x34:                                             # ADDC A,#imm
671:             self.pc = p + 1
672:             self._add(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
673:             return 1
674:         if op == 0x35:                                             # ADDC A,direct
675:             self.pc = p + 1
676:             self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
677:             return 1
678:         if op in (0x36, 0x37):
679:             self.pc = p
680:             self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
681:             return 1
682:         if 0x38 <= op <= 0x3F:
683:             self.pc = p
684:             self._add(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
685:             return 1
686:         # =============================================================== SUBB
687:         if op == 0x94:
688:             self.pc = p + 1
689:             self._sub(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
690:             return 1
691:         if op == 0x95:
692:             self.pc = p + 1
693:             self._sub(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
694:             return 1
695:         if op in (0x96, 0x97):
696:             self.pc = p
697:             self._sub(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
698:             return 1
699:         if 0x98 <= op <= 0x9F:
700:             self.pc = p
701:             self._sub(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
702:             return 1
703:         # ================================================================ INC
704:         if op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):
705:             return self._inc_family(op, p, romb)
706:         if 0x08 <= op <= 0x0F:                                     # INC Rn
707:             self.pc = p
708:             n = op & 7
709:             self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) + 1) & 0xFF)
710:             return 1
711:         if op == 0x14:                                             # DEC A
712:             self.pc = p
713:             self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] - 1) & 0xFF
714:             return 1
715:         if op in (0x15, 0x16, 0x17):
716:             return self._dec_family(op, p, romb)
717:         if 0x18 <= op <= 0x1F:                                     # DEC Rn
718:             self.pc = p
719:             n = op & 7
720:             self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF)
721:             return 1
722:         # ================================================================ MUL/DIV
723:         if op == 0xA4:                                             # MUL AB
724:             self.pc = p
725:             result = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] * self.sfr[SFR_B]
726:             self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = result & 0xFF
727:             self.sfr[SFR_B] = (result >> 8) & 0xFF
728:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
729:             if result > 0xFF:
730:                 psw |= 0x04
731:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
732:             self.set_p()
733:             return 4
734:         if op == 0x84:                                             # DIV AB
735:             self.pc = p
736:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
737:             b = self.sfr[SFR_B]
738:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
739:             if b == 0:
740:                 psw |= 0x04
741:             else:
742:                 self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a // b
743:                 self.sfr[SFR_B] = a % b
744:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
745:             self.set_p()
746:             return 4
747:         # ========================================================== logical ops
748:         if op == 0x54:                                             # ANL A,#imm
749:             self.pc = p + 1
750:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & romb(p)
751:             return 1
752:         if op == 0x55:
753:             self.pc = p + 1
754:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._dir_read(romb(p))
755:             return 1
756:         if op in (0x56, 0x57):
757:             self.pc = p
758:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
759:             return 1
760:         if 0x58 <= op <= 0x5F:
761:             self.pc = p
762:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._r(op & 7)
763:             return 1
764:         if op == 0x44:                                             # ORL A,#imm
765:             self.pc = p + 1
766:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | romb(p)
767:             return 1
768:         if op == 0x45:
769:             self.pc = p + 1
770:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._dir_read(romb(p))
771:             return 1
772:         if op in (0x46, 0x47):
773:             self.pc = p
774:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
775:             return 1
776:         if 0x48 <= op <= 0x4F:
777:             self.pc = p
778:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._r(op & 7)
779:             return 1
780:         if op == 0x64:                                             # XRL A,#imm
781:             self.pc = p + 1
782:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ romb(p)
783:             return 1
784:         if op == 0x65:
785:             self.pc = p + 1
786:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._dir_read(romb(p))
787:             return 1
788:         if op in (0x66, 0x67):
789:             self.pc = p
790:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
791:             return 1
792:         if 0x68 <= op <= 0x6F:
793:             self.pc = p
794:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._r(op & 7)
795:             return 1
796:         # ANL/ORL/XRL direct,A and direct,#imm
797:         if op in (0x52, 0x53):
798:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x52 else 2)
799:             addr = romb(p)
800:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x52 else romb(p + 1)
801:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) & operand)
802:             return 1 if op == 0x52 else 2
803:         if op in (0x42, 0x43):
804:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x42 else 2)
805:             addr = romb(p)
806:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x42 else romb(p + 1)
807:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) | operand)
808:             return 1 if op == 0x42 else 2
809:         if op in (0x62, 0x63):
810:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x62 else 2)
811:             addr = romb(p)
812:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x62 else romb(p + 1)
813:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) ^ operand)
814:             return 1 if op == 0x62 else 2
815:         # =========================================================== rotates
816:         if op == 0x03:                                             # RR A
817:             self.pc = p
818:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
819:             self.acc = (a >> 1) | ((a & 1) << 7)
820:             return 1
821:         if op == 0x13:                                             # RRC A
822:             self.pc = p
823:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
824:             carry = 0x80 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
825:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
826:             if a & 1:
827:                 psw |= 0x80
828:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
829:             self.acc = (a >> 1) | carry
830:             return 1
831:         if op == 0x23:                                             # RL A
832:             self.pc = p
833:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
834:             self.acc = ((a << 1) | (a >> 7)) & 0xFF
835:             return 1
836:         if op == 0x33:                                             # RLC A
837:             self.pc = p
838:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
839:             carry_in = 1 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
840:             result = (a << 1) | carry_in
841:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
842:             if result > 0xFF:
843:                 psw |= 0x80
844:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
845:             self.acc = result & 0xFF
846:             return 1
847:         if op == 0xC4:                                             # SWAP A
848:             self.pc = p
849:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
850:             self.acc = ((a << 4) | (a >> 4)) & 0xFF
851:             return 1
852:         if op in (0xD4,):                                          # DA A
853:             self.pc = p
854:             return self._da(1)
855:         # ========================================================= XCH / XCHD
856:         if op == 0xC5:
857:             self.pc = p + 1
858:             addr = romb(p)
859:             tmp = self._dir_read(addr)
860:             self._dir_write(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
861:             self.acc = tmp
862:             return 1
863:         if op in (0xC6, 0xC7):
864:             self.pc = p
865:             ri = self._ri(op & 1)
866:             tmp = ram[ri]
867:             ram[ri] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
868:             self.acc = tmp
869:             self.set_p()
870:             return 1
871:         if 0xC8 <= op <= 0xCF:
872:             self.pc = p
873:             n = op & 7
874:             tmp = self._r(n)
875:             self._set_r(n, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
876:             self.acc = tmp
877:             return 1
878:         if op in (0xD6, 0xD7):                                     # XCHD A,@Ri
879:             self.pc = p
880:             ri = self._ri(op & 1)
881:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
882:             ram[ri] = (ram[ri] & 0xF0) | (a & 0x0F)
883:             self.acc = (a & 0xF0) | (ram[ri] & 0x0F)
884:             return 1
885:         # ================================================================ PUSH/POP
886:         if op == 0xC0:
887:             self.pc = p + 1
888:             self.push(self._dir_read(romb(p)))
889:             return 2
890:         if op == 0xD0:
891:             self.pc = p + 1
892:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self.pop())
893:             return 2
894:         # ============================================================== branches
895:         if op == 0x02:                                             # LJMP
896:             self.pc = romb(p) << 8 | romb(p + 1)
897:             return 2
898:         if op == 0x12:                                             # LCALL
899:             target = romb(p) << 8 | romb(p + 1)
900:             self.pc = p + 2
901:             self.push_pc()
902:             self.pc = target
903:             return 2
904:         if op == 0x22:                                             # RET
905:             self.pop_pc()
906:             return 2
907:         if op == 0x32:                                             # RETI
908:             self.pop_pc()
909:             self.irq_level = 0
910:             return 2
911:         if op in (0x01, 0x21, 0x41, 0x61, 0x81, 0xA1, 0xC1, 0xE1):  # AJMP
912:             page = (p & 0xF800)
913:             target = page | ((op >> 5) << 8) | romb(p)
914:             self.pc = target
915:             return 2
916:         if op == 0x80:                                             # SJMP
917:             self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
918:             return 2
919:         if op == 0x40:                                             # JC
920:             self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if (sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else p + 1
921:             return 2
922:         if op == 0x50:                                             # JNC
923:             self.pc = p + 1 if (sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
924:             return 2
925:         if op == 0x60:                                             # JZ
926:             self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if self.sfr[SFR_ACC] == 0 else p + 1
927:             return 2
928:         if op == 0x70:                                             # JNZ
929:             self.pc = p + 1 if self.sfr[SFR_ACC] == 0 else (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF
930:             return 2
931:         if op == 0xB4:                                             # CJNE A,#imm,rel
932:             self.pc = p + 2
933:             self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], romb(p))
934:             if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
935:                 self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
936:             return 2
937:         if op == 0xB5:                                             # CJNE A,direct,rel
938:             self.pc = p + 2
939:             self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], self._dir_read(romb(p)))
940:             if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
941:                 self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
942:             return 2
943:         if op in (0xB6, 0xB7):                                     # CJNE @Ri,#imm,rel
944:             self.pc = p + 2
945:             self._cjne(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], romb(p))
946:             if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
947:                 self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
948:             return 2
949:         if 0xB8 <= op <= 0xBF:                                     # CJNE Rn,#imm,rel
950:             self.pc = p + 2
951:             self._cjne(self._r(op & 7), romb(p))
952:             if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:
953:                 self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
954:             return 2
955:         if op == 0xD5:                                             # DJNZ direct,rel
956:             addr = romb(p)
957:             value = (self._dir_read(addr) - 1) & 0xFF
958:             self._dir_write(addr, value)
959:             self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF if value else p + 2
960:             return 2
961:         if 0xD8 <= op <= 0xDF:                                     # DJNZ Rn,rel
962:             n = op & 7
963:             value = (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF
964:             self._set_r(n, value)
965:             self.pc = (p + 1 + _signed(romb(p))) & 0xFFFF if value else p + 1
966:             return 2
967:         if op == 0x20:                                             # JB bit,rel
968:             bit = self._bit(romb(p))
969:             self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF if bit else p + 2
970:             return 2
971:         if op == 0x30:                                             # JNB bit,rel
972:             bit = self._bit(romb(p))
973:             self.pc = p + 2 if bit else (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
974:             return 2
975:         if op == 0x10:                                             # JBC bit,rel
976:             addr = romb(p)
977:             bit = self._bit(addr)
978:             if bit:
979:                 self._bit_write(addr, 0)
980:                 self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
981:             else:
982:                 self.pc = p + 2
983:             return 2
984:         # ============================================================ bit ops
985:         if op in (0xC2, 0xC3, 0xD2, 0xD3, 0xB2, 0xB3):
986:             self.pc = p + 1
987:             addr = romb(p)
988:             if op == 0xC2:
989:                 self._bit_write(addr, 0)
990:             elif op == 0xD2:
991:                 self._bit_write(addr, 1)
992:             elif op == 0xB2:
993:                 self._bit_write(addr, 0 if self._bit(addr) else 1)
994:             elif op == 0xC3:                                       # CLR C
995:                 self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
996:             elif op == 0xD3:                                       # SETB C
997:                 self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
998:             elif op == 0xB3:                                       # CPL C
999:                 self.sfr[SFR_PSW] ^= 0x80
1000:             return 1 if op in (0xC3, 0xD3, 0xB3) else 2
1001:         if op == 0x72:                                             # ORL C,bit
1002:             self.pc = p + 1
1003:             if self._bit(romb(p)):
1004:                 self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
1005:             return 2
1006:         if op == 0xA2:                                             # MOV C,bit
1007:             self.pc = p + 1
1008:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
1009:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | (0x80 if self._bit(romb(p)) else 0)
1010:             return 1
1011:         if op == 0x92:                                             # MOV bit,C
1012:             self.pc = p + 1
1013:             self._bit_write(romb(p), 1 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0)
1014:             return 2
1015:         if op == 0xA0:                                             # ORL C,/bit
1016:             self.pc = p + 1
1017:             if not self._bit(romb(p)):
1018:                 self.sfr[SFR_PSW] |= 0x80
1019:             return 2
1020:         if op == 0x82:                                             # ANL C,bit
1021:             self.pc = p + 1
1022:             if not self._bit(romb(p)):
1023:                 self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
1024:             return 2
1025:         if op == 0xB0:                                             # ANL C,/bit
1026:             self.pc = p + 1
1027:             if self._bit(romb(p)):
1028:                 self.sfr[SFR_PSW] &= 0x7F
1029:             return 2
1030:         # ================================================================= misc
1031:         if op == 0xA5:                                             # reserved
1032:             self.pc = p
1033:             self.error = f"reserved opcode 0xA5 at 0x{pc:04X}"
1034:             return 1
1035:         if op == 0xC0:  # (already handled)
1036:             pass
1037:         # ------------------------------------------------------------- unknown
1038:         self.pc = p
1039:         self.error = f"unimplemented opcode 0x{op:02X} at 0x{pc:04X}"
1040:         return 1

1042:     # -------------------------------------------------------------- helper ops
1043:     def _ext_write_banked(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
1044:         if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
1045:             addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
1046:         self.bus.ext_write(addr, value)
1047: 
1048:     def _add(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
1049:         a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
1050:         result = a + operand + (1 if carry_in else 0)
1051:         psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0
1052:         if ((a & 0x0F) + (operand & 0x0F) + (1 if carry_in else 0)) > 0x0F:
1053:             psw |= 0x40
1054:         if result > 0xFF:
1055:             psw |= 0x80
1056:         value = result & 0xFF
1057:         self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
1058:         if (a ^ value) & (operand ^ value) & 0x80:
1059:             psw |= 0x04
1060:         self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]
1061: 
1062:     def _sub(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
1063:         a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
1064:         borrow_in = 1 if carry_in else 0
1065:         result = a - operand - borrow_in
1066:         psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0
1067:         if ((a & 0x0F) - (operand & 0x0F) - borrow_in) < 0:
1068:             psw |= 0x40
1069:         if result < 0:
1070:             psw |= 0x80
1071:         value = result & 0xFF
1072:         self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
1073:         if (a ^ operand) & (a ^ value) & 0x80:
1074:             psw |= 0x04
1075:         self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]
1076: 
1077:     def _cjne(self, left: int, right: int) -> None:
1078:         """CJNE sets CY when the first operand is *below* the second."""
1079:         psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
1080:         if left < right:
1081:             psw |= 0x80
1082:         self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
1083: 
1084:     def _inc_family(self, op: int, p: int, romb) -> int:
1085:         if op == 0x04:
1086:             self.pc = p
1087:             self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + 1) & 0xFF
1088:             return 1
1089:         if op == 0x05:
1090:             self.pc = p + 1
1091:             addr = romb(p)
1092:             self._dir_write(addr, (self._dir_read(addr) + 1) & 0xFF)
1093:             return 1
