demo-fw: SECOND core bug in m8051/cpu.py — `CJNE` jumps on CY (left < right) instead of on "operands differ". Spotted while running my demo (it silently sent every action key to the wrong handler). Evidence below; m8051/ is yours, I have not touched it.

WHAT HAPPENS NOW (cpu.py, the four CJNE sites in `_execute`):
    if op == 0xB4:                       # CJNE A,#imm,rel
        self.pc = p + 2
        self._cjne(self.sfr[SFR_ACC], romb(p))
        if sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80:          # <-- CY, i.e. "left < right"
            self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
The MCS-51 takes the CJNE branch whenever the two operands are NOT EQUAL; CY is a *separate* output (CY=1 iff the first operand is unsigned-below the second). `_cjne()` is right; the branch condition is wrong.

MEASURED (my harness, unmodified core, program = setup; CJNE ...; LJMP 0x0030 / target at 0x20 -> LJMP 0x0040):
    BUG  CJNE A,#2   (A=5, not equal)      -> PC=0x0030 (no jump, should jump)
    ok   CJNE A,#5   (A=5, equal)          -> PC=0x0030 (correct)
    ok   CJNE A,#5   (A=2, not equal)      -> PC=0x0040 (works only because 2<5)
    ok   CJNE A,30h  (5 vs 9, not equal)   -> PC=0x0040 (works because 5<9)
    BUG  CJNE Rn,#2  (R0=5, not equal)     -> PC=0x0030 (should jump)
    BUG  CJNE @Ri,#3 (7 vs 3, not equal)   -> PC=0x0030 (should jump)
JZ/JNZ/JC/JNC/DJNZ are all correct.

FIX for all four sites — compare explicitly, keep `_cjne` for the flags:
    if op == 0xB4:                                             # CJNE A,#imm,rel
        left, right = self.sfr[SFR_ACC], romb(p)
        self.pc = p + 2
        self._cjne(left, right)
        if left != right:
            self.pc = (p + 2 + _signed(romb(p + 1))) & 0xFFFF
        return 2
    if op == 0xB5:                                             # CJNE A,direct,rel
        left, right = self.sfr[SFR_ACC], self._dir_read(romb(p))
        ... same three lines ...
    if op in (0xB6, 0xB7):                                     # CJNE @Ri,#imm,rel
        left, right = ram[self._ri(op & 1)], romb(p)
        ...
    if 0xB8 <= op <= 0xBF:                                     # CJNE Rn,#imm,rel
        left, right = self._r(op & 7), romb(p)
        ...

IMPACT: bigger than the push_pc one. `CJNE` is the canonical 8051 comparison; the real firmware uses it in every table lookup / range check, so it silently takes wrong branches instead of faulting. Together with push_pc, these two explain why nothing ran far before.

I am adding a `TestCoreContract` class to `tests/test_demo_firmware.py` that pins exactly this behaviour (LCALL/RET byte order + all four CJNE forms + JZ/JNZ/JC/JNC/DJNZ), so the demo cannot silently regress if the core changes again. It will stay red on the CJNE cases until you patch — ping me when it is in and I will re-run the full suite and report.

Also fixed on my side meanwhile: a real bug of my own in BCD_SHL1 (I propagated the decimal carry from high byte to low instead of low to high, so multi-digit entry lost the higher digits).

342:             self.bus.serial_write(value)
343:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_TI
344:         self._sfr_side_effect(addr, value)
345: 
346:     def _port_read(self, port: int) -> int:
347:         """Read a port: latch AND external pin levels (quasi-bidirectional)."""
348:         return self._port_latch[port] & self.bus.port_read(port)
349: 
350:     def _sfr_side_effect(self, addr: int, value: int) -> None:
351:         if addr == SFR_WDTRST:
352:             self.watchdog = 0
353:         elif addr == SFR_WDTPRG:
354:             self.wd_enabled = True
355:         elif addr == SFR_TCON:
356:             self.timers_on = (value & 0x50) != 0
357:         elif addr == SFR_SCON:
358:             self._serial_rx = bool(value & SCON_REN) and self.bus.serial_available()
359: 
360:     # -------------------------------------------------------------------- time
361:     def _advance(self, cycles: int) -> None:
362:         """Run timers/serial/peripherals for ``cycles`` machine cycles."""
363:         self.cycles += cycles
364:         self.op_count += 1
365:         if self.timers_on or self.wd_enabled or self._serial_rx:
366:             self._do_peripherals(cycles)
367:         elif self._pending_tick:
368:             self._pending_tick += cycles
369:             if self._pending_tick >= 32:
370:                 self.bus.tick(self._pending_tick)
371:                 self._pending_tick = 0
372:         else:
373:             self._pending_tick = cycles
374: 
375:     def _do_peripherals(self, cycles: int) -> None:
376:         bus = self.bus
377:         if self._pending_tick:
378:             bus.tick(self._pending_tick + cycles)
379:             self._pending_tick = 0
380:         else:
381:             bus.tick(cycles)
382:         sfr = self.sfr
383:         tmod = sfr[SFR_TMOD]
384:         tcon = sfr[SFR_TCON]
385:         if tcon & TCON_TR0:
386:             m = tmod & 0x03
387:             if m == 0:                       # 13-bit timer
388:                 value = ((sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
389:                 if value > 0x1FFF:
390:                     value &= 0x1FFF
391:                     tcon |= TCON_TF0
392:             elif m == 1:
393:                 value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
394:                 if value > 0xFFFF:
395:                     value &= 0xFFFF
396:                     tcon |= TCON_TF0
397:             else:
398:                 value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL0]) + cycles
399:                 if value > 0xFFFF:
400:                     value = (sfr[SFR_TH0] << 8) | (value & 0xFF)
401:                     tcon |= TCON_TF0
402:             sfr[SFR_TH0] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
403:             sfr[SFR_TL0] = value & 0xFF
404:         if tcon & TCON_TR1:
405:             m = (tmod >> 4) & 0x03
406:             value = (sfr[SFR_TH1] << 8 | sfr[SFR_TL1]) + cycles
407:             if m == 1:
408:                 if value > 0xFFFF:
409:                     value &= 0xFFFF
410:                     tcon |= TCON_TF1
411:             elif m == 2:
412:                 if value > 0xFF:
413:                     value = sfr[SFR_TH1]
414:                     tcon |= TCON_TF1
415:             else:
416:                 value &= 0xFFFF  # mode 0: 13 bit, mode 3: stop
417:             sfr[SFR_TH1] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF
418:             sfr[SFR_TL1] = value & 0xFF
419:         sfr[SFR_TCON] = tcon
420:         self.timers_on = (tcon & 0x50) != 0
421:         # serial receive
422:         if self._serial_rx:
423:             chunk = bus.serial_read()
424:             if chunk is not None:
425:                 sfr[SFR_SBUF] = chunk & 0xFF
426:                 sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_RI
427:         # watchdog: 8051 WDT overflows ~ 2**17 machine cycles on AT89C55
428:         if self.wd_enabled:
429:             self.watchdog += cycles
430:             if self.watchdog > 0x20000:
431:                 self.watchdog = 0
432: 
433:     # ------------------------------------------------------------ interrupts
434:     def _poll_interrupts(self) -> None:
435:         ie = self.sfr[SFR_IE]
436:         if not (ie & 0x80):            # EA
437:             return
438:         pending = 0
439:         tcon = self.sfr[SFR_TCON]
440:         if tcon & TCON_IE0:
441:             pending |= IRQ_INT0
442:         if tcon & TCON_TF0:
443:             pending |= IRQ_T0
444:         if tcon & TCON_IE1:
445:             pending |= IRQ_INT1
446:         if tcon & TCON_TF1:
447:             pending |= IRQ_T1
448:         if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_RI:
449:             pending |= IRQ_RX
450:         if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_TI:
451:             pending |= IRQ_TX
452:         pending |= self.bus.irq_requested()
453:         pending &= 0xFF
454:         if not pending:
455:             return
456:         ip = self.sfr[SFR_IP]
457:         chosen = -1
458:         chosen_pri = -1
459:         for bit, irq in zip(range(6), _VEC_IRQ):
460:             if not (pending & irq):
461:                 continue
462:             if not (ie & irq):
463:                 continue
464:             if (ip & irq) and self.irq_level and irq != self.irq_level:
465:                 continue
466:             pri = 1 if (ip & irq) else 0
467:             if pri > chosen_pri:
468:                 chosen_pri = pri
469:                 chosen = bit
470:         if chosen < 0:
471:             return
472:         irq = _VEC_IRQ[chosen]
473:         if irq == IRQ_T0:
474:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF0 & 0xFF
475:         elif irq == IRQ_T1:
476:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF1 & 0xFF
477:         elif irq == IRQ_INT0:
478:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE0 & 0xFF
479:         elif irq == IRQ_INT1:
480:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE1 & 0xFF
481:         elif irq == IRQ_RX:
482:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_RI & 0xFF
483:         elif irq == IRQ_TX:
484:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_TI & 0xFF
485:         self.irq_level = irq if (ip & irq) else 0
486:         self._advance(2)
487:         self.push_pc()
488:         self.pc = _VEC[chosen]
489: 
490:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------- step
491:     def step(self) -> int:
492:         """Execute one instruction.  Returns the machine cycles consumed."""
493:         if self.halted:
494:             return 1
495:         if not self.rom.is_mapped(self.pc):
496:             # Fetching from an address that no code image covers.  On real
497:             # silicon this reads 0xFF (erased EPROM) and the CPU wanders; for
498:             # emulation that is useless, so we stop and report it.
499:             self.missing_pc = self.pc
500:             self.halted = True
501:             self.error = (f"fetch from unmapped code address 0x{self.pc:04X} "
502:                           f"- this part of the firmware image is missing")
503:             return 1
504:         if self.idle:
505:             self._advance(1)
506:             return 1
507:         self._poll_interrupts()
508:         cycles = self._execute()
509:         self._advance(cycles)
510:         return cycles
511: 
512:     def run_steps(self, max_steps: int) -> int:
513:         """Execute at most ``max_steps`` instructions; stop on halt/error."""
514:         executed = 0
515:         while executed < max_steps and not self.halted:
516:             if not self.rom.is_mapped(self.pc):
517:                 self.missing_pc = self.pc
518:                 self.halted = True
519:                 self.error = (f"fetch from unmapped code address 0x{self.pc:04X} "
520:                               f"- this part of the firmware image is missing")
521:                 break
522:             if self.idle:
523:                 self._advance(1)
524:             else:
525:                 self._poll_interrupts()
526:                 self._advance(self._execute())
527:             executed += 1
528:         return executed
529: 
530:     def run(self, cycles: int) -> int:
531:         """Run for at most ``cycles`` machine cycles (or forever if <= 0)."""
532:         executed = 0
533:         target = self.cycles + cycles if cycles > 0 else -1
534:         execute = self._execute
535:         advance = self._advance
536:         mapped = self.rom.is_mapped
537:         while True:
538:             if self.halted:
539:                 break
540:             if self.idle:
541:                 advance(1)
542:             else:
543:                 self._poll_interrupts()
544:                 advance(execute())
545:             executed += 1
546:             if target >= 0 and self.cycles >= target:
547:                 break
548:             if executed >= 400_000_000:
549:                 break
550:             if not mapped(self.pc):
551:                 self.missing_pc = self.pc
552:                 self.halted = True
553:                 self.error = (f"fetch from unmapped code address 0x{self.pc:04X} "
554:                               f"- this part of the firmware image is missing")
555:                 break
556:         return executed
557: 
558:     # --------------------------------------------------------------- execution
559:     def _execute(self) -> int:
560:         rom = self.rom
561:         pc = self.pc
562:         self.last_op = rom.byte(pc)
563:         trace = self.trace
564:         if trace is not None:
565:             if len(trace) < self.trace_limit:
566:                 trace.append((pc, self.last_op, self.acc, self.psw,
567:                               self.sfr[SFR_SP], self.cycles))
568:             else:
569:                 self.trace = None
570:         p = pc + 1
571:         op = self.last_op
572:         romb = rom.byte
573:         sfr = self.sfr
574:         ram = self.ram
575:         bus = self.bus
576:         # ---- decode/execute -------------------------------------------------
577:         if op == 0x00:                                              # NOP
578:             self.pc = p
579:             return 1
580:         # ================================ MOV A, #imm / direct / @Ri / Rn / R
581:         if op == 0x74:                                              # MOV A,#imm
582:             self.pc = p + 1
583:             self.acc = romb(p)
584:             return 1
585:         if op == 0xE5:                                              # MOV A,direct
586:             self.pc = p + 1
587:             addr = romb(p)
588:             if addr == SFR_ACC:
589:                 pass
590:             elif addr < 0x80:
591:                 self.acc = ram[addr]
592:             elif SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
593:                 self.acc = self._port_read((addr - SFR_P0) >> 4)
594:             elif addr == SFR_SBUF:
595:                 self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
596:             else:
597:                 self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
598:             self.set_p()
599:             return 1
600:         if op == 0xF5:                                              # MOV direct,A
601:             self.pc = p + 1
602:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
603:             return 1
604:         if op == 0xE4:                                              # CLR A
605:             self.pc = p
606:             self.acc = 0
607:             return 1
608:         if op == 0xF4:                                              # CPL A
609:             self.pc = p
610:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ 0xFF
611:             return 1
612:         if op in (0xE6, 0xE7):                                      # MOV A,@Ri
613:             self.pc = p
614:             self.acc = ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
615:             self.set_p()
616:             return 1
617:         if op in (0xF6, 0xF7):                                      # MOV @Ri,A
618:             self.pc = p
619:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
620:             return 1
621:         if op in (0x76, 0x77):                                      # MOV @Ri,#imm
622:             self.pc = p + 1
623:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = romb(p)
624:             return 1
625:         if 0xE8 <= op <= 0xEF:                                      # MOV A,Rn
626:             self.pc = p
627:             self.acc = self._r(op & 7)
628:             self.set_p()
629:             return 1
630:         if 0xF8 <= op <= 0xFF:                                      # MOV Rn,A
631:             self.pc = p
632:             self._set_r(op & 7, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
633:             return 1
634:         if 0x78 <= op <= 0x7F:                                      # MOV Rn,#imm
635:             self.pc = p + 1
636:             self._set_r(op & 7, romb(p))
637:             return 1
638:         if 0xA8 <= op <= 0xAF:                                      # MOV Rn,direct
639:             self.pc = p + 1
640:             self._set_r(op & 7, self._dir_read(romb(p)))
641:             return 1
642:         if 0x88 <= op <= 0x8F:                                      # MOV direct,Rn
643:             self.pc = p + 1
644:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self._r(op & 7))
645:             return 1
646:         if op == 0x85:                                             # MOV direct,direct
647:             self.pc = p + 2
648:             src = romb(p)
649:             dst = romb(p + 1)
650:             self._dir_write(dst, self._dir_read(src))
651:             return 2
652:         if op == 0x75:                                             # MOV direct,#imm
653:             self.pc = p + 2
654:             self._dir_write(romb(p), romb(p + 1))
655:             return 2
656:         if op in (0x86, 0x87):                                     # MOV direct,@Ri
657:             self.pc = p + 1
658:             self._dir_write(romb(p), ram[self._ri(op & 1)])
659:             return 2
660:         if op in (0xA6, 0xA7):                                     # MOV @Ri,direct
661:             self.pc = p + 1
662:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self._dir_read(romb(p))
663:             return 2
664:         if op == 0x90:                                             # MOV DPTR,#imm16
665:             self.pc = p + 2
666:             self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = romb(p)
667:             self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = romb(p + 1)
668:             return 2
669:         # ============================== MOVC / MOVX
670:         if op == 0x93:                                             # MOVC A,@A+DPTR
671:             self.pc = p
672:             self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + self.dptr) & 0xFFFF)
673:             return 2
674:         if op == 0x83:                                             # MOVC A,@A+PC
675:             self.pc = p
676:             self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + p) & 0xFFFF)
677:             return 2
678:         if op in (0xE2, 0xE3):                                     # MOVX A,@Ri
679:             self.pc = p
680:             addr = self._ri(op & 1)
681:             if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
682:                 addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
683:             self.acc = bus.ext_read(addr) & 0xFF
684:             self.set_p()
685:             return 2
686:         if op in (0xF2, 0xF3):                                     # MOVX @Ri,A
687:             self.pc = p
688:             addr = self._ri(op & 1)
689:             self._ext_write_banked(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
690:             return 2
691:         if op == 0xE0:                                             # MOVX A,@DPTR
692:             self.pc = p
693:             self.acc = bus.ext_read(self.dptr) & 0xFF
694:             self.set_p()
695:             return 2
696:         if op == 0xF0:                                             # MOVX @DPTR,A
697:             self.pc = p
698:             bus.ext_write(self.dptr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
699:             return 2
700:         if op == 0xA3:                                             # INC DPTR
701:             self.pc = p
702:             self.dptr = (self.dptr + 1) & 0xFFFF
703:             return 2
704:         # =============================================================== ADD
705:         if op == 0x24:                                             # ADD A,#imm
706:             self.pc = p + 1
707:             self._add(romb(p), 0)
708:             return 1
709:         if op == 0x25:                                             # ADD A,direct
710:             self.pc = p + 1
711:             self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), 0)
712:             return 1
713:         if op in (0x26, 0x27):                                     # ADD A,@Ri
714:             self.pc = p
715:             self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], 0)
716:             return 1
717:         if 0x28 <= op <= 0x2F:                                     # ADD A,Rn
718:             self.pc = p
719:             self._add(self._r(op & 7), 0)
720:             return 1
721:         if op == 0x34:                                             # ADDC A,#imm
722:             self.pc = p + 1
723:             self._add(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
724:             return 1
725:         if op == 0x35:                                             # ADDC A,direct
726:             self.pc = p + 1
727:             self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
728:             return 1
729:         if op in (0x36, 0x37):
730:             self.pc = p
731:             self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
732:             return 1
733:         if 0x38 <= op <= 0x3F:
734:             self.pc = p
735:             self._add(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
736:             return 1
737:         # =============================================================== SUBB
738:         if op == 0x94:
739:             self.pc = p + 1
740:             self._sub(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
741:             return 1
742:         if op == 0x95:
743:             self.pc = p + 1
744:             self._sub(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
745:             return 1
746:         if op in (0x96, 0x97):
747:             self.pc = p
748:             self._sub(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
749:             return 1
750:         if 0x98 <= op <= 0x9F:
751:             self.pc = p
752:             self._sub(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
753:             return 1
754:         # ================================================================ INC
755:         if op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):
756:             return self._inc_family(op, p, romb)
757:         if 0x08 <= op <= 0x0F:                                     # INC Rn
758:             self.pc = p
759:             n = op & 7
760:             self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) + 1) & 0xFF)
761:             return 1
762:         if op == 0x14:                                             # DEC A
763:             self.pc = p
764:             self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] - 1) & 0xFF
765:             return 1
766:         if op in (0x15, 0x16, 0x17):
767:             return self._dec_family(op, p, romb)
768:         if 0x18 <= op <= 0x1F:                                     # DEC Rn
769:             self.pc = p
770:             n = op & 7
771:             self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF)
772:             return 1
773:         # ================================================================ MUL/DIV
774:         if op == 0xA4:                                             # MUL AB
775:             self.pc = p
776:             result = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] * self.sfr[SFR_B]
777:             self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = result & 0xFF
778:             self.sfr[SFR_B] = (result >> 8) & 0xFF
779:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
780:             if result > 0xFF:
781:                 psw |= 0x04
782:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
783:             self.set_p()
784:             return 4
785:         if op == 0x84:                                             # DIV AB
786:             self.pc = p
787:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
788:             b = self.sfr[SFR_B]
789:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
790:             if b == 0:
791:                 psw |= 0x04
792:             else:
793:                 self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a // b
794:                 self.sfr[SFR_B] = a % b
795:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
796:             self.set_p()
797:             return 4
798:         # ========================================================== logical ops
799:         if op == 0x54:                                             # ANL A,#imm
800:             self.pc = p + 1
801:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & romb(p)
802:             return 1
803:         if op == 0x55:
804:             self.pc = p + 1
805:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._dir_read(romb(p))
806:             return 1
807:         if op in (0x56, 0x57):
808:             self.pc = p
809:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
810:             return 1
811:         if 0x58 <= op <= 0x5F:
812:             self.pc = p
813:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._r(op & 7)
814:             return 1
815:         if op == 0x44:                                             # ORL A,#imm
816:             self.pc = p + 1
817:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | romb(p)
818:             return 1
819:         if op == 0x45:
820:             self.pc = p + 1
821:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._dir_read(romb(p))
822:             return 1
823:         if op in (0x46, 0x47):
824:             self.pc = p
825:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
826:             return 1
827:         if 0x48 <= op <= 0x4F:
828:             self.pc = p
829:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._r(op & 7)
830:             return 1
831:         if op == 0x64:                                             # XRL A,#imm
832:             self.pc = p + 1
833:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ romb(p)
834:             return 1
835:         if op == 0x65:
836:             self.pc = p + 1
837:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._dir_read(romb(p))
838:             return 1
839:         if op in (0x66, 0x67):
840:             self.pc = p
841:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
842:             return 1
843:         if 0x68 <= op <= 0x6F:
844:             self.pc = p
845:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._r(op & 7)
846:             return 1
847:         # ANL/ORL/XRL direct,A and direct,#imm
848:         if op in (0x52, 0x53):
849:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x52 else 2)
850:             addr = romb(p)
851:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x52 else romb(p + 1)
852:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) & operand)
853:             return 1 if op == 0x52 else 2
854:         if op in (0x42, 0x43):
855:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x42 else 2)
856:             addr = romb(p)
857:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x42 else romb(p + 1)
858:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) | operand)
859:             return 1 if op == 0x42 else 2
860:         if op in (0x62, 0x63):
861:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x62 else 2)
862:             addr = romb(p)
863:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x62 else romb(p + 1)
864:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) ^ operand)
865:             return 1 if op == 0x62 else 2
866:         # =========================================================== rotates
867:         if op == 0x03:                                             # RR A
868:             self.pc = p
869:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
870:             self.acc = (a >> 1) | ((a & 1) << 7)
871:             return 1
872:         if op == 0x13:                                             # RRC A
873:             self.pc = p
874:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]

{"message": "Lead: second core bug found by `demo-fw` and now fixed — please be aware, it may change your earlier conclusions.

`CJNE` was branching on CY ("first operand < second") instead of on "operands differ". CJNE is the standard 8051 comparison, so every table lookup / range check in the firmware silently took the wrong branch. It never faulted, which is why traces looked plausible. All four forms (`A,#imm`; `A,direct`; `@Ri,#imm`; `Rn,#imm`) are now correct, and CY is still set as a separate output.

Combined with the earlier `push_pc` byte-order fix, this means: **any trace or conclusion you derived from running the ROM before now is unreliable and should be re-derived.** In particular please re-run:
- your `board/` tests,
- `tools/inspect_rom.py trace/histogram` on both dumps,

{"content": """"Тесты ядра MCS-51 (m8051/cpu.py).

Проверяются те места, где ошибка не падает, а тихо портит поток управления:
порядок байт в стеке, условия переходов, флаги. Оба найденных бага
(``push_pc`` и ``CJNE``) были именно такими, поэтому здесь на каждый из них
есть регрессионный тест.

Запуск::

    python -m unittest tests.test_cpu -v
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from m8051 import CPU8051, NullBus, ROM  # noqa: E402

SFR_ACC = 0xE0
SFR_PSW = 0xD0
SFR_SP = 0x81
SFR_B = 0xF0
SFR_P1 = 0x90


def make(program: bytes, base: int = 0x0000) -> tuple:
    rom = ROM("unit")
    rom.load_block(base, program)
    cpu = CPU8051(rom, NullBus())
    return cpu, rom


def run_until(cpu: CPU8051, stop_pcs, limit: int = 200) -> int:
    """Выполнять, пока PC не окажется в ``stop_pcs``; вернуть PC."""
    for _ in range(limit):
        if cpu.pc in stop_pcs:
            return cpu.pc
        cpu.step()
    return cpu.pc


class TestStackOrder(unittest.TestCase):
    """LCALL/ACALL кладут в стек младший байт адреса возврата первым."""

    def test_lcall_pushes_low_byte_first(self):
        # 0000: LCALL 0010h ; 0010: RET
        cpu, _ = make(bytes([0x12, 0x00, 0x10, 0x80, 0xFE]) + bytes(0x0C)
                      + bytes([0x22]))
        cpu.step()                     # LCALL
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0010)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x09)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x08], 0x00, "в стеке должен лежать младший байт")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x09], 0x00, "затем старший байт")
        cpu.step()                     # RET
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0003, "RET обязан вернуться на 0x0003")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x07)

    def test_return_address_survives_a_page_boundary(self):
        # вызов из 0x00F0 -> возврат на 0x00F3 (младший байт 0xF3, старший 0x00)
        program = bytearray(0x110)
        program[0x00:0x03] = bytes([0x12, 0x01, 0x00])     # LCALL 0100h
        program[0x03] = 0x80                                # SJMP $
        program[0x03 + 1] = 0xFE
        program[0x0100] = 0x22                              # RET
        cpu, _ = make(bytes(program))
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x08], 0x03)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x09], 0x00)
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0003)

    def test_interrupt_and_reti_round_trip(self):
        rom = ROM("irq")
        rom.load_block(0, bytes([0x80, 0xFE]))     # SJMP $
        rom.load_block(0x03, bytes([0x32]))        # RETI на векторе EXT0
        cpu = CPU8051(rom, NullBus())
        cpu.sfr[0xA8] = 0x81                        # EA | EX0
        cpu.sfr[0x88] = 0x02                        # IE0
        cpu.step()                                  # прерывание принято
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0003)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x09)
        cpu.step()                                  # RETI
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0000)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x07)


class TestCJNE(unittest.TestCase):
    """CJNE переходит при НЕРАВЕНСТВЕ; CY ставится отдельно (left < right)."""

    def _branch_program(self, opcode_operands: bytes, setup=None):
        # 0000: <setup> ; CJNE <operands>,rel=02h ; LJMP 0030h ; LJMP 0040h
        program = bytearray()
        program += bytes(setup or b"")
        cjne_at = len(program)
        program += bytes(opcode_operands)
        program += bytes([0x02, 0x00, 0x30])       # не перешли
        program += bytes([0x02, 0x00, 0x40])       # перешли
        cpu, _ = make(bytes(program))
        return cpu, cjne_at

    def test_a_immediate_not_equal_branches(self):
        # MOV A,#5 ; CJNE A,#2,+2
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB4, 0x02, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.step()                                  # MOV A,#5
        cpu.step()                                  # CJNE
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040, "5 != 2 -> переход обязан быть")

    def test_a_immediate_equal_falls_through(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB4, 0x05, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0030, "5 == 5 -> перехода быть не должно")

    def test_carry_is_set_when_below(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB4, 0x09, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80, "5 < 9 -> CY=1")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_carry_is_clear_when_above(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB4, 0x01, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertFalse(cpu.psw & 0x80, "5 > 1 -> CY=0")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_direct_form(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB5, 0x30, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.ram[0x30] = 9
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_register_form(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB8, 0x02, 0x02]), b"\x78\x05")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_indirect_form(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB6, 0x03, 0x02]), b"\x76\x07")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)


class TestArithmetic(unittest.TestCase):

    def _acc_after(self, program: bytes) -> int:
        cpu, _ = make(bytes(program) + b"\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(50)
        return cpu.acc

    def test_add_sets_carry_and_overflow(self):
        # MOV A,#0FFh ; ADD A,#01h
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\xff\x24\x01\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x00)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80, "CY=1")
        self.assertFalse(cpu.psw & 0x04, "OV=0 при 0xFF+1")

    def test_add_overflow_flag(self):
        # MOV A,#7Fh ; ADD A,#01h  -> 0x80, OV=1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x7f\x24\x01\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x80)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x04, "OV=1")
        self.assertFalse(cpu.psw & 0x80, "CY=0")

    def test_subb_borrow(self):
        # MOV A,#10h ; SUBB A,#20h -> EFh, CY=1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x10\x94\x20\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0xEF)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80, "заём -> CY=1")

    def test_mul_ab(self):
        # MOV A,#12h ; MOV B,#10h ; MUL AB -> 0x120, A=0x20, B=0x01
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x12\x75\xf0\x10\xa4\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x20)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sfr[SFR_B], 0x01)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x04, "результат > 0xFF -> OV=1")

    def test_div_ab(self):
        # MOV A,#0Ah ; MOV B,#03h ; DIV AB -> A=3, B=1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x0a\x75\xf0\x03\x84\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sfr[SFR_B], 1)

    def test_div_by_zero(self):
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x0a\x75\xf0\x00\x84\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x04, "деление на 0 -> OV=1")

    def test_da_a_produces_bcd(self):
        # MOV A,#09h ; ADD A,#01h ; DA A -> 0x10
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x09\x24\x01\xd4\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x10, "двоично-десятичная коррекция")

    def test_rlc_rotates_through_carry(self):
        # MOV A,#80h ; RLC A -> A=0, CY=1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x80\x33\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x00)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80)


class TestMemoryAndBits(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_direct_versus_indirect_ram(self):
        # MOV 30h,#0AAh ; MOV R0,#30h ; MOV A,@R0
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\x30\xaa\x78\x30\xe6\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0xAA)

    def test_register_bank_switching(self):
        # MOV PSW,#08h ; MOV R0,#11h ; MOV PSW,#00h ; MOV A,R0
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\xd0\x08\x78\x11\x75\xd0\x00\xe8\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(5)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x00, "после возврата в банк 0 R0 не тот")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x08], 0x11, "R0 банка 1 лежит в 0x08")

    def test_bit_operations(self):
        # SETB 20h.3 ; CLR C ; MOV C,20h.3
        cpu, _ = make(b"\xd2\x23\xc3\xa2\x23\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80, "бит 20h.3 установлен -> CY=1")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x20] & 0x08, 0x08)

    def test_push_pop_round_trip(self):
        # MOV A,#5Ah ; PUSH ACC ; MOV A,#00h ; POP ACC
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x5a\xc0\xe0\x74\x00\xd0\xe0\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(6)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x5A)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x07)

    def test_djnz_counts_down_and_branches(self):
        # MOV R0,#03h ; DJNZ R0,$-2
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x78\x03\xd8\xfe\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(10)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x00], 0x00)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0005, "после обнуления выходим из цикла")

    def test_jb_and_jnb(self):
        # SETB 20h.0 ; JB 20h.0,+2 ; LJMP 0030h ; LJMP 0040h
        cpu, _ = make(b"\xd2\x20\x20\x00\x02\x02\x00\x30\x02\x00\x40")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_movx_goes_through_the_bus(self):
        from m8051.bus import NullBus as Bus

        rom = ROM("x")
        rom.load_block(0, b"\x90\x12\x34\x74\x5a\xf0\xe0\x80\xfe")
        bus = Bus()
        cpu = CPU8051(rom, bus)
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(bus.ext[0x1234], 0x5A, "MOVX @DPTR,A")
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x5A, "MOVX A,@DPTR")

    def test_ajmp_stays_in_page(self):
        # 0000: AJMP 0100h (страница 0x0100)
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x01\x00\x80\xfe" + bytes(0xFC) + b"\x80\xfe")
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0100)


class TestTimers(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_timer0_mode1_overflows_and_sets_tf0(self):
        # MOV TMOD,#01h ; MOV TH0,#0FFh ; MOV TL0,#0FEh ; SETB TR0
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\x89\x01\x75\x8c\xff\x75\x8a\xfe\xd2\x8c\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(5)
        for _ in range(10):
            cpu.step()
        self.assertTrue(cpu.sfr[0x88] & 0x20, "TF0 обязан взвестись")

    def test_timer1_mode2_auto_reload(self):
        # MOV TMOD,#20h ; MOV TH1,#0FEh ; MOV TL1,#0FEh ; SETB TR1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\x89\x20\x75\x8d\xfe\x75\x8b\xfe\xd2\x8e\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(5)
        for _ in range(10):
            cpu.step()
        self.assertTrue(cpu.sfr[0x88] & 0x80, "TF1 обязан взвестись")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sfr[0x8B], 0xFE, "TL1 перезагружается из TH1")


class TestHalting(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_unmapped_fetch_stops_the_cpu_and_reports_address(self):
        rom = ROM("sparse")
        rom.load_block(0x8000, b"\x02\x90\x00")     # LJMP 9000h (не отдано)
        cpu = CPU8051(rom, NullBus())
        cpu.pc = 0x8000
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x9000)
        cpu.step()
        self.assertTrue(cpu.halted)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.missing_pc, 0x9000)
        self.assertIn("0x9000", cpu.error)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

Проверяются те места, где ошибка не падает, а тихо портит поток управления:
порядок байт в стеке, условия переходов, флаги. Оба найденных бага
(``push_pc`` и ``CJNE``) были именно такими, поэтому здесь на каждый из них
есть регрессионный тест.

Запуск::

    python -m unittest tests.test_cpu -v
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from m8051 import CPU8051, NullBus, ROM  # noqa: E402

SFR_ACC = 0xE0
SFR_PSW = 0xD0
SFR_SP = 0x81
SFR_B = 0xF0
SFR_P1 = 0x90


def make(program: bytes, base: int = 0x0000) -> tuple:
    rom = ROM("unit")
    rom.load_block(base, program)
    cpu = CPU8051(rom, NullBus())
    return cpu, rom


def run_until(cpu: CPU8051, stop_pcs, limit: int = 200) -> int:
    """Выполнять, пока PC не окажется в ``stop_pcs``; вернуть PC."""
    for _ in range(limit):
        if cpu.pc in stop_pcs:
            return cpu.pc
        cpu.step()
    return cpu.pc


class TestStackOrder(unittest.TestCase):
    """LCALL/ACALL кладут в стек младший байт адреса возврата первым."""

    def test_lcall_pushes_low_byte_first(self):
        # 0000: LCALL 0010h ; 0010: RET
        cpu, _ = make(bytes([0x12, 0x00, 0x10, 0x80, 0xFE]) + bytes(0x0C)
                      + bytes([0x22]))
        cpu.step()                     # LCALL
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0010)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x09)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x08], 0x00, "в стеке должен лежать младший байт")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x09], 0x00, "затем старший байт")
        cpu.step()                     # RET
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0003, "RET обязан вернуться на 0x0003")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x07)

    def test_return_address_survives_a_page_boundary(self):
        # вызов из 0x00F0 -> возврат на 0x00F3 (младший байт 0xF3, старший 0x00)
        program = bytearray(0x110)
        program[0x00:0x03] = bytes([0x12, 0x01, 0x00])     # LCALL 0100h
        program[0x03] = 0x80                                # SJMP $
        program[0x03 + 1] = 0xFE
        program[0x0100] = 0x22                              # RET
        cpu, _ = make(bytes(program))
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x08], 0x03)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x09], 0x00)
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0003)

    def test_interrupt_and_reti_round_trip(self):
        rom = ROM("irq")
        rom.load_block(0, bytes([0x80, 0xFE]))     # SJMP $
        rom.load_block(0x03, bytes([0x32]))        # RETI на векторе EXT0
        cpu = CPU8051(rom, NullBus())
        cpu.sfr[0xA8] = 0x81                        # EA | EX0
        cpu.sfr[0x88] = 0x02                        # IE0
        cpu.step()                                  # прерывание принято
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0003)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x09)
        cpu.step()                                  # RETI
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0000)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x07)


class TestCJNE(unittest.TestCase):
    """CJNE переходит при НЕРАВЕНСТВЕ; CY ставится отдельно (left < right)."""

    def _branch_program(self, opcode_operands: bytes, setup=None):
        # 0000: <setup> ; CJNE <operands>,rel=02h ; LJMP 0030h ; LJMP 0040h
        program = bytearray()
        program += bytes(setup or b"")
        cjne_at = len(program)
        program += bytes(opcode_operands)
        program += bytes([0x02, 0x00, 0x30])       # не перешли
        program += bytes([0x02, 0x00, 0x40])       # перешли
        cpu, _ = make(bytes(program))
        return cpu, cjne_at

    def test_a_immediate_not_equal_branches(self):
        # MOV A,#5 ; CJNE A,#2,+2
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB4, 0x02, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.step()                                  # MOV A,#5
        cpu.step()                                  # CJNE
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040, "5 != 2 -> переход обязан быть")

    def test_a_immediate_equal_falls_through(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB4, 0x05, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0030, "5 == 5 -> перехода быть не должно")

    def test_carry_is_set_when_below(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB4, 0x09, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80, "5 < 9 -> CY=1")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_carry_is_clear_when_above(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB4, 0x01, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertFalse(cpu.psw & 0x80, "5 > 1 -> CY=0")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_direct_form(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB5, 0x30, 0x02]), b"\x74\x05")
        cpu.ram[0x30] = 9
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_register_form(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB8, 0x02, 0x02]), b"\x78\x05")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_indirect_form(self):
        cpu, _ = self._branch_program(bytes([0xB6, 0x03, 0x02]), b"\x76\x07")
        cpu.step()
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)


class TestArithmetic(unittest.TestCase):

    def _acc_after(self, program: bytes) -> int:
        cpu, _ = make(bytes(program) + b"\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(50)
        return cpu.acc

    def test_add_sets_carry_and_overflow(self):
        # MOV A,#0FFh ; ADD A,#01h
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\xff\x24\x01\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x00)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80, "CY=1")
        self.assertFalse(cpu.psw & 0x04, "OV=0 при 0xFF+1")

    def test_add_overflow_flag(self):
        # MOV A,#7Fh ; ADD A,#01h  -> 0x80, OV=1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x7f\x24\x01\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x80)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x04, "OV=1")
        self.assertFalse(cpu.psw & 0x80, "CY=0")

    def test_subb_borrow(self):
        # MOV A,#10h ; SUBB A,#20h -> EFh, CY=1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x10\x94\x20\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0xEF)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80, "заём -> CY=1")

    def test_mul_ab(self):
        # MOV A,#12h ; MOV B,#10h ; MUL AB -> 0x120, A=0x20, B=0x01
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x12\x75\xf0\x10\xa4\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x20)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sfr[SFR_B], 0x01)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x04, "результат > 0xFF -> OV=1")

    def test_div_ab(self):
        # MOV A,#0Ah ; MOV B,#03h ; DIV AB -> A=3, B=1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x0a\x75\xf0\x03\x84\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sfr[SFR_B], 1)

    def test_div_by_zero(self):
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x0a\x75\xf0\x00\x84\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x04, "деление на 0 -> OV=1")

    def test_da_a_produces_bcd(self):
        # MOV A,#09h ; ADD A,#01h ; DA A -> 0x10
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x09\x24\x01\xd4\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x10, "двоично-десятичная коррекция")

    def test_rlc_rotates_through_carry(self):
        # MOV A,#80h ; RLC A -> A=0, CY=1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x80\x33\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(3)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x00)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80)


class TestMemoryAndBits(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_direct_versus_indirect_ram(self):
        # MOV 30h,#0AAh ; MOV R0,#30h ; MOV A,@R0
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\x30\xaa\x78\x30\xe6\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0xAA)

    def test_register_bank_switching(self):
        # MOV PSW,#08h ; MOV R0,#11h ; MOV PSW,#00h ; MOV A,R0
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\xd0\x08\x78\x11\x75\xd0\x00\xe8\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(5)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x00, "после возврата в банк 0 R0 не тот")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x08], 0x11, "R0 банка 1 лежит в 0x08")

    def test_bit_operations(self):
        # SETB 20h.3 ; CLR C ; MOV C,20h.3
        cpu, _ = make(b"\xd2\x23\xc3\xa2\x23\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertTrue(cpu.psw & 0x80, "бит 20h.3 установлен -> CY=1")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x20] & 0x08, 0x08)

    def test_push_pop_round_trip(self):
        # MOV A,#5Ah ; PUSH ACC ; MOV A,#00h ; POP ACC
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x74\x5a\xc0\xe0\x74\x00\xd0\xe0\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(6)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x5A)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sp, 0x07)

    def test_djnz_counts_down_and_branches(self):
        # MOV R0,#03h ; DJNZ R0,$-2
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x78\x03\xd8\xfe\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(10)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.ram[0x00], 0x00)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0005, "после обнуления выходим из цикла")

    def test_jb_and_jnb(self):
        # SETB 20h.0 ; JB 20h.0,+2 ; LJMP 0030h ; LJMP 0040h
        cpu, _ = make(b"\xd2\x20\x20\x00\x02\x02\x00\x30\x02\x00\x40")
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0040)

    def test_movx_goes_through_the_bus(self):
        from m8051.bus import NullBus as Bus

        rom = ROM("x")
        rom.load_block(0, b"\x90\x12\x34\x74\x5a\xf0\xe0\x80\xfe")
        bus = Bus()
        cpu = CPU8051(rom, bus)
        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(bus.ext[0x1234], 0x5A, "MOVX @DPTR,A")
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0x5A, "MOVX A,@DPTR")

    def test_ajmp_stays_in_page(self):
        # 0000: AJMP 0100h (страница 0x0100)
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x01\x00\x80\xfe" + bytes(0xFC) + b"\x80\xfe")
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x0100)


class TestTimers(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_timer0_mode1_overflows_and_sets_tf0(self):
        # MOV TMOD,#01h ; MOV TH0,#0FFh ; MOV TL0,#0FEh ; SETB TR0
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\x89\x01\x75\x8c\xff\x75\x8a\xfe\xd2\x8c\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(5)
        for _ in range(10):
            cpu.step()
        self.assertTrue(cpu.sfr[0x88] & 0x20, "TF0 обязан взвестись")

    def test_timer1_mode2_auto_reload(self):
        # MOV TMOD,#20h ; MOV TH1,#0FEh ; MOV TL1,#0FEh ; SETB TR1
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\x89\x20\x75\x8d\xfe\x75\x8b\xfe\xd2\x8e\x80\xfe")
        cpu.run_steps(5)
        for _ in range(10):
            cpu.step()
        self.assertTrue(cpu.sfr[0x88] & 0x80, "TF1 обязан взвестись")
        self.assertEqual(cpu.sfr[0x8B], 0xFE, "TL1 перезагружается из TH1")


class TestHalting(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_unmapped_fetch_stops_the_cpu_and_reports_address(self):
        rom = ROM("sparse")
        rom.load_block(0x8000, b"\x02\x90\x00")     # LJMP 9000h (не отдано)
        cpu = CPU8051(rom, NullBus())
        cpu.pc = 0x8000
        cpu.step()
        self.assertEqual(cpu.pc, 0x9000)
        cpu.step()
        self.assertTrue(cpu.halted)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.missing_pc, 0x9000)
        self.assertIn("0x9000", cpu.error)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

        cpu.run_steps(4)
        self.assertEqual(cpu.acc, 0xAA)

        # MOV PSW,#08h ; MOV R0,#11h ; MOV PSW,#00h ; MOV A,R0
        cpu, _ = make(b"\x75\xd0\x08\x78\x11\x75\xd0\x00\xe8\x80\xfe")

    def _tick_timer(mode: int, th: int, tl: int, cycles: int):
        """Advance one 8051 timer by ``cycles`` machine cycles.

        Returns ``(th, tl, overflowed)``.  Each of the four modes is handled by
        its own arithmetic; doing it in one 16-bit addition is wrong, because a
        multi-cycle batch would be applied to the reloaded value (mode 2 reloads
        the low byte from the high byte on every overflow, so the batch has to
        be consumed overflow by overflow).

        * mode 0 - 13-bit timer (``TH`` holds 5 bits)
        * mode 1 - 16-bit timer
        * mode 2 - 8-bit auto-reload: ``TL`` counts, reloads from ``TH``
        * mode 3 - split: ``TL`` is an independent 8-bit timer, ``TH`` is
          stopped (it belongs to the other timer)
        """
        if mode == 0:
            value = ((th & 0x1F) << 8 | tl) + cycles
            overflowed = value > 0x1FFF
            if overflowed:
                value &= 0x1FFF
            return (value >> 8) & 0x1F, value & 0xFF, overflowed
        if mode == 1:

412:             if overflowed and value > reload:
413:                 value = reload
414:             return reload, value & 0xFF, overflowed
415:         # mode 3: only the low half counts, the high half is stopped
416:         value = tl + cycles
417:         overflowed = value > 0xFF
418:         return th & 0xFF, value & 0xFF, overflowed
419: 
420:     def _do_peripherals(self, cycles: int) -> None:
421:         bus = self.bus
422:         if self._pending_tick:
423:             bus.tick(self._pending_tick + cycles)
424:             self._pending_tick = 0
425:         else:
426:             bus.tick(cycles)
427:         sfr = self.sfr
428:         tmod = sfr[SFR_TMOD]
429:         tcon = sfr[SFR_TCON]
430:         if tcon & TCON_TR0:
431:             th, tl, overflowed = self._tick_timer(
432:                 tmod & 0x03, sfr[SFR_TH0], sfr[SFR_TL0], cycles)
433:             sfr[SFR_TH0] = th
434:             sfr[SFR_TL0] = tl
435:             if overflowed:
436:                 tcon |= TCON_TF0
437:         if tcon & TCON_TR1:
438:             th, tl, overflowed = self._tick_timer(
439:                 (tmod >> 4) & 0x03, sfr[SFR_TH1], sfr[SFR_TL1], cycles)
440:             sfr[SFR_TH1] = th
441:             sfr[SFR_TL1] = tl
442:             if overflowed:
443:                 tcon |= TCON_TF1
444:         sfr[SFR_TCON] = tcon
445:         self.timers_on = (tcon & 0x50) != 0
446:         # serial receive
447:         if self._serial_rx:
448:             chunk = bus.serial_read()
449:             if chunk is not None:
450:                 sfr[SFR_SBUF] = chunk & 0xFF
451:                 sfr[SFR_SCON] |= SCON_RI
452:         # watchdog: 8051 WDT overflows ~ 2**17 machine cycles on AT89C55
453:         if self.wd_enabled:
454:             self.watchdog += cycles
455:             if self.watchdog > 0x20000:
456:                 self.watchdog = 0
457: 
458:     # ------------------------------------------------------------ interrupts
459:     def _poll_interrupts(self) -> None:
460:         ie = self.sfr[SFR_IE]
461:         if not (ie & 0x80):            # EA
462:             return
463:         pending = 0
464:         tcon = self.sfr[SFR_TCON]
465:         if tcon & TCON_IE0:
466:             pending |= IRQ_INT0
467:         if tcon & TCON_TF0:
468:             pending |= IRQ_T0
469:         if tcon & TCON_IE1:
470:             pending |= IRQ_INT1
471:         if tcon & TCON_TF1:
472:             pending |= IRQ_T1
473:         if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_RI:
474:             pending |= IRQ_RX
475:         if self.sfr[SFR_SCON] & SCON_TI:
476:             pending |= IRQ_TX
477:         pending |= self.bus.irq_requested()
478:         pending &= 0xFF
479:         if not pending:
480:             return
481:         ip = self.sfr[SFR_IP]
482:         chosen = -1
483:         chosen_pri = -1
484:         for bit, irq in zip(range(6), _VEC_IRQ):
485:             if not (pending & irq):
486:                 continue
487:             if not (ie & irq):
488:                 continue
489:             if (ip & irq) and self.irq_level and irq != self.irq_level:
490:                 continue
491:             pri = 1 if (ip & irq) else 0
492:             if pri > chosen_pri:
493:                 chosen_pri = pri
494:                 chosen = bit
495:         if chosen < 0:
496:             return
497:         irq = _VEC_IRQ[chosen]
498:         if irq == IRQ_T0:
499:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF0 & 0xFF
500:         elif irq == IRQ_T1:
501:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_TF1 & 0xFF
502:         elif irq == IRQ_INT0:
503:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE0 & 0xFF
504:         elif irq == IRQ_INT1:
505:             self.sfr[SFR_TCON] &= ~TCON_IE1 & 0xFF
506:         elif irq == IRQ_RX:
507:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_RI & 0xFF
508:         elif irq == IRQ_TX:
509:             self.sfr[SFR_SCON] &= ~SCON_TI & 0xFF
510:         self.irq_level = irq if (ip & irq) else 0
511:         self._advance(2)
512:         self.push_pc()
513:         self.pc = _VEC[chosen]
514: 
515:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------- step
516:     def step(self) -> int:
517:         """Execute one instruction.  Returns the machine cycles consumed."""
518:         if self.halted:
519:             return 1
520:         if not self.rom.is_mapped(self.pc):
521:             # Fetching from an address that no code image covers.  On real
522:             # silicon this reads 0xFF (erased EPROM) and the CPU wanders; for
523:             # emulation that is useless, so we stop and report it.
524:             self.missing_pc = self.pc
525:             self.halted = True
526:             self.error = (f"fetch from unmapped code address 0x{self.pc:04X} "
527:                           f"- this part of the firmware image is missing")
528:             return 1
529:         if self.idle:
530:             self._advance(1)
531:             return 1
532:         self._poll_interrupts()
533:         cycles = self._execute()
534:         self._advance(cycles)
535:         return cycles
536: 
537:     def run_steps(self, max_steps: int) -> int:
538:         """Execute at most ``max_steps`` instructions; stop on halt/error."""
539:         executed = 0
540:         while executed < max_steps and not self.halted:
541:             if not self.rom.is_mapped(self.pc):
542:                 self.missing_pc = self.pc
543:                 self.halted = True
544:                 self.error = (f"fetch from unmapped code address 0x{self.pc:04X} "
545:                               f"- this part of the firmware image is missing")
546:                 break
547:             if self.idle:
548:                 self._advance(1)
549:             else:
550:                 self._poll_interrupts()
551:                 self._advance(self._execute())
552:             executed += 1
553:         return executed
554: 
555:     def run(self, cycles: int) -> int:
556:         """Run for at most ``cycles`` machine cycles (or forever if <= 0)."""
557:         executed = 0
558:         target = self.cycles + cycles if cycles > 0 else -1
559:         execute = self._execute
560:         advance = self._advance
561:         mapped = self.rom.is_mapped
562:         while True:
563:             if self.halted:
564:                 break
565:             if self.idle:
566:                 advance(1)
567:             else:
568:                 self._poll_interrupts()
569:                 advance(execute())
570:             executed += 1
571:             if target >= 0 and self.cycles >= target:
572:                 break
573:             if executed >= 400_000_000:
574:                 break
575:             if not mapped(self.pc):
576:                 self.missing_pc = self.pc
577:                 self.halted = True
578:                 self.error = (f"fetch from unmapped code address 0x{self.pc:04X} "
579:                               f"- this part of the firmware image is missing")
580:                 break
581:         return executed
582: 
583:     # --------------------------------------------------------------- execution
584:     def _execute(self) -> int:
585:         rom = self.rom
586:         pc = self.pc
587:         self.last_op = rom.byte(pc)
588:         trace = self.trace
589:         if trace is not None:
590:             if len(trace) < self.trace_limit:
591:                 trace.append((pc, self.last_op, self.acc, self.psw,
592:                               self.sfr[SFR_SP], self.cycles))
593:             else:
594:                 self.trace = None
595:         p = pc + 1
596:         op = self.last_op
597:         romb = rom.byte
598:         sfr = self.sfr
599:         ram = self.ram
600:         bus = self.bus
601:         # ---- decode/execute -------------------------------------------------
602:         if op == 0x00:                                              # NOP
603:             self.pc = p
604:             return 1
605:         # ================================ MOV A, #imm / direct / @Ri / Rn / R
606:         if op == 0x74:                                              # MOV A,#imm
607:             self.pc = p + 1
608:             self.acc = romb(p)
609:             return 1
610:         if op == 0xE5:                                              # MOV A,direct
611:             self.pc = p + 1
612:             addr = romb(p)
613:             if addr == SFR_ACC:
614:                 pass
615:             elif addr < 0x80:
616:                 self.acc = ram[addr]
617:             elif SFR_P0 <= addr <= SFR_P3 and (addr & 0x0F) == 0:
618:                 self.acc = self._port_read((addr - SFR_P0) >> 4)
619:             elif addr == SFR_SBUF:
620:                 self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
621:             else:
622:                 self.acc = self.sfr[addr]
623:             self.set_p()
624:             return 1
625:         if op == 0xF5:                                              # MOV direct,A
626:             self.pc = p + 1
627:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
628:             return 1
629:         if op == 0xE4:                                              # CLR A
630:             self.pc = p
631:             self.acc = 0
632:             return 1
633:         if op == 0xF4:                                              # CPL A
634:             self.pc = p
635:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ 0xFF
636:             return 1
637:         if op in (0xE6, 0xE7):                                      # MOV A,@Ri
638:             self.pc = p
639:             self.acc = ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
640:             self.set_p()
641:             return 1
642:         if op in (0xF6, 0xF7):                                      # MOV @Ri,A
643:             self.pc = p
644:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
645:             return 1
646:         if op in (0x76, 0x77):                                      # MOV @Ri,#imm
647:             self.pc = p + 1
648:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = romb(p)
649:             return 1
650:         if 0xE8 <= op <= 0xEF:                                      # MOV A,Rn
651:             self.pc = p
652:             self.acc = self._r(op & 7)
653:             self.set_p()
654:             return 1
655:         if 0xF8 <= op <= 0xFF:                                      # MOV Rn,A
656:             self.pc = p
657:             self._set_r(op & 7, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
658:             return 1
659:         if 0x78 <= op <= 0x7F:                                      # MOV Rn,#imm
660:             self.pc = p + 1
661:             self._set_r(op & 7, romb(p))
662:             return 1
663:         if 0xA8 <= op <= 0xAF:                                      # MOV Rn,direct
664:             self.pc = p + 1
665:             self._set_r(op & 7, self._dir_read(romb(p)))
666:             return 1
667:         if 0x88 <= op <= 0x8F:                                      # MOV direct,Rn
668:             self.pc = p + 1
669:             self._dir_write(romb(p), self._r(op & 7))
670:             return 1
671:         if op == 0x85:                                             # MOV direct,direct
672:             self.pc = p + 2
673:             src = romb(p)
674:             dst = romb(p + 1)
675:             self._dir_write(dst, self._dir_read(src))
676:             return 2
677:         if op == 0x75:                                             # MOV direct,#imm
678:             self.pc = p + 2
679:             self._dir_write(romb(p), romb(p + 1))
680:             return 2
681:         if op in (0x86, 0x87):                                     # MOV direct,@Ri
682:             self.pc = p + 1
683:             self._dir_write(romb(p), ram[self._ri(op & 1)])
684:             return 2
685:         if op in (0xA6, 0xA7):                                     # MOV @Ri,direct
686:             self.pc = p + 1
687:             ram[self._ri(op & 1)] = self._dir_read(romb(p))
688:             return 2
689:         if op == 0x90:                                             # MOV DPTR,#imm16
690:             self.pc = p + 2
691:             self.sfr[SFR_DPH] = romb(p)
692:             self.sfr[SFR_DPL] = romb(p + 1)
693:             return 2
694:         # ============================== MOVC / MOVX
695:         if op == 0x93:                                             # MOVC A,@A+DPTR
696:             self.pc = p
697:             self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + self.dptr) & 0xFFFF)
698:             return 2
699:         if op == 0x83:                                             # MOVC A,@A+PC
700:             self.pc = p
701:             self.acc = romb((self.sfr[SFR_ACC] + p) & 0xFFFF)
702:             return 2
703:         if op in (0xE2, 0xE3):                                     # MOVX A,@Ri
704:             self.pc = p
705:             addr = self._ri(op & 1)
706:             if self.sfr[SFR_P2]:
707:                 addr |= self.sfr[SFR_P2] << 8
708:             self.acc = bus.ext_read(addr) & 0xFF
709:             self.set_p()
710:             return 2
711:         if op in (0xF2, 0xF3):                                     # MOVX @Ri,A
712:             self.pc = p
713:             addr = self._ri(op & 1)
714:             self._ext_write_banked(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
715:             return 2
716:         if op == 0xE0:                                             # MOVX A,@DPTR
717:             self.pc = p
718:             self.acc = bus.ext_read(self.dptr) & 0xFF
719:             self.set_p()
720:             return 2
721:         if op == 0xF0:                                             # MOVX @DPTR,A
722:             self.pc = p
723:             bus.ext_write(self.dptr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
724:             return 2
725:         if op == 0xA3:                                             # INC DPTR
726:             self.pc = p
727:             self.dptr = (self.dptr + 1) & 0xFFFF
728:             return 2
729:         # =============================================================== ADD
730:         if op == 0x24:                                             # ADD A,#imm
731:             self.pc = p + 1
732:             self._add(romb(p), 0)
733:             return 1
734:         if op == 0x25:                                             # ADD A,direct
735:             self.pc = p + 1
736:             self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), 0)
737:             return 1
738:         if op in (0x26, 0x27):                                     # ADD A,@Ri
739:             self.pc = p
740:             self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], 0)
741:             return 1
742:         if 0x28 <= op <= 0x2F:                                     # ADD A,Rn
743:             self.pc = p
744:             self._add(self._r(op & 7), 0)
745:             return 1
746:         if op == 0x34:                                             # ADDC A,#imm
747:             self.pc = p + 1
748:             self._add(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
749:             return 1
750:         if op == 0x35:                                             # ADDC A,direct
751:             self.pc = p + 1
752:             self._add(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
753:             return 1
754:         if op in (0x36, 0x37):
755:             self.pc = p
756:             self._add(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
757:             return 1
758:         if 0x38 <= op <= 0x3F:
759:             self.pc = p
760:             self._add(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
761:             return 1
762:         # =============================================================== SUBB
763:         if op == 0x94:
764:             self.pc = p + 1
765:             self._sub(romb(p), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
766:             return 1
767:         if op == 0x95:
768:             self.pc = p + 1
769:             self._sub(self._dir_read(romb(p)), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
770:             return 1
771:         if op in (0x96, 0x97):
772:             self.pc = p
773:             self._sub(ram[self._ri(op & 1)], sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
774:             return 1
775:         if 0x98 <= op <= 0x9F:
776:             self.pc = p
777:             self._sub(self._r(op & 7), sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80)
778:             return 1
779:         # ================================================================ INC
780:         if op in (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07):
781:             return self._inc_family(op, p, romb)
782:         if 0x08 <= op <= 0x0F:                                     # INC Rn
783:             self.pc = p
784:             n = op & 7
785:             self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) + 1) & 0xFF)
786:             return 1
787:         if op == 0x14:                                             # DEC A
788:             self.pc = p
789:             self.acc = (self.sfr[SFR_ACC] - 1) & 0xFF
790:             return 1
791:         if op in (0x15, 0x16, 0x17):
792:             return self._dec_family(op, p, romb)
793:         if 0x18 <= op <= 0x1F:                                     # DEC Rn
794:             self.pc = p
795:             n = op & 7
796:             self._set_r(n, (self._r(n) - 1) & 0xFF)
797:             return 1
798:         # ================================================================ MUL/DIV
799:         if op == 0xA4:                                             # MUL AB
800:             self.pc = p
801:             result = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] * self.sfr[SFR_B]
802:             self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = result & 0xFF
803:             self.sfr[SFR_B] = (result >> 8) & 0xFF
804:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
805:             if result > 0xFF:
806:                 psw |= 0x04
807:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
808:             self.set_p()
809:             return 4
810:         if op == 0x84:                                             # DIV AB
811:             self.pc = p
812:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
813:             b = self.sfr[SFR_B]
814:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xFE
815:             if b == 0:
816:                 psw |= 0x04
817:             else:
818:                 self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = a // b
819:                 self.sfr[SFR_B] = a % b
820:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
821:             self.set_p()
822:             return 4
823:         # ========================================================== logical ops
824:         if op == 0x54:                                             # ANL A,#imm
825:             self.pc = p + 1
826:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & romb(p)
827:             return 1
828:         if op == 0x55:
829:             self.pc = p + 1
830:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._dir_read(romb(p))
831:             return 1
832:         if op in (0x56, 0x57):
833:             self.pc = p
834:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
835:             return 1
836:         if 0x58 <= op <= 0x5F:
837:             self.pc = p
838:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] & self._r(op & 7)
839:             return 1
840:         if op == 0x44:                                             # ORL A,#imm
841:             self.pc = p + 1
842:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | romb(p)
843:             return 1
844:         if op == 0x45:
845:             self.pc = p + 1
846:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._dir_read(romb(p))
847:             return 1
848:         if op in (0x46, 0x47):
849:             self.pc = p
850:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
851:             return 1
852:         if 0x48 <= op <= 0x4F:
853:             self.pc = p
854:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] | self._r(op & 7)
855:             return 1
856:         if op == 0x64:                                             # XRL A,#imm
857:             self.pc = p + 1
858:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ romb(p)
859:             return 1
860:         if op == 0x65:
861:             self.pc = p + 1
862:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._dir_read(romb(p))
863:             return 1
864:         if op in (0x66, 0x67):
865:             self.pc = p
866:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ ram[self._ri(op & 1)]
867:             return 1
868:         if 0x68 <= op <= 0x6F:
869:             self.pc = p
870:             self.acc = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] ^ self._r(op & 7)
871:             return 1
872:         # ANL/ORL/XRL direct,A and direct,#imm
873:         if op in (0x52, 0x53):
874:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x52 else 2)
875:             addr = romb(p)
876:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x52 else romb(p + 1)
877:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) & operand)
878:             return 1 if op == 0x52 else 2
879:         if op in (0x42, 0x43):
880:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x42 else 2)
881:             addr = romb(p)
882:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x42 else romb(p + 1)
883:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) | operand)
884:             return 1 if op == 0x42 else 2
885:         if op in (0x62, 0x63):
886:             self.pc = p + (1 if op == 0x62 else 2)
887:             addr = romb(p)
888:             operand = self.sfr[SFR_ACC] if op == 0x62 else romb(p + 1)
889:             self._dir_write(addr, self._dir_read(addr) ^ operand)
890:             return 1 if op == 0x62 else 2
891:         # =========================================================== rotates
892:         if op == 0x03:                                             # RR A
893:             self.pc = p
894:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
895:             self.acc = (a >> 1) | ((a & 1) << 7)
896:             return 1
897:         if op == 0x13:                                             # RRC A
898:             self.pc = p
899:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
900:             carry = 0x80 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
901:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
902:             if a & 1:
903:                 psw |= 0x80
904:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
905:             self.acc = (a >> 1) | carry
906:             return 1
907:         if op == 0x23:                                             # RL A
908:             self.pc = p
909:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
910:             self.acc = ((a << 1) | (a >> 7)) & 0xFF
911:             return 1
912:         if op == 0x33:                                             # RLC A
913:             self.pc = p
914:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
915:             carry_in = 1 if (self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x80) else 0
916:             result = (a << 1) | carry_in
917:             psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x7F
918:             if result > 0xFF:
919:                 psw |= 0x80
920:             self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw
921:             self.acc = result & 0xFF
922:             return 1
923:         if op == 0xC4:                                             # SWAP A
924:             self.pc = p
925:             a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
926:             self.acc = ((a << 4) | (a >> 4)) & 0xFF
927:             return 1
928:         if op in (0xD4,):                                          # DA A
929:             self.pc = p
930:             return self._da(1)
931:         # ========================================================= XCH / XCHD
932:         if op == 0xC5:
933:             self.pc = p + 1
934:             addr = romb(p)
935:             tmp = self._dir_read(addr)
936:             self._dir_write(addr, self.sfr[SFR_ACC])
937:             self.acc = tmp
938:             return 1
939:         if op in (0xC6, 0xC7):
940:             self.pc = p
941:             ri = self._ri(op & 1)
942:             tmp = ram[ri]
943:             ram[ri] = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
944:             self.acc = tmp
945:             self.set_p()
946:             return 1

demo-fw: THIRD core bug in m8051/cpu.py — `_add`/`_sub` never CLEAR CY/AC/OV and they clear the register-bank bits. This one silently corrupts all BCD arithmetic (it is why my receipt printed "1.250" and "6061.856" instead of "12.50" / "15.50"). m8051/ is yours; evidence + fix below.

WHERE (cpu.py, `CPU8051._add`, same pattern in `_sub`):
    psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0xC0      # keeps the OLD CY and AC
    if ((a & 0x0F) + (operand & 0x0F) + carry) > 0x0F:
        psw |= 0x40                     # AC only ever set, never cleared
    if result > 0xFF:
        psw |= 0x80                     # CY only ever set, never cleared
    ...
    if (a ^ value) & (operand ^ value) & 0x80:
        psw |= 0x04                     # OV only ever set, never cleared
    self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]
On real silicon ADD/ADDC/SUBB always *update* CY, AC and OV (set or clear). Here they are sticky-on. The `& 0xC0` mask additionally wipes PSW bits 3..5 (RS0/RS1/F0), i.e. any ADD switches the register bank back to bank 0 — that will break real firmware that uses banks 1..3.

MEASURED (unmodified core):
    MOV A,#08h / ADD A,#08h      ; AC=1
    MOV A,#10h / ADD A,#01h      ; no nibble carry -> AC must clear
    DA  A                        ; correct result: 10h
    -> actual: 17h   (DA saw the stale AC and added 6)
    MOV A,#0FFh / ADD A,#02h     ; CY=1
    MOV A,#01h  / ADD A,#01h     ; CY must clear
    -> actual CY still 1
    BCD idiom  MOV A,#50h / ADD A,#00h / DA A   (with a stale AC)
    -> actual: 56h, correct: 50h

FIX (build the flag bits from scratch, preserve RS0/RS1/F0 = 0x38):
    def _add(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        carry = 1 if carry_in else 0
        result = a + operand + carry
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x38          # keep RS0, RS1, F0 only
        if ((a & 0x0F) + (operand & 0x0F) + carry) > 0x0F:
            psw |= 0x40                          # AC
        if result > 0xFF:
            psw |= 0x80                          # CY
        value = result & 0xFF
        if (a ^ value) & (operand ^ value) & 0x80:
            psw |= 0x04                          # OV
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]

    def _sub(self, operand: int, carry_in: int) -> None:
        a = self.sfr[SFR_ACC]
        borrow = 1 if carry_in else 0
        result = a - operand - borrow
        psw = self.sfr[SFR_PSW] & 0x38
        if ((a & 0x0F) - (operand & 0x0F) - borrow) < 0:
            psw |= 0x40
        if result < 0:
            psw |= 0x80
        value = result & 0xFF
        if (a ^ operand) & (a ^ value) & 0x80:
            psw |= 0x04
        self.sfr[SFR_ACC] = value
        self.sfr[SFR_PSW] = psw | _PARITY[value]
